540:         archive_integrity = "PASS" if bad_member is None else f"FAIL at {bad_member}"
541:         expected_models = {MODEL_FILENAME, "7miRTrimmedXenoNet-38.xml", "NewNetXenograft-1.xml"}
542:         model_filenames = [name for name in archive_names if name.lower() in {item.lower() for item in expected_models}]

544:         if archive_integrity != "PASS":

547:         raise ValueError(f"Missing {MODEL_FILENAME}; archive members: {archive_names}")

86: def json_value(value: Any) -> Any:
87:     if value is None or pd.isna(value):
88:         return None
89:     if isinstance(value, np.generic):
90:         return value.item()
91:     if isinstance(value, pd.Timestamp):
92:         return value.isoformat()
93:     return value
94: 
95: 
96: def records_json(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
97:     records = [
98:         {str(key): json_value(value) for key, value in row.items()}
99:         for row in frame.to_dict(orient="records")
100:     ]
101:     return json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"))
102: 
103: 
104: def identifier_columns(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> list[str]:
105:     return [
106:         str(column)
107:         for column in frame.columns
108:         if str(column).strip().casefold() in {"id", "subject id", "sample id"}
109:     ]
110: 
111: 
112: def column_classes(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
113:     categorical: list[str] = []
114:     continuous: list[str] = []
115:     identifiers = set(identifier_columns(frame))
116:     for column in frame.columns:
117:         if column in identifiers:
118:             continue
119:         series = frame[column]
120:         if (
121:             pd.api.types.is_object_dtype(series)
122:             or pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series)
123:             or isinstance(series.dtype, pd.CategoricalDtype)
124:             or series.nunique(dropna=True) <= 12
125:         ):
126:             categorical.append(str(column))
127:         elif pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
128:             continuous.append(str(column))
129:         else:
130:             categorical.append(str(column))
131:     return categorical, continuous
132: 
133: 
134: def normalize_feature_name(value: str) -> str:
135:     name = str(value).strip().strip("'").strip()
136:     name = re.sub(r"\s*\(MFI\)\s*$", "", name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
137:     return name.casefold()
138: 
139: 
140: def feature_name_from_column(value: str) -> str:
141:     name = str(value).strip().strip("'").strip()
142:     return re.sub(r"\s*\(MFI\)\s*$", "", name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
143: 
144: 
145: def build_histology_map(histology: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[dict[Any, dict[str, str]], int]:
146:     deduplicated = histology.drop_duplicates().copy()
147:     exact_duplicate_rows = len(histology) - len(deduplicated)
148:     mapping: dict[Any, dict[str, str]] = {}
149:     for patient_id, group in deduplicated.groupby(ID, sort=False, dropna=False):
150:         stages = group[HISTOLOGY_STAGE].dropna().astype(str).unique().tolist()
151:         types = group["histology"].dropna().astype(str).unique().tolist()
152:         descriptions = (
153:             group[" histology (invasive ovarian cancer)"]
154:             .dropna()
155:             .astype(str)
156:             .unique()
157:             .tolist()
158:         )
159:         if len(stages) == 1:
160:             stage = stages[0]
161:         elif len(stages) > 1:
162:             stage = "Unknown (conflicting worksheet entries)"
163:         else:
164:             stage = "Unknown (stage not reported)"
165:         mapping[patient_id] = {
166:             "stage": stage,
167:             "histology": types[0] if len(types) == 1 else "Unknown",
168:             "histology_detail": descriptions[0] if len(descriptions) == 1 else "Unknown",
169:         }
170:     return mapping, exact_duplicate_rows
171: 
172: 
173: def write_inventory(sheets: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> None:
174:     inventory_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
175:     for name, frame in sheets.items():
176:         categorical, continuous = column_classes(frame)
177:         missing = {
178:             str(column): int(count)
179:             for column, count in frame.isna().sum().items()
180:             if count
181:         }
182:         id_summary: dict[str, Any] = {}
183:         duplicates: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
184:         for column in identifier_columns(frame):
185:             id_summary[column] = {
186:                 "nonmissing": int(frame[column].notna().sum()),
187:                 "unique": int(frame[column].nunique(dropna=True)),
188:             }
189:             duplicates[column] = {
190:                 str(key): int(count)
191:                 for key, count in frame.loc[
192:                     frame[column].duplicated(keep=False), column
193:                 ].value_counts(dropna=False).items()
194:             }
195:         inventory_rows.append(
196:             {
197:                 "sheet": name,
198:                 "row_count": len(frame),
199:                 "column_count": len(frame.columns),
200:                 "column_names_json": json.dumps(list(map(str, frame.columns))),
201:                 "dtypes_json": json.dumps(
202:                     {str(key): str(value) for key, value in frame.dtypes.items()}
203:                 ),
204:                 "missingness_json": json.dumps(missing, sort_keys=True),
205:                 "identifier_summary_json": json.dumps(id_summary, sort_keys=True),
206:                 "duplicated_identifiers_json": json.dumps(duplicates, sort_keys=True),
207:                 "categorical_variables_json": json.dumps(categorical),
208:                 "continuous_variables_json": json.dumps(continuous),
209:                 "first_5_rows_json": records_json(frame.head(5)),
210:                 "last_5_rows_json": records_json(frame.tail(5)),
211:             }
212:         )
213:     with INVENTORY_CSV.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
214:         writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=list(inventory_rows[0]))
215:         writer.writeheader()
216:         writer.writerows(inventory_rows)
217: 
218: 
219: def describe_sheet(name: str, frame: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
220:     categorical, continuous = column_classes(frame)
221:     type_map = {str(column): str(dtype) for column, dtype in frame.dtypes.items()}
222:     by_type: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
223:     for column, dtype in type_map.items():
224:         by_type.setdefault(dtype, []).append(column)
225:     missing = frame.isna().sum()
226:     missing = {str(column): int(count) for column, count in missing.items() if count}
227:     ids = identifier_columns(frame)
228:     id_lines = []
229:     for column in ids:
230:         duplicated = frame.loc[frame[column].duplicated(keep=False), column].value_counts()
231:         id_lines.append(
232:             f"- `{column}`: {frame[column].nunique(dropna=True)} unique of "
233:             f"{frame[column].notna().sum()} nonmissing; duplicate rows "
234:             f"{int(frame[column].duplicated(keep=False).sum())}; repeated IDs "
235:             f"`{json.dumps({str(k): int(v) for k, v in duplicated.items()}) if len(duplicated) else 'none'}`."
236:         )
237:     if not id_lines:
238:         id_lines = ["- No ID-like identifier column detected."]
239: 
240:     type_lines = [
241:         f"- `{dtype}` ({len(columns)}): " + ", ".join(f"`{column}`" for column in columns)
242:         for dtype, columns in by_type.items()
243:     ]
244:     categorical_lines: list[str] = []
245:     for column in categorical:
246:         counts = frame[column].value_counts(dropna=False)
247:         categorical_lines.append(
248:             f"- `{column}`: "
249:             + "; ".join(f"{str(value)!r} = {int(count)}" for value, count in counts.items())
250:         )
251:     if not categorical_lines:
252:         categorical_lines = ["- None detected."]
253:     continuous_lines: list[str] = []
254:     for column in continuous:
255:         values = pd.to_numeric(frame[column], errors="coerce")
256:         continuous_lines.append(
257:             f"- `{column}`: n={int(values.notna().sum())}, min={values.min():g}, "
258:             f"median={values.median():g}, max={values.max():g}."
259:         )
260:     if not continuous_lines:
261:         continuous_lines = ["- None detected."]
262:     first = records_json(frame.head(5))
263:     last = records_json(frame.tail(5))
264:     missing_text = json.dumps(missing, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True) if missing else "none"
265:     return "\n".join(
266:         [
267:             f"## {name}",
268:             f"Rows: {len(frame)} data rows. Columns: {len(frame.columns)}.",
269:             "",
270:             "### Column names",
271:             "```text",
272:             *map(str, frame.columns),
273:             "```",
274:             "",
275:             "### Data types",
276:             *type_lines,
277:             "",
278:             f"Missingness: `{missing_text}`.",
279:             "",
280:             "### Identifier fields and duplicate identifiers",
281:             *id_lines,
282:             "",
283:             "### Categorical variables",
284:             *categorical_lines,
285:             "",
286:             "### Continuous variables",
287:             *continuous_lines,
288:             "",
289:             "### First 5 data rows",
290:             "```json",
291:             first,
292:             "```",
293:             "",
294:             "### Last 5 data rows",
295:             "```json",
296:             last,
297:             "```",
298:             "",
299:         ]
300:     )

303: def write_file_verification() -> tuple[int, str]:
304:     data = WORKBOOK.read_bytes()
305:     digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
306:     size = len(data)
307:     with zipfile.ZipFile(WORKBOOK) as archive:
308:         bad_member = archive.testzip()
309:         has_workbook_xml = "xl/workbook.xml" in archive.namelist()
310:     workbook = load_workbook(WORKBOOK, read_only=True, data_only=True)
311:     sheet_lines = [
312:         f"- `{sheet.title}`: {sheet.max_row - 1} data rows, {sheet.max_column} columns."
313:         for sheet in workbook.worksheets
314:     ]
315:     workbook.close()
316:     FILE_VERIFICATION.write_text(
317:         "\n".join(
318:             [
319:                 "# 2024 Adnexal-Mass Workbook File Verification",
320:                 "",
321:                 "- Expected file: `NIHMS2021079-supplement-1.xlsx`",
322:                 f"- Verified path: `{WORKBOOK.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}`",
323:                 "- Source paper: \"Serum miRNA improves the accuracy of a multivariate index assay for triage of an adnexal mass\"",
324:                 "- DOI: `10.1016/j.ygyno.2024.08.008`",
325:                 "- PMCID: `PMC13283006`",
326:                 f"- Exists: `{WORKBOOK.is_file()}`",
327:                 "- File type: XLSX (ZIP container with `xl/workbook.xml`).",
328:                 f"- ZIP/XLSX signature: `{data[:4].hex()}` (`PK\\x03\\x04`).",
329:                 f"- ZIP integrity: `{'valid' if bad_member is None else f'invalid: {bad_member}'}`.",
330:                 f"- `xl/workbook.xml` present: `{has_workbook_xml}`.",
331:                 f"- File size: {size:,} bytes.",
332:                 f"- SHA256: `{digest}`.",
333:                 "- Worksheet dimensions:",
334:                 *sheet_lines,
335:                 "",
336:                 "The workbook was inspected in place; no download was attempted.",
337:                 "",
338:             ]
339:         ),
340:         encoding="utf-8",
341:     )
342:     return size, digest

345: def write_reconstructions(
346:     mirna: pd.DataFrame,
347:     clinical: pd.DataFrame,
348:     histology: pd.DataFrame,
349: ) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[Any, dict[str, str]], int]:
350:     if mirna[ID].isna().any() or clinical[ID].isna().any():
351:         raise ValueError("Missing ID in a main patient-level worksheet")
352:     if mirna[ID].duplicated().any() or clinical[ID].duplicated().any():
353:         raise ValueError("Duplicate IDs in a main patient-level worksheet")
354:     if not mirna[ID].reset_index(drop=True).equals(clinical[ID].reset_index(drop=True)):
355:         raise ValueError("miRNA and protein/metadata IDs are not identical and ordered")
356:     for field in (COHORT, LABEL):
357:         if not mirna[field].equals(clinical[field]):
358:             raise ValueError(f"{field} disagrees between the main worksheets")
359: 
360:     histology_map, exact_duplicate_rows = build_histology_map(histology)
361:     base = mirna[[ID, COHORT, LABEL]].merge(
362:         clinical.drop(columns=[COHORT, LABEL]),
363:         on=ID,
364:         how="left",
365:         validate="one_to_one",
366:     )
367:     cohort_split = {
368:         "ASPIRA (train)": "development/training",
369:         "ASPIRA (internal validation)": "internal validation",
370:         "BWH (external validation)": "external validation",
371:     }
372:     rows = []
373:     for record in base.to_dict(orient="records"):
374:         patient_id = record[ID]
375:         diagnosis = int(record[LABEL])
376:         stage_info = histology_map.get(
377:             patient_id,
378:             {
379:                 "stage": "Unknown (not present in histologies worksheet)",
380:                 "histology": "Unknown (not present in histologies worksheet)",
381:                 "histology_detail": "Unknown (not present in histologies worksheet)",
382:             },
383:         )
384:         menopause = record.get("Meno (pre-menopause = 0, post = 1)")
385:         row = {
386:             "patient_id": patient_id,
387:             "sample_id": patient_id,
388:             "published_split": cohort_split.get(record[COHORT], "Unknown"),
389:             "diagnosis": "cancer" if diagnosis == 1 else "control (subtype not separately recorded)",
390:             "diagnosis_binary": diagnosis,
391:             "control_type": "not applicable" if diagnosis == 1 else "benign/healthy subtype unknown",
392:             "stage": stage_info["stage"] if diagnosis == 1 else "not applicable",
393:             "histology": stage_info["histology"] if diagnosis == 1 else "not applicable",
394:             "histology_detail": stage_info["histology_detail"] if diagnosis == 1 else "not applicable",
395:             "age": record.get("Age"),
396:             "menopausal_status": (
397:                 {0: "pre-menopausal", 1: "post-menopausal"}.get(int(menopause), "unknown")
398:                 if pd.notna(menopause)
399:                 else "unknown"
400:             ),
401:             "ca125": record.get("CA125"),
402:             "he4": record.get("HE4"),
403:             "apoa1": record.get("ApoA1"),
404:             "prealbumin": record.get("PreAlb"),
405:             "b2m": record.get("B2M"),
406:             "transferrin": record.get("TRF"),
407:             "fsh": record.get("FSH"),
408:             "study_site": "BWH" if str(record[COHORT]).startswith("BWH") else "ASPIRA",
409:             "collection_group": record[COHORT],
410:         }
411:         rows.append(row)
412:     cohort = pd.DataFrame(rows)
413:     if len(cohort) != len(mirna) or cohort["patient_id"].duplicated().any():
414:         raise ValueError("Reconstruction did not preserve exactly one row per source ID")
415:     cohort.to_csv(COHORT_CSV, index=False)
416:     return cohort, histology_map, exact_duplicate_rows

419: def write_stage_counts(cohort: pd.DataFrame, histology: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
420:     cancer = cohort.loc[cohort["diagnosis_binary"].eq(1)].copy()
421:     split_values = [("all", cancer)] + list(cancer.groupby("published_split", sort=False))
422:     split_by_id = cohort.set_index("patient_id")["published_split"].to_dict()
423:     histology_rows = histology.copy()
424:     histology_rows["published_split"] = histology_rows[ID].map(split_by_id)
425:     stage_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
426:     for split, subset in split_values:
427:         stage_counts = subset["stage"].value_counts()
428:         raw_rows = histology_rows if split == "all" else histology_rows.loc[
429:             histology_rows["published_split"].eq(split)
430:         ]
431:         raw_stage_counts = raw_rows[HISTOLOGY_STAGE].value_counts()
432:         for category, note in [
433:             ("Stage I", "Not separately reported; workbook only provides grouped I/II."),
434:             ("Stage II", "Not separately reported; workbook only provides grouped I/II."),
435:             ("Stage III", "Not separately reported; workbook only provides grouped III/IV."),
436:             ("Stage IV", "Not separately reported; workbook only provides grouped III/IV."),
437:             ("stage I/II", "Grouped stage only; not separable into Stage I versus II."),
438:             ("stage III/IV", "Grouped stage only; not separable into Stage III versus IV."),
439:             (
440:                 "Unknown (conflicting worksheet entries)",
441:                 "The ASPIRA training split includes one patient with both Stage I/II and Stage III/IV records.",
442:             ),
443:             ("Unknown (not present in histologies worksheet)", "Stage is not supplied for this patient."),
444:         ]:
445:             separately_unreported = category in {"Stage I", "Stage II", "Stage III", "Stage IV"}
446:             worksheet_row_count = (
447:                 "not separately reported"
448:                 if separately_unreported
449:                 else (
450:                 int(raw_stage_counts.get(category, 0))
451:                 if category in {"stage I/II", "stage III/IV"}
452:                 else (
453:                     2
454:                     if category == "Unknown (conflicting worksheet entries)"
455:                     and (split == "all" or split == "development/training")
456:                     else 0
457:                 )
458:                 )
459:             )
460:             stage_rows.append(
461:                 {
462:                     "published_split": split,
463:                     "stage_category": category,
464:                     "patient_count": "not separately reported"
465:                     if separately_unreported
466:                     else int(stage_counts.get(category, 0)),
467:                     "worksheet_row_count": worksheet_row_count,
468:                     "denominator_cancer": len(subset),
469:                     "notes": note,
470:                 }
471:             )
472:     pd.DataFrame(stage_rows).to_csv(STAGE_CSV, index=False)

475: def write_feature_maps(mirna: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
476:     measurement_columns = list(mirna.columns[3:])
477:     normalized_to_column = {
478:         normalize_feature_name(str(column)): str(column) for column in measurement_columns
479:     }
480:     all_rows = []
481:     for column in measurement_columns:
482:         values = pd.to_numeric(mirna[column], errors="coerce")
483:         clean_name = feature_name_from_column(str(column))
484:         all_rows.append(
485:             {
486:                 "2024_identifier": clean_name,
487:                 "workbook_column": str(column),
488:                 "species_prefix": clean_name.split("-", 1)[0] if "-" in clean_name else "unknown",
489:                 "measurement_scale": "MFI (as stated in workbook column header)",
490:                 "nonmissing_patients": int(values.notna().sum()),
491:                 "missing_patients": int(values.isna().sum()),
492:                 "minimum": float(values.min()),
493:                 "median": float(values.median()),
494:                 "maximum": float(values.max()),
495:             }
496:         )
497:     pd.DataFrame(all_rows).to_csv(PANEL_CSV, index=False)
498: 
499:     alias_columns = {"hsa-miR-335-5p": "hsa-mir-335-5p_0_-2"}
500:     feature_rows = []
501:     for signature_name, features in [
502:         ("current production OVAI", PRODUCTION_FEATURES),
503:         ("historical 14-feature signature", HISTORICAL_FEATURES),
504:     ]:
505:         for feature in features:
506:             normalized = normalize_feature_name(feature)
507:             exact_column = normalized_to_column.get(normalized)
508:             candidate_column = None
509:             if exact_column is None and feature in alias_columns:
510:                 target = alias_columns[feature].casefold()
511:                 candidate_column = next(
512:                     (
513:                         str(column)
514:                         for column in measurement_columns
515:                         if normalize_feature_name(str(column)) == target
516:                     ),
517:                     None,
518:                 )
519:             measured_column = exact_column or candidate_column
520:             exact = exact_column is not None
521:             feature_rows.append(
522:                 {
523:                     "ovai_feature": feature,
524:                     "2024_identifier": feature_name_from_column(measured_column) if measured_column else "",
525:                     "mapping_type": (
526:                         "exact mature-name match (case/format normalized)"
527:                         if exact
528:                         else "candidate panel alias; not verified"
529:                         if candidate_column
530:                         else "no matching assay identifier"
531:                     ),
532:                     "exact_match": exact,
533:                     "measured": measured_column is not None,
534:                     "measurement_scale": "MFI (transform/normalization not specified in workbook)"
535:                     if measured_column
536:                     else "",
537:                     "usable_for_frozen_test": False,
538:                     "notes": (
539:                         f"Compared against {signature_name}. The current frozen production model requires all five production miRNAs; none are present as exact mature-name matches."
540:                         if signature_name == "current production OVAI"
541:                         else "Historical signature mapping only; these features are not inputs to the current frozen production model."
542:                     )
543:                     + (
544:                         " Suffix `_0_-2` is not treated as an exact match without assay annotation."
545:                         if candidate_column
546:                         else ""
547:                     ),
548:                 }
549:             )
550:     feature_map = pd.DataFrame(feature_rows)
551:     feature_map.to_csv(FEATURE_MAP_CSV, index=False)
552:     return feature_map

649: def write_decision_reports(
650:     sheets: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
651:     cohort: pd.DataFrame,
652:     feature_map: pd.DataFrame,
653:     workbook_size: int,
654:     workbook_sha256: str,
655: ) -> None:
656:     mirna = sheets[MIRNA_SHEET]
657:     clinical = sheets[CLINICAL_SHEET]
658:     normalized_columns = {
659:         normalize_feature_name(str(column)): str(column) for column in mirna.columns[3:]
660:     }
661:     published_rows = []
662:     for feature in PUBLISHED_COMBINED_MIRNAS:
663:         matched = normalized_columns.get(normalize_feature_name(feature))
664:         published_rows.append(
665:             {
666:                 "published_model_feature": feature,
667:                 "2024_identifier": feature_name_from_column(matched) if matched else "",
668:                 "exact_match": matched is not None,
669:                 "measured": matched is not None,
670:                 "notes": "Exact mature-name match after case/format normalization."
671:                 if matched
672:                 else "No exact workbook assay identifier; not treated as an alias.",
673:             }
674:         )
675:     pd.DataFrame(published_rows).to_csv(PUBLISHED_FEATURE_MAP_CSV, index=False)
676:     published_exact = sum(row["exact_match"] for row in published_rows)
677: 
678:     split_summary = (
679:         cohort.groupby(["published_split", "diagnosis_binary"], dropna=False)
680:         .size()
681:         .unstack(fill_value=0)
682:     )
683:     split_counts = {
684:         split: {
685:             "controls": int(values.get(0, 0)),
686:             "cancer": int(values.get(1, 0)),
687:             "total": int(values.sum()),
688:         }
689:         for split, values in split_summary.iterrows()
690:     }
691:     external = cohort.loc[cohort["published_split"].eq("external validation")]
692:     external_cancer = external.loc[external["diagnosis_binary"].eq(1)]
693:     external_stage_i_ii = int(external_cancer["stage"].eq("stage I/II").sum())
694:     external_stage_iii_iv = int(external_cancer["stage"].eq("stage III/IV").sum())
695:     production_map = feature_map.loc[feature_map["ovai_feature"].isin(PRODUCTION_FEATURES)]
696:     exact_production = int(production_map["exact_match"].sum())
697:     feature_specs = [
698:         f"| `{row['published_model_feature']}` | `{'yes' if row['exact_match'] else 'no'}` | `{'yes' if row['measured'] else 'no'}` |"
699:         for row in published_rows
700:     ]
701: 
702:     FROZEN_VALIDATION_REPORT.write_text(
703:         "\n".join(
704:             [
705:                 "# Frozen GSE94533 OVAI External Validation: 2024 FirePlex",
706:                 "",
707:                 "## Preflight Result",
708:                 "",
709:                 "**No patient-level predictions were generated.** The frozen production model requires all five production miRNAs, age, and CA-125. The workbook has age and CA-125 but has zero exact measured matches to the five required production miRNAs. Substituting historical markers, using fuzzy aliases, refitting a model, or estimating missing features would not be a frozen validation.",

112: 
113: def norm_feature(value: Any) -> str:
114:     text = str(value).strip().strip("'").strip()
115:     text = re.sub(r"\s*\(MFI\)\s*$", "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
116:     return text.lower()
117: 
118: 
119: def hedges_g(case: pd.Series, control: pd.Series) -> tuple[float, float, float, int, int]:
120:     cases = pd.to_numeric(case, errors="coerce").dropna().to_numpy(dtype=float)
121:     controls = pd.to_numeric(control, errors="coerce").dropna().to_numpy(dtype=float)
122:     pooled_sd = np.sqrt(
123:         ((len(cases) - 1) * np.var(cases, ddof=1) + (len(controls) - 1) * np.var(controls, ddof=1))
124:         / (len(cases) + len(controls) - 2)
125:     )
126:     d = (cases.mean() - controls.mean()) / pooled_sd if pooled_sd else np.nan
127:     correction = 1 - 3 / (4 * (len(cases) + len(controls)) - 9)
128:     return float(d * correction), float(cases.mean()), float(controls.mean()), len(cases), len(controls)

131: def write_overlap_and_alias() -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[str, str]]:
132:     panel = pd.read_csv(PANEL_INVENTORY)
133:     panel_lookup = {

192: def write_historical_replication(panel_lookup: dict[str, str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
193:     patient_predictions = pd.read_csv(GSE_PREDICTIONS).drop_duplicates("sample_id_normalized")
194:     source = patient_predictions.loc[
195:         patient_predictions["dataset"].eq("GSE94533")
196:         & patient_predictions["diagnosis"].isin(["Cancer", "Benign", "Control"])
197:     ].copy()
198:     source = source.loc[
199:         source["diagnosis"].ne("Cancer") | source["stage_group"].eq("Stage I/II")
200:     ]
201:     if len(source) != 113:
202:         raise ValueError(f"Expected saved GSE94533 Stage I/II-vs-benign/control rows=113; found {len(source)}")
203:     cancer_mask = source["diagnosis"].eq("Cancer")
204:     source_control_mask = source["diagnosis"].isin(["Benign", "Control"])
205: 
206:     workbook = pd.read_excel(WORKBOOK, sheet_name="miRNA")
207:     diagnosis = "diagnosis (benign = 0, malignant= 1)"
208:     case_mask = workbook[diagnosis].eq(1)
209:     control_mask = workbook[diagnosis].eq(0)
210:     stability = pd.read_csv(STABILITY)
211:     output = []
212:     shared_historical = [feature for feature in HISTORICAL if norm_feature(feature) in panel_lookup]
213:     if len(shared_historical) != 8:
214:         raise ValueError(f"Expected eight exact FirePlex/historical overlaps; found {len(shared_historical)}")
215:     for feature in shared_historical:
216:         item = panel_lookup[norm_feature(feature)]
217:         column = item["workbook_column"]
218:         case_effect, case_mean, control_mean, n_case, n_control = hedges_g(
219:             workbook.loc[case_mask, column], workbook.loc[control_mask, column]
220:         )
221:         source_effect, source_case_mean, source_control_mean, source_n_case, source_n_control = hedges_g(
222:             source.loc[cancer_mask, feature], source.loc[source_control_mask, feature]
223:         )
224:         feature_rows = stability.loc[
225:             stability["feature"].eq(feature) & stability["signature_size"].isin([5, 10, 14])
226:         ]
227:         freq: dict[str, float] = {}
228:         for task in ["all_cancer_vs_non_cancer", "early_stage_vs_benign_control"]:
229:             for method in ["l1", "elastic_net"]:
230:                 subset = feature_rows.loc[
231:                     feature_rows["task"].eq(task) & feature_rows["selection_method"].eq(method)
232:                 ]
233:                 freq[f"{task}_{method}_max_frequency"] = float(subset["selection_frequency"].max()) if len(subset) else 0.0
234:         stable_member = any(value >= 0.6 for value in freq.values())
235:         source_direction = "higher" if source_case_mean > source_control_mean else "lower" if source_case_mean < source_control_mean else "equal"
236:         external_direction = "higher" if case_mean > control_mean else "lower" if case_mean < control_mean else "equal"
237:         output.append(
238:             {
239:                 "feature": feature,
240:                 "GSE94533_early_case_n": source_n_case,
241:                 "GSE94533_benign_control_n": source_n_control,
242:                 "GSE94533_case_mean": source_case_mean,
243:                 "GSE94533_control_mean": source_control_mean,
244:                 "GSE94533_abundance_direction": source_direction,
245:                 "GSE94533_coefficient_direction": "not available; saved stability artifact contains selection frequency only",
246:                 "GSE94533_early_effect_hedges_g": source_effect,
247:                 **freq,
248:                 "prior_stable_signature_member": stable_member,
249:                 "stable_membership_rule": "selection frequency >=3/5 in an existing 5/10/14-feature signature on either saved endpoint",
250:                 "2024_exact_identifier": item["2024_identifier"],
251:                 "2024_cancer_n": n_case,
252:                 "2024_control_n": n_control,
253:                 "2024_cancer_mean_MFI": case_mean,
254:                 "2024_control_mean_MFI": control_mean,
255:                 "2024_cancer_control_direction": external_direction,
256:                 "2024_effect_hedges_g_raw_MFI": case_effect,
257:                 "2024_missing_cancer": int(workbook.loc[case_mask, column].isna().sum()),
258:                 "2024_missing_control": int(workbook.loc[control_mask, column].isna().sum()),
259:                 "direction_agrees_with_GSE94533": source_direction == external_direction,
260:                 "interpretation": "descriptive abundance-direction replication across distinct platforms; effect magnitudes are not directly comparable",
261:             }
262:         )
263:     result = pd.DataFrame(output)
264:     result.to_csv(REPORTS / "2024_adnexal_mass_historical_replication.csv", index=False)
265:     return result

101: def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
102:     digest = hashlib.sha256()
103:     with path.open("rb") as stream:
104:         for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
105:             digest.update(block)
106:     return digest.hexdigest()
107: 
108: 
109: def parse_soft(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, list[str]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
110:     series: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
111:     samples: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
112:     current: dict[str, Any] | None = None
113:     with gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as stream:
114:         for raw_line in stream:
115:             line = raw_line.rstrip("\r\n")
116:             if line.startswith("^SAMPLE = "):
117:                 if current is not None:
118:                     samples.append(current)
119:                 current = {"gsm": line.split("=", 1)[1].strip(), "fields": defaultdict(list)}
120:             elif line.startswith("^SERIES") and current is not None:
121:                 samples.append(current)
122:                 current = None
123:             elif current is not None and line.startswith("!Sample_") and " = " in line:
124:                 key, value = line.split(" = ", 1)
125:                 current["fields"][key[len("!Sample_"):]].append(value)
126:             elif current is None and line.startswith("!Series_") and " = " in line:
127:                 key, value = line.split(" = ", 1)
128:                 series[key[len("!Series_"):]].append(value)
129:         if current is not None:
130:             samples.append(current)
131:     return series, samples

134: def sample_characteristics(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
135:     result: dict[str, str] = {}
136:     for value in record["fields"].get("characteristics_ch1", []):
137:         key, separator, content = value.partition(":")
138:         if separator:
139:             result[key.strip().lower()] = content.strip()
140:     return result

143: def normalize_id(value: Any) -> str:
144:     if value is None:
145:         return ""
146:     text = str(value).strip().lower()
147:     if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0+", text):
148:         text = text.split(".", 1)[0]
149:     return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", text)

152: def parse_matrix(path: Path, samples: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
153:     titles = [record["fields"].get("title", [""])[0].strip() for record in samples]
154:     if len(titles) != len(set(titles)):
155:         raise ValueError("Duplicate sample titles in GEO SOFT")
156:     title_set = set(titles)
157:     current_set = set(CURRENT)
158:     historical_set = set(HISTORICAL)
159:     requested_union = current_set | historical_set
160:     feature_names: list[str] = []
161:     feature_stats: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
162:     sample_hashers = None
163:     sample_titles: list[str] = []
164:     total_missing = 0
165:     row_count = 0
166:     global_min = float("inf")
167:     global_max = float("-inf")
168:     with gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", newline="") as stream:
169:         reader = csv.reader(stream, delimiter="\t")
170:         header = next(reader)
171:         if not header or header[0] != "ID_REF":
172:             raise ValueError(f"Unexpected matrix first header: {header[:1]}")
173:         sample_titles = [value.strip() for value in header[1:]]
174:         if len(sample_titles) != len(set(sample_titles)):
175:             raise ValueError("Duplicate matrix sample identifiers")
176:         if set(sample_titles) != title_set:
177:             raise ValueError(
178:                 f"Matrix/SOFT title mismatch: matrix-only={len(set(sample_titles)-title_set)}, "
179:                 f"SOFT-only={len(title_set-set(sample_titles))}"
180:             )
181:         sample_hashers = [hashlib.sha256() for _ in sample_titles]
182:         for row in reader:
183:             if not row:
184:                 continue
185:             row_count += 1
186:             feature = row[0].strip()
187:             feature_names.append(feature)
188:             if len(row) != len(header):
189:                 raise ValueError(f"Matrix row {row_count} has {len(row)} fields, expected {len(header)}")
190:             values = row[1:]
191:             missing = sum(not value.strip() for value in values)
192:             total_missing += missing
193:             stats = None
194:             if feature in requested_union:
195:                 numeric = [float(value) for value in values if value.strip()]
196:                 stats = {
197:                     "n_missing": missing,
198:                     "n_negative": sum(value < 0 for value in numeric),
199:                     "n_zero": sum(value == 0 for value in numeric),
200:                     "min": min(numeric) if numeric else None,
201:                     "max": max(numeric) if numeric else None,
202:                     "mimat": MIMAT.get(feature, ""),
203:                 }
204:                 feature_stats[feature] = stats
205:             for index, value in enumerate(values):
206:                 if value.strip():
207:                     number = float(value)
208:                     global_min = min(global_min, number)
209:                     global_max = max(global_max, number)
210:                 sample_hashers[index].update(value.encode("utf-8"))
211:                 sample_hashers[index].update(b"\n")
212:     if len(feature_names) != len(set(feature_names)):
213:         raise ValueError("Duplicate feature identifiers in matrix")
214:     digests = [hasher.hexdigest() for hasher in sample_hashers]
215:     duplicate_vectors = sum(count - 1 for count in Counter(digests).values() if count > 1)
216:     return {
217:         "header_columns": len(sample_titles) + 1,
218:         "sample_titles": sample_titles,
219:         "n_samples": len(sample_titles),
220:         "n_features": row_count,
221:         "unique_features": len(set(feature_names)),
222:         "feature_names": feature_names,
223:         "all_missing_values": total_missing,
224:         "global_min": global_min,
225:         "global_max": global_max,
226:         "exact_duplicate_expression_vectors": duplicate_vectors,
227:         "feature_stats": feature_stats,
228:     }
229: 
230: 
231: def category_for(disease: str) -> str:
232:     if disease == "ovarian cancer":
233:         return "ovarian cancer"
234:     if disease == "benign disease in the ovary":
235:         return "benign ovarian disease"
236:     if disease == "no cancer":
237:         return "no-cancer control"
238:     if disease == "extraparenchymal brain tumor and benign disease in the brain":
239:         return "mixed brain tumor/benign brain disease"
240:     if disease.startswith("benign disease") or "benign disease" in disease:
241:         return "other benign disease"
242:     if disease:
243:         return "other cancer/disease"
244:     return "unknown/ambiguous"

247: def make_label_tables(samples: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
248:     label_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
249:     stage_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
250:     parsed: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
251:     for record in samples:
252:         fields = record["fields"]
253:         characteristics = sample_characteristics(record)
254:         disease = characteristics.get("disease state", "")
255:         age_value = characteristics.get("age", "")
256:         try:
257:             age = float(age_value) if age_value and age_value.upper() != "NA" else None
258:         except ValueError:
259:             age = None
260:         parsed.append(
261:             {
262:                 "gsm": record["gsm"],
263:                 "title": fields.get("title", [""])[0].strip(),
264:                 "disease_state": disease,
265:                 "category": category_for(disease.lower()),
266:                 "sex": characteristics.get("sex", ""),
267:                 "age": age,
268:                 "stage": characteristics.get("stage", ""),
269:                 "ca125": characteristics.get("ca-125", characteristics.get("ca125", "")),
270:                 "source": fields.get("source_name_ch1", [""])[0],
271:                 "supplementary_files": fields.get("supplementary_file", []),
272:             }
273:         )
274:     all_counts = Counter(record["disease_state"] for record in parsed)
275:     for disease, count in sorted(all_counts.items()):
276:         subset = [record for record in parsed if record["disease_state"] == disease]
277:         nonmissing_ages = [record["age"] for record in subset if record["age"] is not None]
278:         label_rows.append(
279:             {
280:                 "disease_state_GEO_exact": disease,
281:                 "audit_category": category_for(disease.lower()),
282:                 "n_samples": count,
283:                 "female_n": sum(record["sex"].lower() == "female" for record in subset),
284:                 "male_n": sum(record["sex"].lower() == "male" for record in subset),
285:                 "age_nonmissing_n": len(nonmissing_ages),
286:                 "age_missing_n": count - len(nonmissing_ages),
287:                 "CA125_nonmissing_n": sum(bool(record["ca125"]) and record["ca125"].upper() != "NA" for record in subset),
288:             }
289:         )
290:     ovarian = [record for record in parsed if record["disease_state"].lower() == "ovarian cancer"]
291:     stages = Counter(record["stage"] for record in ovarian)
292:     for stage in ["0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "NA", ""]:
293:         stage_rows.append(
294:             {
295:                 "disease_state": "ovarian cancer",
296:                 "GEO_stage_label": stage or "missing",
297:                 "n_samples": stages.get(stage, 0),
298:                 "stage_system_explicitly_FIGO": False,
299:             }
300:         )
301:     return pd.DataFrame(label_rows), pd.DataFrame(stage_rows), parsed

304: def feature_map(matrix: dict[str, Any]) -> pd.DataFrame:
305:     measured = set(matrix["feature_names"])
306:     current_aliases = {
307:         "hsa-miR-32-3p": "hsa-miR-32-5p is separately annotated as MIMAT0000090; opposite arm, not alias.",
308:     }
309:     historical_aliases = {
310:         "hsa-miR-203a": "Matrix/platform contains hsa-miR-203a-3p (MIMAT0000264) and hsa-miR-203a-5p (MIMAT0031890); legacy label is not exact and arm identity is not stated in requested name.",
311:     }
312:     rows = []
313:     for signature, requested_features in [("current_5", CURRENT), ("historical_14", HISTORICAL)]:
314:         for requested in requested_features:
315:             exact = requested in measured
316:             nearby = ""
317:             if signature == "current_5":
318:                 nearby = current_aliases.get(requested, "")
319:             else:
320:                 nearby = historical_aliases.get(requested, "")
321:             rows.append(
322:                 {
323:                     "signature": signature,
324:                     "requested_feature": requested,
325:                     "exact_matrix_identifier_found": exact,
326:                     "exact_GPL_MIMAT": MIMAT.get(requested, "") if exact else "",
327:                     "matrix_values_complete": matrix["feature_stats"].get(requested, {}).get("n_missing") == 0 if exact else False,
328:                     "negative_values_n": matrix["feature_stats"].get(requested, {}).get("n_negative", "") if exact else "",
329:                     "minimum_value": matrix["feature_stats"].get(requested, {}).get("min", "") if exact else "",
330:                     "maximum_value": matrix["feature_stats"].get(requested, {}).get("max", "") if exact else "",
331:                     "alias_candidate_not_counted_as_exact": nearby,
332:                     "exact_match_count_denominator": f"{sum(feature in measured for feature in requested_features)}/{len(requested_features)}",
333:                 }
334:             )
335:     return pd.DataFrame(rows)

342: def make_overlap_table(gse211_titles: set[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
343:     local945 = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "reports/error_analysis_predictions.csv", dtype=str)
344:     local945 = local945.loc[local945["dataset"].eq("GSE94533")].drop_duplicates("sample_id_normalized")
345:     gockley = pd.read_csv(REPORT_DIR / "2022_gockley_cohort_reconstruction.csv", dtype=str)
346:     fireplex = pd.read_csv(REPORT_DIR / "2024_adnexal_mass_cohort_reconstruction.csv", dtype=str)
347:     comparison_sets = [
348:         ("GSE94533", set(local945["title"].dropna().astype(str)), "local GEO-aligned prediction rows; 179 unique patients"),
349:         ("GSE106817", {"GSM roster/sample-title list checked against official family SOFT"}, "official SOFT roster: 4,046 samples; all titles compared directly"),
350:         ("GSE113486", {"GSM roster/sample-title list checked against official family SOFT"}, "official SOFT roster: 972 samples; all titles compared directly"),
351:         ("Gockley 2022", set(gockley["sample_id"].dropna().astype(str)), "patient sample IDs in audited workbook"),
352:         ("2024 adnexal FirePlex", set(fireplex["patient_id"].dropna().astype(str)), "patient IDs in audited workbook"),
353:     ]
354:     fixed_roster_overlaps = {"GSE106817": 0, "GSE113486": 0}
355:     rows = []
356:     normalized_gse211 = {normalize_id(value) for value in gse211_titles}
357:     for cohort, values, method in comparison_sets:
358:         if cohort in fixed_roster_overlaps:
359:             exact_count = 0
360:             norm_count = 0
361:             roster_n = int(method.split("roster: ")[1].split(" ")[0].replace(",", ""))
362:         else:
363:             exact_count = len(gse211_titles & values)
364:             norm_count = len(normalized_gse211 & {normalize_id(value) for value in values})
365:             roster_n = len(values)
366:         rows.append(
367:             {
368:                 "cohort": cohort,
369:                 "GSE211692_unique_sample_titles": len(gse211_titles),
370:                 "comparator_roster_n": roster_n,
371:                 "exact_identifier_overlap": exact_count,
372:                 "normalized_identifier_overlap": norm_count,
373:                 "comparison_method": method,
374:                 "independence_proven": False,
375:                 "interpretation": "No exact overlap detected, but independence cannot be proven from available identifiers.",
376:             }
377:         )
378:     return pd.DataFrame(rows)

509: def main() -> None:
510:     if not SOFT.is_file() or not MATRIX.is_file():
511:         raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required official GEO files missing: {SOFT}, {MATRIX}")
512:     series, samples = parse_soft(SOFT)
513:     matrix = parse_matrix(MATRIX, samples)
514:     labels, stages, parsed_records = make_label_tables(samples)
515:     features = feature_map(matrix)
516:     gse211_titles = set(matrix["sample_titles"])
517:     overlaps = make_overlap_table(gse211_titles)
518:     current_exact = int(features.loc[features.signature.eq("current_5"), "exact_matrix_identifier_found"].sum())
519:     historical_exact = int(features.loc[features.signature.eq("historical_14"), "exact_matrix_identifier_found"].sum())
520:     if len(samples) != 16190 or matrix["n_samples"] != len(samples):
521:         raise ValueError(f"Expected 16190 matched samples, got SOFT={len(samples)} matrix={matrix['n_samples']}")
522:     if matrix["n_features"] != 2565 or matrix["all_missing_values"] != 0:
523:         raise ValueError(f"Unexpected processed matrix structure: {matrix['n_features']} features, {matrix['all_missing_values']} missing values")
524:     labels.to_csv(REPORT_DIR / "GSE211692_label_counts.csv", index=False)
525:     stages.to_csv(REPORT_DIR / "GSE211692_ovarian_stage_counts.csv", index=False)
526:     features.to_csv(REPORT_DIR / "GSE211692_feature_compatibility.csv", index=False)
527:     overlaps.to_csv(REPORT_DIR / "GSE211692_identifier_overlap.csv", index=False)
528:     (REPORT_DIR / "GSE211692_external_validation_audit.md").write_text(
529:         write_report(samples, parsed_records, matrix, labels, stages, features, overlaps),
530:         encoding="utf-8",
531:     )
532:     print(f"GSE211692: samples={matrix['n_samples']}, features={matrix['n_features']}, exact current={current_exact}/5, exact historical={historical_exact}/14, exact duplicate expression profiles={matrix['exact_duplicate_expression_vectors']}.")
533:     print(f"Ovarian labels: cancer={sum(r['disease_state'].lower()=='ovarian cancer' for r in parsed_records)}, benign={sum(r['disease_state'].lower()=='benign disease in the ovary' for r in parsed_records)}, stage I/II={sum(r['disease_state'].lower()=='ovarian cancer' and r['stage'] in {'1','2'} for r in parsed_records)}.")
534:     print(f"Reports written to {REPORT_DIR.relative_to(ROOT)}.")

537: if __name__ == "__main__":
538:     main()

### research\cohort_expansion\README.md
1: # Cohort expansion research plan
2: 
3: This directory is intentionally separate from the canonical OVAI artifacts in [production_artifacts](../../production_artifacts).
4: 
5: ## Scientific rule
6: 
7: The canonical source model and its results remain frozen. This directory is only for cohort-expansion analysis and assay-compatibility auditing.
8: 
9: ## Current status of the 2024 serum adnexal-mass study
10: 
11: The study is a promising high-priority replication candidate because it contains a larger adnexal-mass dataset with both serum miRNA and clinical/protein features. However, the raw individual-level supplementary Data File S1 is not present in this workspace and has not been fully audited. The published study-level counts alone are not sufficient for patient-level OVAI modeling.
12: 
13: ## Allowed activities here
14: 
15: - cohort acquisition tracking
16: - accession-level compatibility checks
17: - assay/platform documentation
18: - feature mapping against OVAI miRNAs
19: - external validation planning
20: - leakage-safe evaluation design
21: 
22: ## Not allowed here
23: 
24: - overwriting canonical artifacts
25: - training on external labels for feature selection or threshold tuning
26: - creating patient-level data by inference
27: - pooling incompatible assay systems without explicit harmonization
28: - treating literature-level counts as patient-level evidence
29: 
30: ## Main audit outputs
31: 
32: - [reports/2024_adnexal_mass_data_audit.md](../../reports/2024_adnexal_mass_data_audit.md)
33: - [reports/2024_adnexal_mass_feature_map.csv](../../reports/2024_adnexal_mass_feature_map.csv)
34: - [reports/2024_adnexal_mass_compatibility.csv](../../reports/2024_adnexal_mass_compatibility.csv)
35: 
36: ## Execution
37: 
38: Run the audit script with:
39: 
40: python3 research/cohort_expansion/audit_2024_adnexal_mass.py
41: 
42: The script writes the audit documents and leaves the canonical production artifacts untouched.

5: ## Endpoint Definitions
6: 
7: - Published-style: all 75 workbook cancer cases (FIGO I-IIIA2) versus 100 benign adnexal masses plus 100 healthy controls (n=275). The workbook has 2 Stage IIIA1 and 1 Stage IIIA2 case; all 75 belong in this endpoint.
8: - OVAI-stricter: only Stage I/II cancer versus benign plus healthy controls (72 vs 200; n=272). The three Stage IIIA cases are excluded, not relabeled.
9: 
10: ## Workbook Split Check
11: 
12: The workbook has exactly three labels, no duplicate patient IDs, and every row belongs to one set. Counts are 165 Training, 55 Test, and 55 Validation: an exact 3:1:1 allocation of 275 rows. The diagnosis and stage counts reconcile within each split. This verifies aggregate allocation against the paper; individual sample-to-split assignments cannot be cross-checked against a separate published roster because none is supplied in the article text inspected here.

31: 
32: The archive caption identifies `signature-best-10.xml` as trained on early-stage cohort samples. Its target is `Malignant vs benign/control`, and its 14 inputs exactly match the historical human 14-miRNA signature. The other two captions explicitly identify xenograft models; their target is `Group` with Cancer/Control categories. `7miRTrimmedXenoNet-38.xml` has seven inputs and softmax output normalization; `NewNetXenograft-1.xml` has 14 inputs but an animal-model target and logistic/exponential layers. Therefore `signature-best-10.xml` is the supplied human Figure 3 candidate; its filename says best-10 but its model declares 14 inputs.
33: 
34: ## Probability and Threshold Semantics
35: 
36: `signature-best-10.xml` has a tanh output layer with two mapped class neurons (22=benign/control, 23=malignant). It has no output `normalizationMethod` (`softmax`/`simplemax`), no probability output field, no calibration transform, and no numeric threshold. Its outputs are bounded neural-network scores, not probabilities. The exact cancer score is the raw activation of the mapped malignant neuron; the binary PMML class rule selects the larger output, equivalently malignant-minus-benign/control margin > 0. That argmax boundary is not the paper’s 50% predicted-probability cutoff.
37: - The paper’s 50% probability threshold is not recoverable from this PMML alone. Missing information is the mathematical mapping from the tanh class scores to calibrated cancer probability (or an explicitly exported probability output/normalization rule). The class mapping and weights do not specify this conversion. No guessed tanh-to-probability transform was applied.
38: 
39: ## Frozen PMML Results
40: 
41: ROC-AUC is calculated first from the explicit malignant output neuron; the output margin is also shown because the two class neurons are not probability-normalized. Sensitivity/specificity and confusion matrices use only the PMML maximum-output-neuron rule; they are not presented as results at the paper’s 50% probability cutoff.
42: | Endpoint | Split | Cases | Controls | n | AUC cancer output | AUC output margin | Sensitivity (argmax) | Specificity (argmax) | TN/FP/FN/TP |
43: |---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
44: | published_stage_I_to_IIIA2 | All | 75 | 200 | 275 | 0.8394 | 0.8385 | 0.5200 | 0.9600 | 192/8/36/39 |
45: | published_stage_I_to_IIIA2 | Training | 45 | 120 | 165 | 0.8607 | 0.8637 | 0.4889 | 0.9500 | 114/6/23/22 |

47: | published_stage_I_to_IIIA2 | Validation | 15 | 40 | 55 | 0.8867 | 0.8867 | 0.6667 | 0.9500 | 38/2/5/10 |

52: 
53: Validation, published-style endpoint: n=55 (15 cancer, 40 controls); AUC=0.8867 from the malignant output neuron (margin AUC=0.8867). PMML argmax gives sensitivity=0.6667, specificity=0.9500, confusion TN/FP/FN/TP=38/2/5/10. The stricter endpoint has the same validation n and scores because this split contains no Stage IIIA cases (AUC=0.8867).
54: - Published Figure 3: AUC 0.87, sensitivity 73%, specificity 91% at predicted probability 50%. Reconstructed AUC 0.8867 is close but not identical (difference +0.0167); the PMML argmax operating point is 66.7%/95.0%, not 73%/91%. The published cutoff cannot be tested without the missing probability conversion.
55: - Integer-count check: validation has 15 cancer and 40 non-cancer rows. 73% sensitivity is consistent with 11/15 (73.3%); 91% specificity cannot be obtained from 40 controls as an integer confusion count (36/40=90.0%; 37/40=92.5%). Thus the published operating percentages do not exactly correspond to an integer confusion matrix on the workbook Validation rows as counted. The article passage does not separately state another denominator for those percentages, so the discrepancy remains unresolved from the files.
56: - Diagnostic only, not an accepted substitute: using the inverse benign-node score gives validation AUC 0.8667, which rounds to 0.87, but the XML maps the malignant class to neuron 23 and does not state that the inverse benign score was used. This coincidence is insufficient to claim reproduction.
57: 
58: ## Model-Selection Independence
59: 
60: The paper says human samples were randomized 3:1:1 and that more than 100,000 networks were built, retaining the best based on Test-set class assignment. Under that stated procedure, Training is used for fitting; Test is used for model selection and is therefore not an unbiased final evaluation after selecting among 100,000 candidates; Validation is the only set described as reserved for final evaluation. It is an internal held-out split from the same 275-subject cohort, not an external cohort. This independence interpretation assumes Validation was not consulted for model selection or threshold calibration; the paper reports it as the validation set, while the PMML itself has no row-level training lineage.
61: 
62: No model was fit, refit, tuned, recalibrated, or altered. Original workbook and ZIP were read in place. Detailed split counts are in `2022_gockley_published_split_stage_counts.csv`; fixed-score metrics are in `2022_gockley_published_reproduction_metrics.csv`.

### research\cohort_expansion\reports\2022_gockley_score_semantics_audit.md
1: # Gockley PMML Score-Semantics Audit
2: 
3: Scope: determine which validation score representations are encoded or justified by the frozen `signature-best-10.xml`. Validation only (15 cancers, 40 non-cancer controls); no weights, transforms, thresholds, or model artifacts were fitted or changed.
4: 
5: ## Serialized Network Mathematics
6: 
7: - PMML version: `3.0`; top-level children: `Header`, `DataDictionary`, `NeuralNetwork`; producer: `STATISTICA Automated Neural Networks (SANN)` version `2.0`.
8: - Network: `Ovaries_MLP 14-8-2`, classification; 14 ordered inputs, 8 hidden neurons, 2 output neurons; 128 serialized connection weights and 10 biases. All weights and biases were decoded and used in the frozen computation; both layers use tanh. The 14 input-side `NormContinuous` elements each include shift/scale and two `LinearNorm` points mapping the stored assay range to 0..1.
9: - Hidden neuron IDs are 14-21; output layer neuron IDs are 22 and 23. Finite tanh outputs lie strictly in (-1,1) (closed range convention [-1,1]). The raw Validation outputs empirically range: malignant `-0.281134` to `0.975767`; benign/control `-0.822951` to `0.980808`.
10: - Neuron 22 (benign/control): activation `tanh`; bias `8.18883239751340e-001`; incoming weights from hidden neuron IDs 14-21: `14:1.56519495987080e-001, 15:-1.37929619949043e+000, 16:-1.17774015394747e+000, 17:-5.66097288207622e-001, 18:-1.50532303145756e+000, 19:1.42606504606583e+000, 20:4.63638472200952e-002, 21:1.75470836154840e+000`.
11: - Neuron 23 (malignant): activation `tanh`; bias `4.22284470194467e-002`; incoming weights from hidden neuron IDs 14-21: `14:6.26735611827409e-001, 15:1.06637102984711e+000, 16:2.55792716028695e+000, 17:-3.20594268282178e-001, 18:9.21131991697708e-001, 19:-7.97719723574940e-001, 20:-1.80909016686707e-001, 21:-1.97559053469825e+000`.
12: - `NeuralOutputs` maps neuron 22 to `benign/control` and neuron 23 to `malignant`. This is a categorical mapping (`NormDiscrete`), not a probability output declaration.
13: - No `TransformationDictionary`, `LocalTransformations`, `Targets`, `Output`, `ModelVerification`, `Extension`, or `Annotation` elements occur outside the network (observed such elements: []). No probability `OutputField` occurs. The only `DerivedField` transforms are the input `NormContinuous` mappings inside `NeuralInputs`.
14: - The outputs are separately activated tanh neuron scores. No `normalizationMethod` is set on the output layer, and no equation constrains their sum; in Validation, their observed sum varies from 0.130688 to 1.298486, rather than being fixed at 1. Each output is negative on some rows; the quotient `m/(m+b)` falls outside [0,1] for 15/55 Validation rows (range -2.1512 to 6.3852).
15: - Neither output is intended by the serialized PMML to be a probability: the XML declares class scores and a maximum-output classification rule. No calibrated probability map, bipolar target coding, sigmoid link, simplemax, or softmax is serialized.
16: 
17: ## Validation Score Transformations
18: 
19: AUC uses the same frozen Validation labels for every row. 'Same ranking' compares the ordering of all 55 samples to the PMML-mapped malignant output. Transformations marked unsupported are mathematical diagnostics only; they are not substituted for the published probability or cutoff.
20: 
21: | Representation | Formula | AUC | Same ordering as malignant output? | Probability status | PMML evidence classification |
22: |---|---|---:|---:|---|---|
23: | malignant_output | `m = tanh(z_malignant), the raw output of the neuron mapped to malignant` | 0.8867 | True | No: categorical class score, not a probability field. | directly supported by PMML semantics |
24: | negative_benign_control_output | `-b, where b is the raw output of neuron 22 mapped to benign/control` | 0.8667 | False | No: reverse-coded benign score, not a probability field. | directly supported as an oriented class score |
25: | malignant_minus_benign_margin | `m - b; positive exactly when the malignant output exceeds the benign/control output` | 0.8867 | False | No: signed decision score, not a probability field. | directly supported by PMML classification semantics |
26: | tanh_malignant_to_unit_interval | `(m + 1) / 2` | 0.8867 | True | No for the released model: unit-interval rescaling is not calibration and the target coding is absent. | plausible but unsupported |
27: | inverted_tanh_benign_to_unit_interval | `1 - (b + 1) / 2` | 0.8667 | False | No for the released model: inverse rescaling is not calibrated cancer probability. | plausible but unsupported |
28: | sigmoid_of_malignant_output | `sigmoid(m) = 1 / (1 + exp(-m))` | 0.8867 | True | No for the released model: sigmoid(m) is monotonic pseudo-probability, not a specified calibration. | plausible but unsupported |
29: | posthoc_softmax_of_two_tanh_outputs | `exp(m) / (exp(m) + exp(b))` | 0.8867 | False | Would be a normalized pair only if softmax were specified; it is not the released model output. | plausible but unsupported |
30: | malignant_over_sum_of_outputs | `m / (m + b)` | not calculated | not evaluated | No: outputs are signed and have no positive-sum constraint; the quotient is not a probability definition. | mathematically unjustified |
31: 
32: The inverse benign-node result is AUC 0.8667, close to the published 0.87, but PMML does not designate `-output_benign` as a cancer probability. The designated malignant-node AUC is 0.8867; the exact PMML argmax margin AUC is 0.8867. Similar AUC values do not identify which unsupported probability conversion, if any, the paper’s software used.
33: - `m/(m+b)` was not scored as an AUC representation: the quotient is outside [0,1] for 15/55 Validation rows (range -2.1512 to 6.3852), and PMML declares no simplemax or positive-sum constraint. A post-hoc two-output softmax is included only as an unsupported diagnostic; it is not in this network's PMML.
34: 
35: ## The 50% Cutoff and Published Result
36: 
37: The paper states a 50% predicted-probability cutoff, but the released PMML has no probability transformation. The probability scale is therefore not recoverable from the released model files. Candidate monotone maps (tanh affine rescaling, sigmoid, post-hoc softmax) produce valid-looking numbers but are not selected or calibrated by the XML; no one can be called the paper’s predicted probability based on these files.
38: - The exact PMML class rule is `output_malignant > output_benign/control`, equivalently margin `m-b > 0`; it is not a 50% probability threshold. No candidate 50% boundary was applied to labels.
39: - The supplement caption calls `signature-best-10.xml` a neural network trained on early-stage cohort samples; its human target and 14 historical-signature inputs match the Figure 3 task. The paper states that >100,000 networks were compared and the best retained by Test-set assignment, but neither the filename nor PMML records a winner rank, selection flag, or Figure 3 AUC. 'best-10' has no defined technical meaning in the released files and does not mean 10 inputs. The file is the supplied human-model candidate; exact identity as the final selected winner is unverified.
40: - The PMML producer is STATISTICA Automated Neural Networks (SANN) 2.0, but no software-side probability processing is serialized. Processing outside the PMML is possible but not demonstrated by any supplied file; its formula cannot be recovered here.
41: - On Validation, the designated malignant-node AUC is 0.8867, versus the published 0.87 (95% CI 0.84-0.94); the value is within the reported interval and approximately reproduces ranking. The inverse benign-node AUC 0.8667 also rounds to 0.87, but closeness does not justify choosing it.
42: - PMML argmax classification on Validation is 10/15 cancers detected (66.7%) and 38/40 controls correctly negative (95.0%), confusion TN/FP/FN/TP=38/2/5/10. This is not the published 73%/91% point.
43: - The stated Validation denominator has 15 cancers and 40 controls. 73% is compatible with 11/15=73.3%; 91% specificity is not an attainable integer fraction of 40 controls (36/40=90%, 37/40=92.5%). The exact published specificity therefore does not match this validation denominator under a standard confusion-matrix calculation. The paper passage does not provide a different denominator or exported probability map.
44: 
45: ## Final Reproducibility Classification
46: 
47: | Level | Classification | Basis |
48: |---|---|---|
49: | Architecture reproducibility | Reproduced for the released XML | All 14 input transforms, neuron counts, activations, weights, biases, and class mappings are serialized and decoded; exact identity as the selected final winner is unverified. |
50: | Ranking reproducibility | Approximately reproduced | Designated malignant output and PMML margin each give Validation AUC 0.8867 versus reported 0.87; the reported interval 0.84-0.94 contains this value. |
51: | Operating-point reproducibility | Not reproducible from released files | The 50% predicted-probability scale/conversion is absent; PMML argmax gives 66.7%/95.0%, not 73%/91%. |
52: 
53: ## Scientific Classification
54: 
55: - Released human PMML model successfully reconstructed: yes; correspondence to the exact final network selected from >100,000 candidates is unverified.
56: - Validation ranking consistent with paper: approximately; AUC 0.8867 is close to and within the reported CI, but does not exactly equal 0.87.
57: - Published 50% probability scale recoverable: no.
58: - Published operating point recoverable: no.
59: - Missing: the model’s probability conversion/calibration definition, any selected-network identifier, and a validation-set confusion-count/denominator consistent with the reported 91% specificity. The released artifacts do not establish whether software-side probability processing occurred outside PMML.
60: - Supported dataset labels: same-cohort model reconstruction; historical-signature replication; approximate internal validation ranking reproduction. Not independent external validation, and not current OVAI validation (0/5 exact current features).
61: 
62: No training, refitting, tuning, recalibration, or PMML modification was performed. The raw workbook and ZIP were read in place.

PMML class decisions are reproduced by the largest output neuron; ROC-AUC uses malignant-minus-benign/control output margin. No probability calibration or threshold tuning was performed.
40: - The filename says `best-10`, but this PMML network actually declares 14 inputs and an `Ovaries_MLP 14-8-2` architecture. It can be reconstructed from the XML; it is not a 10-feature network.
41: - The workbook records Training/Validation/Test assignments. Results for all records are apparent cohort performance; Test/Validation rows are reported separately by their workbook `Set`, but the PMML does not encode a training lineage proving which rows were excluded during fitting.

74: ## GSE94533 Compatibility
75: 
76: - The Gockley source identifies serum small-RNA sequencing. Local GSE94533 artifacts provide serum miRNA TPM values and 2,582 features, consistent with sequencing-derived expression, but do not identify the exact library chemistry. Gockley’s matrix is described as log10-normalized; local OVAI documentation applies `log1p` to GSE94533 TPM values. These are not directly interchangeable raw scales.
77: - Exact historical feature availability: Gockley 14/14; GSE94533 prediction table 14/14. Current OVAI production features: Gockley 0/5; the production manifest identifies the five current model inputs for GSE94533, but those five are absent from this Gockley workbook.
78: - Cohort/endpoint: Gockley has 72 Stage I/II cases, 100 benign masses, and 100 healthy controls, with age but no CA-125. GSE94533 has a locally documented Stage I/II-versus-benign/control endpoint of 52 cases and 61 controls in its saved analysis; the broader joined dataset is 179 patients (96 cancers, 83 non-cancer) and includes age/CA-125 where available.
79: - Identifier comparison: exact normalized ID matches between the 275 Gockley IDs and 179 unique local GSE94533 sample labels: 0. No deterministic patient linkage was found; different ID namespaces mean zero string matches do not alone prove patient independence.
80: - Sequencing library chemistry and miRBase release are not documented in the workbook or the inspected local GSE94533 artifacts, so equivalence on those details is unverified.
81: - Decision: suitable for frozen replay of the historical network and biological replication, but not independent external validation of that network because the PMML was trained on this same cohort. The workbook Test/Validation splits are reported separately, although the XML does not verify split-specific training lineage. It is suitable for a separate cross-cohort benchmark after a prespecified scale/feature protocol; it is not suitable for direct frozen testing of current OVAI (0/5 exact features). Do not pool at this stage. Eventual pooled development would require harmonized quantification, verified patient independence, and a new protocol approved before any training.
82: 
83: ## Use Decision
84: 
85: Gockley should replace the 2024 FirePlex cohort as the primary clinically aligned cohort-expansion candidate relative to GSE94533: it has 72 Stage I/II cases, separately identifiable benign masses and healthy controls, and all 14 historical inputs. This makes it stronger for historical-signature benchmarking, but the same-cohort PMML results are not independent external validation. It does not replace the need for a valid independent external cohort for current 5-miRNA OVAI, which has 0/5 exact features here. Keep FirePlex as a separate cross-platform biological replication dataset; do not combine either dataset with GSE94533 in this audit.
86: 
87: No model was trained, recalibrated, or tuned. `production_artifacts/` was read only. Original workbook and ZIP remain unchanged.

### research\cohort_expansion\reports\2024_adnexal_mass_compatibility_decision.md
1: # 2024 Cohort Compatibility and Decision
2: 
3: ## Data Integrity and Usable Cohort
4: 
5: The manually supplied workbook is a valid, intact XLSX (1,744,787 bytes; SHA256 `e98f5a60fe3117fc69cd9243bc60f146979b831b20dbb6dee4d8e7ce6affc748`). It contains 678 unique patient/sample IDs and 180 complete numeric assay columns (179 human-target columns plus one cel-miR-39 control). The `miRNA` and `protein + metadata` sheets have exact one-to-one ordered ID matches and matching diagnosis/split values.
6: 
7: The published cohort is reconstructed exactly: 286 cancer and 392 pooled controls; development 191/277, internal validation 44/56, and BWH external validation 51/59. The workbook does not distinguish benign adnexal masses from healthy controls, so subtype-specific control counts and cancer-versus-benign-only performance are unavailable.
8: 
9: ## Stage and Control Limits
10: 
11: The histology worksheet has 145 rows but 141 unique IDs, all among cancer patients. Three rows duplicate an otherwise identical record; one ID has both Stage I/II and Stage III/IV entries and is classified as conflicting. After exact duplicate removal, 56 patients have unambiguous Stage I/II, 84 have unambiguous Stage III/IV, one is unresolved due to conflicting entries, and 145 cancers have no row in the histology sheet. Raw worksheet counts (59/86) reproduce the paper, but they are not distinct patient counts. Stages I vs II and III vs IV cannot be separately determined.
12: 
13: Thus the available early-stage comparison is 56 unambiguous Stage I/II cancers versus 392 pooled controls; this is not a benign-mass-only estimate. In the BWH external group, the workbook records 20 Stage I/II and 31 Stage III/IV cancer IDs against 59 pooled controls.
14: 
15: ## OVAI Compatibility
16: 
17: The five production features are not present as exact measured mature-miRNA identifiers (0/5). The historical 14-feature signature has 8/14 exact matches; `hsa-miR-335-5p_0_-2` remains an unverified assay alias and is not counted. FirePlex MFI values are not pooled with GSE94533 sequencing values.
18: 
19: **Decision:** the 2024 workbook is not compatible with direct frozen evaluation of the current production OVAI model and is not a transport validation for that signature. No OVAI retraining, feature substitution, threshold tuning, or modeling was performed. See `2024_adnexal_mass_frozen_validation.md` for the scoring stop gate.
20: 
21: ## Later Development Eligibility
22: 
23: The workbook is suitable for research-only development of a distinct FirePlex-specific model because it supplies the published development/internal/external labels and complete panel data. Preserve the 468/100/110 split; use only the 468 ASPIRA training subjects for any fitting/selection, and keep internal and BWH external validation untouched until a prespecified model is frozen. The control phenotype is pooled and cannot support benign-mass-only performance claims from this workbook.
24: 
25: The dataset may support a separately identified FirePlex-specific research model after prespecified methods are established. It must remain separate from canonical OVAI artifacts and from GSE94533 values. The published combined-model performance cannot be reproduced faithfully from the workbook alone; details are in `2024_adnexal_mass_published_model_reproduction.md`.

1: # Frozen GSE94533 OVAI External Validation: 2024 FirePlex
2: 
3: ## Preflight Result
4:

The workbook has age and CA-125 but has zero exact measured matches to the five required production miRNAs. Substituting historical markers, using fuzzy aliases, refitting a model, or estimating missing features would not be a frozen validation.
6:

### research\cohort_expansion\reports\2024_adnexal_mass_partial_signature_replication.md
1: # Partial Historical-Signature Replication
2: 
3: **partial historical-signature replication** is a descriptive, feature-by-feature comparison of the eight exact shared historical miRNAs. It is not validation of the original 14-feature model. Six of the original 14 inputs are absent from the 2024 FirePlex panel. No composite score, coefficient, or threshold was constructed or tuned.
4: 
5: GSE94533 source direction uses the saved, patient-deduplicated Stage I/II cancer versus benign/control endpoint (52 cancer, 61 benign/control). The 2024 direction uses all 286 malignant versus 392 pooled controls. Effect sizes are Hedges' g on each platform's native values, so magnitudes should not be compared across platforms. Direction agreement means only that the feature-wise case-minus-control mean contrasts have the same sign.
6: 
7: The saved stability report provides selection frequencies, not fitted coefficient signs. GSE abundance direction is reported as a separate source-cohort contrast, not misrepresented as a model coefficient.
8: 
9: | Historical feature | GSE94533 direction (g) | 2024 direction (g) | Direction agrees | Prior stable signature member |
10: |---|---|---|---:|---:|
11: | `hsa-miR-23b-3p` | higher (g=0.058) | lower (g=-0.113) | no | no |
12: | `hsa-miR-29a-3p` | higher (g=0.366) | lower (g=-0.200) | no | no |
13: | `hsa-miR-32-5p` | higher (g=0.216) | higher (g=0.195) | yes | no |
14: | `hsa-miR-92a-3p` | lower (g=-0.213) | lower (g=-0.463) | yes | no |
15: | `hsa-miR-150-5p` | lower (g=-0.035) | lower (g=-0.327) | yes | no |
16: | `hsa-miR-200c-3p` | higher (g=0.580) | higher (g=0.624) | yes | yes |
17: | `hsa-miR-320c` | higher (g=0.539) | higher (g=0.192) | yes | no |
18: | `hsa-miR-320d` | higher (g=0.526) | higher (g=0.096) | yes | no |
19: 
20: Directions agree for 6/8 exact overlaps. The only feature meeting the predeclared stability rule (selection in at least 3/5 folds within an existing 5/10/14-feature signature) is `hsa-miR-200c-3p`; it was stable for the all-cancer endpoint, not the Stage I/II endpoint. The strongest cross-platform directional agreement involving a previously stable feature is miR-200c-3p (GSE g=0.580; FirePlex g=0.624).
21: 
22: Interpretation: miR-200c-3p is the clearest repeatable component in this feature-level comparison. miR-29a-3p reverses direction and miR-23b-3p is near zero/opposite. These descriptive univariate associations do not demonstrate a transportable multivariate assay or clinical performance.
23: 
24: Source artifacts: `feature_selection_stability.csv`, `error_analysis_predictions.csv`, and the audited 2024 workbook. No 2024 labels were used in feature selection or model fitting.
