924:             "neurons"

926:

948: 
949:             for conn in neuron[
950:                 "connections"
951:             ]:
952:

1010:         "derived_fields"

1012: 
1013:         lines.append(
1014:             f"\n{derived['name']}"
1015:         )
1016: 
1017:         lines.append(

1020:                     "expression"

1029:

1031:     lines.append(

### scripts\build_fair_historical_14mirna_baseline.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: """
4: FAIR MODERN 14-miRNA BASELINE
5: 
6: Uses EXACTLY the same historical cohort and Dataset 2 representation
7: used by the reproduced eLife PMML model.
8: 
9: Historical cohort:
10:     179 patients
11:     97 cancer
12:     82 non-cancer
13: 
14: Representation:
15:     eLife Supplementary Dataset 2
16:     batch-adjusted
17:     log10-transformed
18: 
19: Features:
20:     exact 14 PMML miRNAs
21: 
22: Model:
23:     standardized L2 logistic regression
24: 
25: Evaluation:
26:     5-fold stratified patient-level OOF predictions
27: 
28: This is a NEW model.
29: It does NOT use the historical PMML weights.
30: """
31: 
32: from __future__ import annotations
33: 
34: import json
35: from pathlib import Path
36: 
37: import numpy as np
38: import pandas as pd

41: from sklearn.metrics import (

47: from sklearn.model_selection import (

51: from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

53:

55: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
56: 
57: SUPPLEMENTARY_XLSX = (
58:     ROOT
59:     / "data"

66:     ROOT

79:     OUTPUT_DIR

85:     / "fair_historical_14mirna_baseline_results.json"

88: 
89: FEATURES = [
90:     "hsa-miR-23b-3p",
91:     "hsa-miR-29a-3p",
92:     "hsa-miR-32-5p",
93:     "hsa-miR-92a-3p",

99:     "hsa-miR-320d",
100:     "hsa-miR-335-5p",
101:     "hsa-miR-450b-5p",
102:     "hsa-miR-1246",
103:     "hsa-miR-1307-5p",
104: ]
105: 
106: 
107: def norm_id(value):
108: 
109:     s = str(value).strip().lower()
110: 
111:     if s.endswith(".0") and s[:-2].isdigit():
112:         s = s[:-2]
113: 
114:     return s.replace("-", "")
115: 
116: 
117: # =====================================================================
118: # LOAD HISTORICAL SAMPLE ORDER
119: # =====================================================================
120: 
121: print("=" * 90)
122: print("FAIR HISTORICAL 14-miRNA MODERN BASELINE")
123: print("=" * 90)
124: 
125: print()
126: print("Loading historical PMML prediction file...")
127: 
128: pred = pd.read_csv(PREDICTIONS_PATH)
129: 
130: if len(pred) != 179:
131:     raise RuntimeError(
132:         f"Expected 179 historical patients, found {len(pred)}."
133:     )
134: 
135: pred["sample_key"] = pred["sample_id"].map(norm_id)
136: 
137: print(
138:     f"Historical cohort: {len(pred)} patients"
139: )
140: 
141: print(
142:     f"Cancer: {(pred['true_label'] == 1).sum()}"
143: )
144: 
145: print(
146:     f"Non-cancer: {(pred['true_label'] == 0).sum()}"
147: )
148: 
149: 
150: # =====================================================================
151: # READ DATASET 2
152: # =====================================================================
153: 
154: print()
155: print("=" * 90)
156: print("READING eLIFE SUPPLEMENTAL DATASET 2")
157: print("=" * 90)
158: 
159: raw = pd.read_excel(
160:     SUPPLEMENTARY_XLSX,
161:     sheet_name="Supplemental Dataset 2",
162:     header=None,
163:     engine="openpyxl",
164: )
165: 
166: print()
167: print("Raw shape:", raw.shape)
168: 
169: HEADER_ROW = 2
170: 
171: # Dataset 2:
172: #   column 0 = feature name
173: #   columns 1..179 = 179 retained historical samples
174: 
175: header = list(
176:     raw.iloc[
177:         HEADER_ROW,
178:         1:180,
179:     ]
180: )
181: 
182: if len(header) != 179:
183:     raise RuntimeError(
184:         f"Expected 179 Dataset 2 sample columns, found {len(header)}."
185:     )
186: 
187: 
188: # =====================================================================
189: # BUILD THE EXACT HISTORICAL SAMPLE ORDER FROM THE PMML REPRODUCTION
190: # =====================================================================
191: 
192: # The prediction file is already in the exact historical ordering
193: # established by the successful PMML reproduction.
194: 
195: historical_ids = pred["sample_key"].tolist()
196: 
197: if len(set(historical_ids)) != 179:
198:     raise RuntimeError(
199:         "Historical prediction file contains duplicate sample IDs."
200:     )
201: 
202: 
203: # =====================================================================
204: # EXTRACT THE 14 FEATURES
205: # =====================================================================
206: 
207: feature_series = (
208:     raw.iloc[:, 0]
209:     .astype(str)
210:     .str.strip()
211: )
212: 
213: rows = {}
214: 
215: for feature in FEATURES:
216: 
217:     matches = np.where(
218:         feature_series.values == feature
219:     )[0]
220: 
221:     if len(matches) != 1:
222:         raise RuntimeError(
223:             f"Expected exactly one row for {feature}, "
224:             f"found {len(matches)}."
225:         )
226: 
227:     rows[feature] = int(matches[0])
228: 
229: 
230: values = []
231: 
232: for feature in FEATURES:
233: 
234:     row_idx = rows[feature]
235: 
236:     vals = pd.to_numeric(
237:         raw.iloc[
238:             row_idx,
239:             1:180,
240:         ],
241:         errors="coerce",
242:     ).to_numpy(
243:         dtype=np.float64
244:     )
245: 
246:     if len(vals) != 179:
247:         raise RuntimeError(
248:             f"{feature} has {len(vals)} values."
249:         )
250: 
251:     if not np.all(np.isfinite(vals)):
252:         raise RuntimeError(
253:             f"{feature} contains non-finite values."
254:         )
255: 
256:     values.append(vals)
257: 
258: 
259: X = np.vstack(values).T
260: 
261: historical = pd.DataFrame(
262:     X,
263:     columns=FEATURES,
264: )
265: 
266: historical.insert(
267:     0,
268:     "sample_id",
269:     historical_ids,
270: )
271: 
272: 
273: # =====================================================================
274: # ALIGN LABELS
275: # =====================================================================
276: 
277: label_map = (
278:     pred
279:     .set_index("sample_key")["true_label"]
280:     .astype(int)
281: )
282: 
283: historical["sample_key"] = (
284:     historical["sample_id"]
285:     .map(norm_id)
286: )
287: 
288: historical["true_label"] = (
289:     historical["sample_key"]
290:     .map(label_map)
291: )
292: 
293: if historical["true_label"].isna().any():
294:     bad = historical.loc[
295:         historical["true_label"].isna(),
296:         "sample_id",
297:     ].tolist()
298: 
299:     raise RuntimeError(
300:         "Missing labels for historical samples:\n"
301:         + "\n".join(map(str, bad))
302:     )
303: 
304: historical["true_label"] = (
305:     historical["true_label"].astype(int)
306: )
307: 
308: 
309: # =====================================================================
310: # VALIDATION
311: # =====================================================================
312: 
313: y = historical["true_label"].to_numpy()
314: 
315: if len(historical) != 179:
316:     raise RuntimeError(
317:         "Historical dataset is not 179 patients."
318:     )
319: 
320: if X.shape != (179, 14):
321:     raise RuntimeError(
322:         f"Unexpected X shape: {X.shape}"
323:     )
324: 
325: if (y == 1).sum() != 97:
326:     raise RuntimeError(
327:         f"Expected 97 cancer patients, found {(y == 1).sum()}."
328:     )
329: 
330: if (y == 0).sum() != 82:
331:     raise RuntimeError(
332:         f"Expected 82 non-cancer patients, found {(y == 0).sum()}."
333:     )
334: 
335: 
336: print()
337: print("=" * 90)
338: print("HISTORICAL DATA VALIDATION")
339: print("=" * 90)
340: 
341: print()
342: print("Patients:", len(historical))
343: print("Features:", X.shape[1])
344: print("Cancer:", int((y == 1).sum()))
345: print("Non-cancer:", int((y == 0).sum()))
346: 
347: 
348: # =====================================================================
349: # 5-FOLD OOF
350: # =====================================================================
351: 
352: cv = StratifiedKFold(
353:     n_splits=5,
354:     shuffle=True,
355:     random_state=2026,
356: )
357: 
358: oof_probability = np.full(
359:     len(historical),
360:     np.nan,
361: )
362: 
363: oof_prediction = np.full(
364:     len(historical),
365:     -1,
366:     dtype=int,
367: )
368: 
369: fold_records = []
370: 
371: 
372: print()
373: print("=" * 90)
374: print("5-FOLD PATIENT-LEVEL CROSS-VALIDATION")
375: print("=" * 90)
376: 
377: 
378: for fold, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
379:     cv.split(X, y),
380:     start=1,
381: ):
382: 
383:     model = Pipeline(
384:         steps=[
385:             (
386:                 "scaler",
387:                 StandardScaler(),
388:             ),
389:             (
390:                 "classifier",
391:                 LogisticRegression(
392:                     solver="saga",
393:                     max_iter=10000,
394:                     random_state=2026,
395:                 ),
396:             ),
397:         ]
398:     )
399: 
400:     inner_cv = StratifiedKFold(
401:         n_splits=3,
402:         shuffle=True,
403:         random_state=2026 + fold,
404:     )
405: 
406:     param_grid = {
407:         "classifier__C": [
408:             0.01,
409:             0.03,
410:             0.1,
411:             0.3,
412:             1.0,
413:             3.0,
414:         ],
415:         "classifier__l1_ratio": [
416:             0.0,
417:             0.25,
418:             0.5,
419:             0.75,
420:             1.0,
421:         ],
422:         "classifier__penalty": [
423:             "elasticnet",
424:         ],
425:     }
426: 
427:     search = GridSearchCV(
428:         model,
429:         param_grid=param_grid,
430:         scoring="roc_auc",
431:         cv=inner_cv,
432:         n_jobs=-1,
433:         refit=True,
434:     )
435: 
436:     search.fit(
437:         X[train_idx],
438:         y[train_idx],
439:     )
440: 
441:     probability = search.predict_proba(
442:         X[test_idx]
443:     )[:, 1]
444: 
445:     prediction = (
446:         probability >= 0.5
447:     ).astype(int)
448: 
449:     oof_probability[test_idx] = probability
450:     oof_prediction[test_idx] = prediction
451: 
452:     fold_auc = roc_auc_score(
453:         y[test_idx],
454:         probability,
455:     )
456: 
457:     fold_accuracy = accuracy_score(
458:         y[test_idx],
459:         prediction,
460:     )
461: 
462:     fold_records.append(
463:         {
464:             "fold": fold,
465:             "n_train": int(len(train_idx)),
466:             "n_test": int(len(test_idx)),
467:             "roc_auc": float(fold_auc),
468:             "accuracy": float(fold_accuracy),
469:         }
470:     )
471: 
472:     print(
473:         f"Fold {fold}: "
474:         f"train={len(train_idx)} "
475:         f"test={len(test_idx)} "
476:         f"AUC={fold_auc:.6f} "
477:         f"accuracy={fold_accuracy:.6f}"
478:     )
479: 
480: 
481: # =====================================================================
482: # OOF METRICS
483: # =====================================================================
484: 
485: auc = roc_auc_score(
486:     y,
487:     oof_probability,
488: )
489: 
490: pr_auc = average_precision_score(
491:     y,
492:     oof_probability,
493: )
494: 
495: accuracy = accuracy_score(
496:     y,
497:     oof_prediction,
498: )
499: 
500: tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(
501:     y,
502:     oof_prediction,
503: ).ravel()
504: 
505: sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn)
506: 
507: specificity = tn / (tn + fp)
508: 
509: 
510: # =====================================================================
511: # SAVE
512: # =====================================================================
513: 
514: historical["oof_probability_cancer"] = (
515:     oof_probability
516: )
517: 
518: historical["oof_prediction"] = (
519:     oof_prediction
520: )
521: 
522: historical["fold"] = -1
523: 
524: for fold, (_, test_idx) in enumerate(
525:     cv.split(X, y),
526:     start=1,
527: ):
528: 
529:     historical.loc[
530:         test_idx,
531:         "fold",
532:     ] = fold
533: 
534: 
535: OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
536:     parents=True,
537:     exist_ok=True,
538: )
539: 
540: historical.to_csv(
541:     PREDICTION_OUTPUT,
542:     index=False,
543: )
544: 
545: 
546: results = {
547:     "model": "standardized L2 logistic regression",
548:     "cohort": {
549:         "patients": 179,
550:         "cancer": 97,
551:         "non_cancer": 82,
552:     },
553:     "representation": {
554:         "source": "eLife Supplementary Dataset 2",
555:         "batch_adjusted": True,
556:         "log10_transformed": True,
557:     },
558:     "features": FEATURES,
559:     "cross_validation": {
560:         "method": "5-fold stratified patient-level OOF",
561:         "random_state": 2026,
562:     },
563:     "metrics": {
564:         "roc_auc": float(auc),
565:         "pr_auc": float(pr_auc),
566:         "accuracy": float(accuracy),
567:         "sensitivity": float(sensitivity),
568:         "specificity": float(specificity),
569:     },
570:     "confusion_matrix": {
571:         "TN": int(tn),
572:         "FP": int(fp),
573:         "FN": int(fn),
574:         "TP": int(tp),
575:     },
576:     "folds": fold_records,
577: }
578: 
579: with RESULTS_OUTPUT.open("w") as f:
580: 
581:     json.dump(
582:         results,
583:         f,
584:         indent=2,
585:     )
586: 
587: 
588: print()
589: print("=" * 90)
590: print("FAIR HISTORICAL 14-miRNA BASELINE RESULTS")
591: print("=" * 90)
592: 
593: print()
594: print(f"Patients:       {len(historical)}")
595: print(f"Cancer:         {(y == 1).sum()}")
596: print(f"Non-cancer:     {(y == 0).sum()}")
597: 
598: print()
599: print(f"OOF ROC AUC:    {auc:.6f}")
600: print(f"OOF PR AUC:     {pr_auc:.6f}")
601: print(f"OOF Accuracy:   {accuracy:.6f}")
602: print(f"Sensitivity:    {sensitivity:.6f}")
603: print(f"Specificity:    {specificity:.6f}")
604:

606: print("Confusion matrix:")
607: print(f"  TP={tp} FN={fn}")
608: print(f"  FP={fp} TN={tn}")
609: 
610: print()
611: print("Saved:")
612: print(PREDICTION_OUTPUT)
613: print(RESULTS_OUTPUT)

### scripts\build_full_historical_mirna_baseline.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: """
4: FULL HISTORICAL miRNA BASELINE
5: 
6: Uses the full miRNA feature set available in eLife Supplemental
7: Dataset 2 on the exact historical 179-patient cohort.
8: 
9: This is a NEW model.
10: 
11: It does NOT use:
12:     - historical PMML weights
13:     - historical neural-network architecture
14: 
15: Model:
16:     StandardScaler
17:         ->
18:     Elastic-net logistic regression
19: 
20: Evaluation:
21:     5-fold outer patient-level stratified CV
22: 
23: Hyperparameter tuning:
24:     3-fold inner CV within each outer training set
25: 
26: Therefore:
27: 
28:     test patients
29:         are never used for
30:         feature/model selection.
31: 
32: This prevents data leakage.
33: 
34: The purpose is to compare:
35: 
36:     historical 14-miRNA neural network
37:                 vs
38:     modern 14-miRNA logistic regression
39:                 vs
40:     modern full-miRNA regularized model
41: """
42: 
43: from __future__ import annotations
44: 
45: import json
46: import re
47: from pathlib import Path
48: 
49: import numpy as np
50: import pandas as pd
51: 
52: from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
53: from sklearn.metrics import (
54:     accuracy_score,
55:     average_precision_score,
56:     confusion_matrix,
57:     roc_auc_score,
58: )
59: from sklearn.model_selection import (
60:     GridSearchCV,
61:     StratifiedKFold,
62: )
63: from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
64: from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
65: 
66: 
67: # =====================================================================
68: # PATHS
69: # =====================================================================
70: 
71: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
72: 
73: SUPPLEMENTARY_XLSX = (
74:     ROOT
75:     / "data"
76:     / "external"
77:     / "elife_28932"
78:     / "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_6.xlsx"
79: )
80: 
81: HISTORICAL_PREDICTIONS = (
82:     ROOT
83:     / "reports"
84:     / "tables"
85:     / "original_historical_clean_predictions.csv"
86: )
87: 
88: OUTPUT_DIR = (
89:     ROOT
90:     / "reports"
91:     / "tables"
92: )
93: 
94: PREDICTIONS_OUTPUT = (
95:     OUTPUT_DIR
96:     / "full_historical_mirna_oof_predictions.csv"
97: )
98: 
99: RESULTS_OUTPUT = (
100:     OUTPUT_DIR
101:     / "full_historical_mirna_baseline_results.json"
102: )
103: 
104: 
105: # =====================================================================
106: # SETTINGS
107: # =====================================================================
108: 
109: OUTER_SPLITS = 5
110: INNER_SPLITS = 3
111: 
112: RANDOM_STATE = 2026
113: 
114: 
115: # =====================================================================
116: # ID NORMALIZATION
117: # =====================================================================
118: 
119: def norm_id(value) -> str:
120: 
121:     s = str(value).strip().lower()
122: 
123:     if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0+", s):
124:         s = s.split(".", 1)[0]
125: 
126:     return s.replace("-", "")
127: 
128: 
129: # =====================================================================
130: # IDENTIFY miRNA FEATURE ROWS
131: # =====================================================================
132: 
133: def looks_like_mirna(value) -> bool:
134: 
135:     if pd.isna(value):
136:         return False
137: 
138:     s = str(value).strip()
139: 
140:     return (
141:         s.startswith("hsa-miR-")
142:         or s.startswith("hsa-let-")
143:     )
144: 
145: 
146: # =====================================================================
147: # LOAD HISTORICAL COHORT
148: # =====================================================================
149: 
150: print("=" * 90)
151: print("FULL HISTORICAL miRNA BASELINE")
152: print("=" * 90)
153: 
154: print()
155: print("Loading historical cohort...")
156: 
157: pred = pd.read_csv(
158:     HISTORICAL_PREDICTIONS
159: )
160: 
161: if len(pred) != 179:
162:     raise RuntimeError(
163:         f"Expected 179 historical patients, found {len(pred)}."
164:     )
165: 
166: pred["sample_key"] = (
167:     pred["sample_id"].map(norm_id)
168: )
169: 
170: if pred["sample_key"].duplicated().any():
171:     raise RuntimeError(
172:         "Duplicate historical sample IDs detected."
173:     )
174: 
175: print(
176:     f"Patients: {len(pred)}"
177: )
178: 
179: print(
180:     f"Cancer: {(pred['true_label'] == 1).sum()}"
181: )
182: 
183: print(
184:     f"Non-cancer: {(pred['true_label'] == 0).sum()}"
185: )
186: 
187: 
188: # =====================================================================
189: # READ DATASET 2
190: # =====================================================================
191: 
192: print()
193: print("=" * 90)
194: print("READING eLIFE SUPPLEMENTAL DATASET 2")
195: print("=" * 90)
196: 
197: raw = pd.read_excel(
198:     SUPPLEMENTARY_XLSX,
199:     sheet_name="Supplemental Dataset 2",
200:     header=None,
201:     engine="openpyxl",
202: )
203: 
204: print()
205: print("Raw shape:", raw.shape)
206: 
207: HEADER_ROW = 2
208: 
209: raw_header = list(
210:     raw.iloc[
211:         HEADER_ROW,
212:         1:180,
213:     ]
214: )
215: 
216: if len(raw_header) != 179:
217:     raise RuntimeError(
218:         f"Expected 179 sample columns, found {len(raw_header)}."
219:     )
220: 
221: 
222: # =====================================================================
223: # USE THE SAME HISTORICAL SAMPLE ORDER AS THE PMML REPRODUCTION
224: # =====================================================================
225: 
226: historical_ids = pred["sample_key"].tolist()
227: 
228: # Dataset 2's first 119 numeric columns correspond to the retained
229: # numeric historical samples; the remainder are the 60 e-samples.
230: #
231: # We already independently established the exact historical ordering
232: # in original_historical_clean_predictions.csv.
233: 
234: if len(historical_ids) != 179:
235:     raise RuntimeError(
236:         "Historical ID count is not 179."
237:     )
238: 
239: 
240: # =====================================================================
241: # FIND ALL miRNA ROWS
242: # =====================================================================
243: 
244: feature_names = []
245: 
246: feature_rows = []
247: 
248: for row_idx, value in enumerate(
249:     raw.iloc[:, 0]
250: ):
251: 
252:     if not looks_like_mirna(value):
253:         continue
254: 
255:     feature = str(value).strip()
256: 
257:     # Avoid duplicate feature names.
258:     if feature in feature_names:
259:         continue
260: 
261:     feature_names.append(feature)
262:     feature_rows.append(row_idx)
263: 
264: 
265: if len(feature_names) < 50:
266:     raise RuntimeError(
267:         "Unexpectedly few miRNA features found: "
268:         f"{len(feature_names)}"
269:     )
270: 
271: 
272: print()
273: print("=" * 90)
274: print("FULL miRNA FEATURE SET")
275: print("=" * 90)
276: 
277: print()
278: print(
279:     f"miRNA features detected: {len(feature_names)}"
280: )
281: 
282: print()
283: print("First 20 features:")
284: 
285: for feature in feature_names[:20]:
286:     print(f"  {feature}")
287: 
288: print()
289: print("Last 10 features:")
290: 
291: for feature in feature_names[-10:]:
292:     print(f"  {feature}")
293: 
294: 
295: # =====================================================================
296: # EXTRACT MATRIX
297: # =====================================================================
298: 
299: values = []
300: 
301: for feature, row_idx in zip(
302:     feature_names,
303:     feature_rows,
304: ):
305: 
306:     vals = pd.to_numeric(
307:         raw.iloc[
308:             row_idx,
309:             1:180,
310:         ],
311:         errors="coerce",
312:     ).to_numpy(
313:         dtype=np.float64
314:     )
315: 
316:     if len(vals) != 179:
317:         raise RuntimeError(
318:             f"{feature} has {len(vals)} values."
319:         )
320: 
321:     if not np.all(np.isfinite(vals)):
322:         bad = np.where(
323:             ~np.isfinite(vals)
324:         )[0]
325: 
326:         raise RuntimeError(
327:             f"{feature} contains non-finite values "
328:             f"at columns {bad[:10].tolist()}."
329:         )
330: 
331:     values.append(vals)
332: 
333: 
334: X = np.vstack(values).T
335: 
336: 
337: # =====================================================================
338: # BUILD DATAFRAME
339: # =====================================================================
340: 
341: mirna = pd.DataFrame(
342:     X,
343:     columns=feature_names,
344: )
345: 
346: mirna.insert(
347:     0,
348:     "sample_id",
349:     historical_ids,
350: )
351: 
352: mirna["sample_key"] = (
353:     mirna["sample_id"]
354:     .map(norm_id)
355: )
356: 
357: 
358: # =====================================================================
359: # ALIGN LABELS
360: # =====================================================================
361: 
362: label_map = (
363:     pred
364:     .set_index("sample_key")["true_label"]
365:     .astype(int)
366: )
367: 
368: mirna["true_label"] = (
369:     mirna["sample_key"]
370:     .map(label_map)
371: )
372: 
373: if mirna["true_label"].isna().any():
374: 
375:     bad = mirna.loc[
376:         mirna["true_label"].isna(),
377:         "sample_id",
378:     ].tolist()
379: 
380:     raise RuntimeError(
381:         "Missing labels for:\n"
382:         + "\n".join(
383:             map(str, bad)
384:         )
385:     )
386: 
387: mirna["true_label"] = (
388:     mirna["true_label"].astype(int)
389: )
390: 
391: 
392: # =====================================================================
393: # VALIDATION
394: # =====================================================================
395: 
396: y = mirna["true_label"].to_numpy()
397: 
398: if X.shape[0] != 179:
399:     raise RuntimeError(
400:         f"Expected 179 patients, found {X.shape[0]}."
401:     )
402: 
403: if X.shape[1] != len(feature_names):
404:     raise RuntimeError(
405:         "Feature dimension mismatch."
406:     )
407: 
408: if (y == 1).sum() != 97:
409:     raise RuntimeError(
410:         f"Expected 97 cancer patients, found {(y == 1).sum()}."
411:     )
412: 
413: if (y == 0).sum() != 82:
414:     raise RuntimeError(
415:         f"Expected 82 non-cancer patients, found {(y == 0).sum()}."
416:     )
417: 
418: 
419: print()
420: print("=" * 90)
421: print("DATA VALIDATION")
422: print("=" * 90)
423: 
424: print()
425: print("Patients:", X.shape[0])
426: print("miRNA features:", X.shape[1])
427: print("Cancer:", int((y == 1).sum()))
428: print("Non-cancer:", int((y == 0).sum()))
429: 
430: 
431: # =====================================================================
432: # OUTER CV
433: # =====================================================================
434: 
435: outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
436:     n_splits=OUTER_SPLITS,
437:     shuffle=True,
438:     random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
439: )
440: 
441: oof_probability = np.full(
442:     len(y),
443:     np.nan,
444: )
445: 
446: oof_prediction = np.full(
447:     len(y),
448:     -1,
449:     dtype=int,
450: )
451: 
452: fold_records = []
453: 
454: 
455: print()
456: print("=" * 90)
457: print("NESTED CROSS-VALIDATION")
458: print("=" * 90)
459: 
460: 
461: for fold, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
462:     outer_cv.split(X, y),
463:     start=1,
464: ):
465: 
466:     print()
467:     print(
468:         f"OUTER FOLD {fold}/{OUTER_SPLITS}"
469:     )
470: 
471:     X_train = X[train_idx]
472:     X_test = X[test_idx]
473: 
474:     y_train = y[train_idx]
475:     y_test = y[test_idx]
476: 
477: 
478:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
479:     # Inner CV
480:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
481: 
482:     inner_cv = StratifiedKFold(
483:         n_splits=INNER_SPLITS,
484:         shuffle=True,
485:         random_state=RANDOM_STATE + fold,
486:     )
487: 
488: 
489:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
490:     # Pipeline
491:     #
492:     # Scaling occurs separately inside every inner/outer training
493:     # split.
494:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
495: 
496:     pipeline = Pipeline(
497:         steps=[
498:             (
499:                 "scaler",
500:                 StandardScaler(),
501:             ),
502:             (
503:                 "classifier",
504:                 LogisticRegression(
505:                     solver="saga",
506:                     max_iter=10000,
507:                     random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
508:                 ),
509:             ),
510:         ]
511:     )
512: 
513: 
514:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
515:     # Hyperparameter grid
516:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
517: 
518:     param_grid = {
519:         "classifier__C": [
520:             0.01,
521:             0.03,
522:             0.1,
523:             0.3,
524:             1.0,
525:             3.0,
526:         ],
527:         "classifier__l1_ratio": [
528:             0.0,
529:             0.25,
530:             0.5,
531:             0.75,
532:             1.0,
533:         ],
534:         "classifier__penalty": [
535:             "elasticnet",
536:         ],
537:     }
538: 
539: 
540:     search = GridSearchCV(
541:         pipeline,
542:         param_grid=param_grid,
543:         scoring="roc_auc",
544:         cv=inner_cv,
545:         n_jobs=-1,
546:         refit=True,
547:     )
548: 
549: 
550:     search.fit(
551:         X_train,
552:         y_train,
553:     )
554: 
555: 
556:     probability = search.predict_proba(
557:         X_test
558:     )[:, 1]
559: 
560:     prediction = (
561:         probability >= 0.5
562:     ).astype(int)
563: 
564: 
565:     oof_probability[test_idx] = (
566:         probability
567:     )
568: 
569:     oof_prediction[test_idx] = (
570:         prediction
571:     )
572: 
573: 
574:     fold_auc = roc_auc_score(
575:         y_test,
576:         probability,
577:     )
578: 
579:     fold_accuracy = accuracy_score(
580:         y_test,
581:         prediction,
582:     )
583: 
584: 
585:     best_params = {
586:         key: value
587:         for key, value in search.best_params_.items()
588:     }
589: 
590: 
591:     fold_records.append(
592:         {
593:             "fold": fold,
594:             "n_train": int(len(train_idx)),
595:             "n_test": int(len(test_idx)),
596:             "roc_auc": float(fold_auc),
597:             "accuracy": float(fold_accuracy),
598:             "inner_cv_auc": float(
599:                 search.best_score_
600:             ),
601:             "best_params": best_params,
602:         }
603:     )
604: 
605: 
606:     print(
607:         f"  test patients: {len(test_idx)}"
608:     )
609: 
610:     print(
611:         f"  inner-CV AUC: {search.best_score_:.6f}"
612:     )
613: 
614:     print(
615:         f"  test AUC:     {fold_auc:.6f}"
616:     )
617: 
618:     print(
619:         f"  accuracy:     {fold_accuracy:.6f}"
620:     )
621: 
622:     print(
623:         f"  best params:  {best_params}"
624:     )
625: 
626: 
627: # =====================================================================
628: # OOF METRICS
629: # =====================================================================
630: 
631: if np.any(
632:     ~np.isfinite(oof_probability)
633: ):
634:     raise RuntimeError(
635:         "Some patients lack OOF probabilities."
636:     )
637: 
638: if np.any(
639:     oof_prediction < 0
640: ):
641:     raise RuntimeError(
642:         "Some patients lack OOF predictions."
643:     )
644: 
645: 
646: auc = roc_auc_score(
647:     y,
648:     oof_probability,
649: )
650: 
651: pr_auc = average_precision_score(
652:     y,
653:     oof_probability,
654: )
655: 
656: accuracy = accuracy_score(
657:     y,
658:     oof_prediction,
659: )
660: 
661: tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(
662:     y,
663:     oof_prediction,
664: ).ravel()
665: 
666: sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn)
667: 
668: specificity = tn / (tn + fp)
669: 
670: 
671: # =====================================================================
672: # SAVE PREDICTIONS
673: # =====================================================================
674: 
675: mirna["oof_probability_cancer"] = (
676:     oof_probability
677: )
678: 
679: mirna["oof_prediction"] = (
680:     oof_prediction
681: )
682: 
683: mirna["fold"] = -1
684: 
685: 
686: for fold, (_, test_idx) in enumerate(
687:     outer_cv.split(X, y),
688:     start=1,
689: ):
690: 
691:     mirna.loc[
692:         test_idx,
693:         "fold",
694:     ] = fold
695: 
696: 
697: OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
698:     parents=True,
699:     exist_ok=True,
700: )
701: 
702: mirna.to_csv(
703:     PREDICTIONS_OUTPUT,
704:     index=False,
705: )
706: 
707: 
708: # =====================================================================
709: # SAVE RESULTS
710: # =====================================================================
711: 
712: results = {
713:     "model": "nested-CV elastic-net logistic regression",
714:     "representation": {
715:         "source": "eLife Supplemental Dataset 2",
716:         "batch_adjusted": True,
717:         "log10_transformed": True,
718:     },
719:     "cohort": {
720:         "patients": 179,
721:         "cancer": 97,
722:         "non_cancer": 82,
723:     },
724:     "n_mirna_features": int(
725:         len(feature_names)
726:     ),
727:     "cross_validation": {
728:         "outer": "5-fold stratified patient-level",
729:         "inner": "3-fold stratified",
730:         "random_state": RANDOM_STATE,
731:     },
732:     "metrics": {
733:         "roc_auc": float(auc),
734:         "pr_auc": float(pr_auc),
735:         "accuracy": float(accuracy),
736:         "sensitivity": float(sensitivity),
737:         "specificity": float(specificity),
738:     },
739:     "confusion_matrix": {
740:         "TN": int(tn),
741:         "FP": int(fp),
742:         "FN": int(fn),
743:         "TP": int(tp),
744:     },
745:     "folds": fold_records,
746: }
747: 
748: with RESULTS_OUTPUT.open(
749:     "w"
750: ) as f:
751: 
752:     json.dump(
753:         results,
754:         f,
755:         indent=2,
756:     )
757: 
758: 
759: # =====================================================================
760: # REPORT
761: # =====================================================================
762: 
763: print()
764: print("=" * 90)
765: print("FULL HISTORICAL miRNA BASELINE RESULTS")
766: print("=" * 90)
767: 
768: print()
769: print(f"Patients:       {len(y)}")
770: print(f"miRNA features: {len(feature_names)}")
771: 
772: print()
773: print(f"Cancer:         {(y == 1).sum()}")
774: print(f"Non-cancer:     {(y == 0).sum()}")
775: 
776: print()
777: print(f"OOF ROC AUC:    {auc:.6f}")
778: print(f"OOF PR AUC:     {pr_auc:.6f}")
779: print(f"OOF Accuracy:   {accuracy:.6f}")
780: print(f"Sensitivity:    {sensitivity:.6f}")
781: print(f"Specificity:    {specificity:.6f}")
782: 
783: print()
784: print("Confusion matrix:")
785: print(f"  TP={tp} FN={fn}")
786: print(f"  FP={fp} TN={tn}")
787: 
788: print()
789: print("Saved:")
790: print(PREDICTIONS_OUTPUT)
791: print(RESULTS_OUTPUT)
792: 
793: print()
794: print("=" * 90)
795: print("IMPORTANT")
796: print("=" * 90)
797: 
798: print()
799: print(
800:     "This is a NEW model and is not the historical eLife neural network."
801: )
802: 
803: print(
804:     "All scaling and hyperparameter selection were performed "
805:     "inside the cross-validation procedure."
806: )

### scripts\build_gse106817_170mirna_baseline.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: from pathlib import Path
4: import json
5: 
6: import numpy as np
7: import pandas as pd
8: 
9: from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
10: from sklearn.metrics import (
11:     accuracy_score,
12:     average_precision_score,
13:     confusion_matrix,
14:     roc_auc_score,
15: )
16: from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
17: from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
18: from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
19: 
20: 
21: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
22: 
23: DATA = (
24:     ROOT
25:     / "data"
26:     / "processed"
27:     / "gse106817_external_validation.csv.gz"
28: )
29: 
30: OUT_PRED = (
31:     ROOT
32:     / "reports"
33:     / "tables"
34:     / "gse106817_170mirna_oof_predictions.csv"
35: )
36: 
37: OUT_RESULTS = (
38:     ROOT
39:     / "reports"
40:     / "tables"
41:     / "gse106817_170mirna_baseline_results.json"
42: )
43: 
44: 
45: print("=" * 80)
46: print("GSE106817 INDEPENDENT 170-miRNA BASELINE")
47: print("=" * 80)
48: 
49: df = pd.read_csv(DATA)
50: 
51: feature_cols = [
52:     c for c in df.columns
53:     if c.startswith("hsa-")
54: ]
55: 
56: X = df[feature_cols].apply(
57:     pd.to_numeric,
58:     errors="coerce",
59: )
60: 
61: y = df["binary_label"].astype(int)
62: 
63: print()
64: print("Patients:", len(df))
65: print("Features:", len(feature_cols))
66: print("Cancer:", int(y.sum()))
67: print("Non-cancer:", int((y == 0).sum()))
68: 
69: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
70: # Remove rows with missing molecular data.
71: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
72: 
73: valid = (
74:     X.notna().all(axis=1)
75:     & y.notna()
76: )
77: 
78: X = X.loc[valid].reset_index(drop=True)
79: y = y.loc[valid].reset_index(drop=True)
80: meta = df.loc[valid].reset_index(drop=True)
81: 
82: print()
83: print("Patients after feature validation:", len(X))
84: print("Missing miRNA rows:", int((~valid).sum()))
85: 
86: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
87: # Model
88: #
89: # Class weighting is important here because GSE106817 has many
90: # non-cancer controls.
91: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
92: 
93: model = Pipeline([
94:     (
95:         "scaler",
96:         StandardScaler(),
97:     ),
98:     (
99:         "classifier",
100:         LogisticRegression(
101:             max_iter=5000,
102:             class_weight="balanced",
103:             solver="liblinear",
104:             random_state=42,
105:         ),
106:     ),
107: ])
108: 
109: cv = StratifiedKFold(
110:     n_splits=5,
111:     shuffle=True,
112:     random_state=42,
113: )
114: 
115: oof_prob = np.full(
116:     len(X),
117:     np.nan,
118: )
119: 
120: oof_pred = np.full(
121:     len(X),
122:     np.nan,
123: )
124: 
125: print()
126: print("=" * 80)
127: print("5-FOLD PATIENT-LEVEL OOF VALIDATION")
128: print("=" * 80)
129: 
130: for fold, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
131:     cv.split(X, y),
132:     start=1,
133: ):
134: 
135:     X_train = X.iloc[train_idx]
136:     X_test = X.iloc[test_idx]
137: 
138:     y_train = y.iloc[train_idx]
139: 
140:     model.fit(
141:         X_train,
142:         y_train,
143:     )
144: 
145:     prob = model.predict_proba(
146:         X_test
147:     )[:, 1]
148: 
149:     pred = (
150:         prob >= 0.5
151:     ).astype(int)
152: 
153:     oof_prob[test_idx] = prob
154:     oof_pred[test_idx] = pred
155: 
156:     auc = roc_auc_score(
157:         y.iloc[test_idx],
158:         prob,
159:     )
160: 
161:     acc = accuracy_score(
162:         y.iloc[test_idx],
163:         pred,
164:     )
165: 
166:     print(
167:         f"Fold {fold}: "
168:         f"train={len(train_idx)} "
169:         f"test={len(test_idx)} "
170:         f"AUC={auc:.6f} "
171:         f"accuracy={acc:.6f}"
172:     )
173: 
174: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
175: # Overall OOF metrics
176: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
177: 
178: auc = roc_auc_score(
179:     y,
180:     oof_prob,
181: )
182: 
183: pr_auc = average_precision_score(
184:     y,
185:     oof_prob,
186: )
187: 
188: accuracy = accuracy_score(
189:     y,
190:     oof_pred,
191: )
192: 
193: cm = confusion_matrix(
194:     y,
195:     oof_pred,
196: )
197: 
198: tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()
199: 
200: sensitivity = (
201:     tp / (tp + fn)
202:     if (tp + fn)
203:     else np.nan
204: )
205: 
206: specificity = (
207:     tn / (tn + fp)
208:     if (tn + fp)
209:     else np.nan
210: )
211: 
212: print()
213: print("=" * 80)
214: print("RESULTS")
215: print("=" * 80)
216: 
217: print(
218:     f"OOF ROC AUC:    {auc:.6f}"
219: )
220: 
221: print(
222:     f"OOF PR AUC:     {pr_auc:.6f}"
223: )
224: 
225: print(
226:     f"OOF Accuracy:   {accuracy:.6f}"
227: )
228: 
229: print(
230:     f"Sensitivity:    {sensitivity:.6f}"
231: )
232: 
233: print(
234:     f"Specificity:    {specificity:.6f}"
235: )
236: 
237: print()
238: print("Confusion matrix:")
239: print(
240:     f"  TP={tp} FN={fn}"
241: )
242: print(
243:     f"  FP={fp} TN={tn}"
244: )
245: 
246: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
247: # Save OOF predictions
248: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
249: 
250: predictions = meta[
251:     [
252:         "sample_id",
253:         "title",
254:         "group",
255:         "age",
256:         "binary_label",
257:     ]
258: ].copy()
259: 
260: predictions["prediction_probability"] = (
261:     oof_prob
262: )
263: 
264: predictions["prediction"] = (
265:     oof_pred.astype(int)
266: )
267: 
268: predictions["correct"] = (
269:     predictions["prediction"]
270:     == predictions["binary_label"]
271: )
272: 
273: OUT_PRED.parent.mkdir(
274:     parents=True,
275:     exist_ok=True,
276: )
277: 
278: predictions.to_csv(
279:     OUT_PRED,
280:     index=False,
281: )
282: 
283: results = {
284:     "dataset": "GSE106817",
285:     "patients": int(len(X)),
286:     "features": int(len(feature_cols)),
287:     "cancer": int(y.sum()),
288:     "non_cancer": int((y == 0).sum()),
289:     "roc_auc": float(auc),
290:     "pr_auc": float(pr_auc),
291:     "accuracy": float(accuracy),
292:     "sensitivity": float(sensitivity),
293:     "specificity": float(specificity),
294:     "tp": int(tp),
295:     "fn": int(fn),
296:     "fp": int(fp),
297:     "tn": int(tn),
298:     "model": "balanced logistic regression",
299:     "evaluation": "5-fold stratified patient-level OOF",
300: }
301: 
302: OUT_RESULTS.write_text(
303:     json.dumps(
304:         results,
305:         indent=2,
306:     )
307: )
308: 
309: print()
310: print("=" * 80)
311: print("FILES")
312: print("=" * 80)
313: 
314: print(OUT_PRED)
315: print(OUT_RESULTS)
316: 
317: print()
318: print("IMPORTANT:")
319: print(
320:     "This is an independent GSE106817 baseline."
321: )
322: print(
323:     "It is NOT the frozen GSE94533 model."
324: )
325: print(
326:     "Age is not used because most GSE106817 controls lack age."
327: )

### scripts\build_gse106817_allmirna_borderline_discovery.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: from pathlib import Path
4: import json
5: 
6: import numpy as np
7: import pandas as pd
8: 
9: from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
10: from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
11: from sklearn.metrics import (
12:     accuracy_score,
13:     average_precision_score,
14:     confusion_matrix,
15:     roc_auc_score,
16: )
17: from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, StratifiedKFold
18: from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
19: from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
20: 
21: 
22: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
23: 
24: DATA = (
25:     ROOT
26:     / "data"
27:     / "processed"
28:     / "gse106817_external_validation.csv.gz"
29: )
30: 
31: OUT_PRED = (
32:     ROOT
33:     / "reports"
34:     / "tables"
35:     / "gse106817_allmirna_borderline_oof_predictions.csv"
36: )
37: 
38: OUT_RESULTS = (
39:     ROOT
40:     / "reports"
41:     / "tables"
42:     / "gse106817_allmirna_borderline_results.json"
43: )
44: 
45: 
46: print("=" * 80)
47: print("GSE106817 ALL-miRNA CANCER vs BORDERLINE DISCOVERY")
48: print("=" * 80)
49: 
50: df = pd.read_csv(DATA)
51: 
52: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
53: # Only cancer and borderline.
54: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
55: 
56: df = df[
57:     df["group"].isin([
58:         "cancer",
59:         "borderline",
60:     ])
61: ].copy()
62: 
63: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
64: # Every available miRNA in GSE106817.
65: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
66: 
67: mirna_cols = [
68:     c for c in df.columns
69:     if c.startswith("hsa-")
70: ]
71: 
72: feature_cols = mirna_cols + ["age"]
73: 
74: X = df[feature_cols].apply(
75:     pd.to_numeric,
76:     errors="coerce",
77: )
78: 
79: y = (
80:     df["group"] == "cancer"
81: ).astype(int)
82: 
83: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
84: # Remove incomplete rows.
85: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
86: 
87: valid = X.notna().all(axis=1)
88: 
89: X = X.loc[valid].reset_index(drop=True)
90: y = y.loc[valid].reset_index(drop=True)
91: meta = df.loc[valid].reset_index(drop=True)
92: 
93: print()
94: print("Patients:", len(X))
95: print("Cancer:", int(y.sum()))
96: print("Borderline:", int((y == 0).sum()))
97: print("miRNAs:", len(mirna_cols))
98: print("Total features including age:", len(feature_cols))
99: 
100: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
101: # Nested CV
102: #
103: # Feature selection happens ONLY inside the training folds.
104: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
105: 
106: outer_cv = StratifiedKFold(
107:     n_splits=5,
108:     shuffle=True,
109:     random_state=42,
110: )
111: 
112: inner_cv = StratifiedKFold(
113:     n_splits=4,
114:     shuffle=True,
115:     random_state=43,
116: )
117: 
118: pipeline = Pipeline([
119:     (
120:         "scale",
121:         StandardScaler(),
122:     ),
123:     (
124:         "select",
125:         SelectKBest(
126:             score_func=f_classif,
127:         ),
128:     ),
129:     (
130:         "clf",
131:         LogisticRegression(
132:             max_iter=5000,
133:             class_weight="balanced",
134:             solver="liblinear",
135:         ),
136:     ),
137: ])
138: 
139: param_grid = {
140:     "select__k": [
141:         5,
142:         10,
143:         20,
144:         30,
145:         50,
146:         75,
147:         100,
148:         150,
149:         200,
150:         300,
151:     ],
152:     "clf__C": [
153:         0.01,
154:         0.03,
155:         0.1,
156:         0.3,
157:         1.0,
158:         3.0,
159:     ],
160: }
161: 
162: oof_prob = np.full(
163:     len(X),
164:     np.nan,
165: )
166: 
167: oof_pred = np.full(
168:     len(X),
169:     np.nan,
170: )
171: 
172: fold_results = []
173: 
174: for fold, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(
175:     outer_cv.split(X, y),
176:     start=1,
177: ):
178: 
179:     print()
180:     print("=" * 80)
181:     print(f"OUTER FOLD {fold}/5")
182:     print("=" * 80)
183: 
184:     search = GridSearchCV(
185:         estimator=pipeline,
186:         param_grid=param_grid,
187:         cv=inner_cv,
188:         scoring="roc_auc",
189:         n_jobs=-1,
190:         refit=True,
191:     )
192: 
193:     search.fit(
194:         X.iloc[train_idx],
195:         y.iloc[train_idx],
196:     )
197:

199:         X.iloc[test_idx]
200:     )[:, 1]
201:

203:         probability >= 0.5
204:     ).astype(int)

231:     )
232:

234:         "best:",
235:         search.best_params_,
236:     )
237:

243:     y,
244:     oof_prob,

268: print("=" * 80)

### scripts\bulk_test_external_datasets.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """Download and externally test GEO ovarian-miRNA candidate series.
3: 
4: The runner is intentionally conservative: external labels are used only for
5: final evaluation, never for feature selection, preprocessing, threshold
6: tuning, or model fitting. GEO metadata and matrices are untrusted inputs and
7: each accession is isolated so one malformed series cannot stop the batch.
8: """

80: 
81: def read_accessions(path: Path) -> list[str]:
82:     """Extract and deduplicate GSE accessions from the scout report."""
83: 
84:     if not path.exists():
85:         raise FileNotFoundError(f"Candidate report not found: {path}")
86:     accessions = re.findall(r"^\|\s*(GSE\d+)\s*\|", path.read_text(), re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE)
87:     unique = list(dict.fromkeys(accession.upper() for accession in accessions))
88:     if not unique:
89:         raise RuntimeError(f"No GSE accessions found in {path}")
90:     LOGGER.info("Parsed %d candidate accessions from %s", len(unique), path)
91:     return unique
92: 
93: 
94: def read_candidates(path: Path) -> list[Candidate]:
95:     """Read accession/sample-count pairs from the scout report."""
96: 
97:     candidates: list[Candidate] = []
98:     for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
99:         if not line.startswith("|") or "Accession ID (GSE)" in line or line.startswith("|---"):
100:             continue
101:         columns = [column.strip() for column in line.strip("|").split("|")]
102:         if len(columns) < 3 or not re.fullmatch(r"GSE\d+", columns[0], re.IGNORECASE):
103:             continue
104:         sample_count = int(columns[2]) if columns[2].isdigit() else None
105:         candidates.append(Candidate(columns[0].upper(), sample_count))
106:     if not candidates:
107:         raise RuntimeError(f"No candidate rows found in {path}")
108:     return list({candidate.accession: candidate for candidate in candidates}.values())
109: 
110: 
111: def text_value(value: Any) -> str:
112:     if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
113:         return " ".join(text_value(item) for item in value)
114:     if isinstance(value, Mapping):
115:         return " ".join(f"{key} {text_value(item)}" for key, item in value.items())
116:     return str(value).strip()
117: 
118: 
119: def normalize_feature(value: Any) -> str:
120:     return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", text_value(value).lower())
121: 
122: 
123: def aliases(feature: str) -> set[str]:
124:     normalized = normalize_feature(feature)
125:     names = {normalized}
126:     if feature == "hsa-miR-203a":
127:         names.add(normalize_feature("hsa-miR-203a-3p"))
128:     return names
129: 
130: 
131: def sample_metadata(sample: Any) -> str:
132:     metadata = getattr(sample, "metadata", {}) or {}
133:     values: list[str] = []
134:     for key, value in metadata.items():
135:         if key in {"title", "source_name_ch1", "characteristics_ch1", "description"}:
136:             values.append(text_value(value))
137:     return " ".join(values)
138: 
139: 
140: def label_from_metadata(metadata: str) -> int | None:
141:     """Return the prespecified early-stage-compatible binary label."""
142: 
143:     value = metadata.lower()
144:     if "borderline" in value:
145:         return None
146:     ovarian_cancer = bool(re.search(r"ovarian\s+(cancer|carcinoma)|ovarian\s+tumou?r", value))
147:     if ovarian_cancer:
148:         return 1
149:     if re.search(r"\b(benign|healthy|control|non[- ]?cancer|normal)\b", value):
150:         return 0
151:     return None
152: 
153: 
154: def numeric_series(table: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
155:     if table is None or table.empty or table.shape[1] == 0:
156:         raise ValueError("GEO sample table is empty")
157:     value_columns = [column for column in table.columns if str(column).upper() in {"VALUE", "VALUES", "EXPRESSION"}]
158:     if not value_columns:
159:         numeric = table.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").notna().sum()
160:         value_columns = [str(numeric.idxmax())] if numeric.max() else []
161:     if not value_columns:
162:         raise ValueError("No numeric expression column found in GEO sample table")
163:     return pd.to_numeric(table[value_columns[0]], errors="coerce")
164: 
165: 
166: def metadata_expression_values(sample: Any, features: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict[str, float]:
167:     """Extract feature/value pairs from non-tabular GSM metadata when present."""
168: 
169:     aliases_to_feature = {
170:         alias: feature for feature in features for alias in aliases(feature)
171:     }
172:     values: dict[str, float] = {}
173: 
174:     def visit(value: Any, key_hint: str = "") -> None:
175:         if isinstance(value, Mapping):
176:             for key, child in value.items():
177:                 visit(child, normalize_feature(key))
178:             return
179:         if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, np.ndarray, pd.Series)):
180:             for child in value:
181:                 visit(child, key_hint)
182:             return
183:         if not key_hint:
184:             return
185:         matched = next(
186:             (feature for alias, feature in aliases_to_feature.items() if alias in key_hint),
187:             None,
188:         )
189:         if matched is None:
190:             return
191:         try:
192:             numeric = float(value)
193:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
194:             return
195:         if np.isfinite(numeric):
196:             values[matched] = numeric
197: 
198:     visit(getattr(sample, "metadata", {}) or {})
199:     return values
200: 
201: 
202: def platform_feature_map(gse: Any, features: Iterable[str]) -> dict[str, list[Any]]:
203:     """Map canonical miRNAs to platform probe IDs using GPL annotations."""
204: 
205:     targets = {feature: aliases(feature) for feature in features}
206:     mapping: dict[str, list[Any]] = {feature: [] for feature in targets}
207:     for platform in (getattr(gse, "gpls", {}) or {}).values():
208:         table = getattr(platform, "table", None)
209:         if not isinstance(table, pd.DataFrame) or table.empty:
210:             continue
211:         id_column = next((column for column in table.columns if str(column).upper() in {"ID", "ID_REF", "PROBEID"}), table.columns[0])
212:         for _, row in table.iterrows():
213:             row_text = {normalize_feature(value) for value in row.tolist() if pd.notna(value)}
214:             for feature, target_aliases in targets.items():
215:                 if row_text & target_aliases:
216:                     mapping[feature].append(str(row[id_column]))
217:     return mapping
218: 
219: 
220: def expression_frame(gse: Any, features: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, list[str]]:
221:     mapping = platform_feature_map(gse, features)
222:     sample_rows: list[dict[str, float]] = []
223:     labels: list[int | None] = []
224:     sample_ids: list[str] = []
225:     for sample_id, sample in (getattr(gse, "gsms", {}) or {}).items():
226:         table = getattr(sample, "table", None)
227:         row: dict[str, float]
228:         if not isinstance(table, pd.DataFrame) or table.empty or table.shape[1] == 0:
229:             LOGGER.warning(
230:                 "[%s] GSM table is empty or has no columns; trying metadata expression fallback",
231:                 sample_id,
232:             )
233:             row = {feature: np.nan for feature in features}
234:             row.update(metadata_expression_values(sample, features))
235:         else:
236:             ids = table.iloc[:, 0].astype(str)
237:             normalized_ids = {normalize_feature(value): value for value in ids}
238:             for feature in features:
239:                 if not mapping[feature]:
240:                     mapping[feature] = [normalized_ids[name] for name in aliases(feature) if name in normalized_ids]
241:             values = numeric_series(table)
242:             by_probe = pd.Series(values.to_numpy(), index=ids).groupby(level=0).mean()
243:             row = {}
244:             for feature in features:
245:                 probe_values = pd.to_numeric(by_probe.reindex(mapping[feature]), errors="coerce").dropna()
246:                 row[feature] = float(probe_values.mean()) if not probe_values.empty else np.nan
247:         sample_rows.append(row)
248:         labels.append(label_from_metadata(sample_metadata(sample)))
249:         sample_ids.append(str(sample_id))
250:     frame = pd.DataFrame(sample_rows, index=sample_ids)
251:     return frame, labels
252: 
253: 
254: def load_local_training() -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, tuple[str, ...]]:
255:     if not MATRIX_PATH.exists() or not METADATA_PATH.exists():
256:         raise FileNotFoundError(
257:             "GSE94533 processed inputs are required: "
258:             f"{MATRIX_PATH} and {METADATA_PATH}"
259:         )
260:     matrix = pd.read_csv(MATRIX_PATH)
261:     metadata = pd.read_csv(METADATA_PATH)
262:     required = {"sample_id_normalized", "diagnosis", "stage"}
263:     missing = required - set(metadata.columns)
264:     if missing:
265:         raise ValueError(f"Local metadata missing columns: {sorted(missing)}")
266:     features = tuple(column for column in matrix.columns if column.startswith("hsa-"))
267:     frame = metadata[["sample_id_normalized", "diagnosis", "stage"]].merge(
268:         matrix, on="sample_id_normalized", how="inner", validate="one_to_one"
269:     )
270:     keep = frame["diagnosis"].eq("Cancer") & frame["stage"].eq("Stage I/II")
271:     keep |= frame["diagnosis"].isin(["Benign", "Control"])
272:     frame = frame.loc[keep].reset_index(drop=True)
273:     labels = (frame["diagnosis"].eq("Cancer") & frame["stage"].eq("Stage I/II")).astype(int).to_numpy()
274:     if len(np.unique(labels)) != 2 or len(features) < SIGNATURE_SIZE:
275:         raise ValueError("Local GSE94533 training cohort does not contain the expected endpoint/features")
276:     return frame, labels, features
277: 
278: 
279: def fit_model(frame: pd.DataFrame, labels: np.ndarray, features: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[Pipeline, tuple[str, ...]]:
280:     values = np.log1p(frame[list(features)].clip(lower=0).to_numpy(dtype=float))
281:     preprocessor = Pipeline([("impute", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")), ("scale", StandardScaler())])
282:     training_values = preprocessor.fit_transform(values)
283:     selector = LogisticRegression(penalty="l1", solver="liblinear", C=0.1, class_weight="balanced", max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED)
284:     selector.fit(training_values, labels)
285:     ranking = np.argsort(-np.abs(selector.coef_[0]), kind="stable")[:SIGNATURE_SIZE]
286:     signature = tuple(features[index] for index in ranking)
287:     pipeline = Pipeline([("impute", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")), ("scale", StandardScaler()), ("model", LogisticRegression(solver="liblinear", class_weight="balanced", max_iter=5000, random_state=SEED))])
288:     search = GridSearchCV(pipeline, {"model__C": [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0]}, scoring="balanced_accuracy", cv=StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED), n_jobs=-1, error_score="raise")
289:     search.fit(np.log1p(frame[list(signature)].clip(lower=0)), labels)
290:     LOGGER.info("Frozen local signature: %s", ", ".join(signature))
291:     return search.best_estimator_, signature
292: 
293: 
294: def evaluate(model: Pipeline, frame: pd.DataFrame, labels: np.ndarray, signature: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict[str, float]:
295:     values = np.log1p(frame[list(signature)].clip(lower=0))
296:     probability = model.predict_proba(values)[:, 1]
297:     prediction = (probability >= 0.5).astype(int)
298:     tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(labels, prediction, labels=[0, 1]).ravel()
299:     return {
300:         "roc_auc": float(roc_auc_score(labels, probability)),
301:         "balanced_accuracy": float(balanced_accuracy_score(labels, prediction)),
302:         "sensitivity": float(tp / (tp + fn)) if tp + fn else np.nan,
303:         "specificity": float(tn / (tn + fp)) if tn + fp else np.nan,
304:     }
305: 
306: 
307: def geo_family_url(accession: str) -> str:
308:     range_subdir = re.sub(r"\d{1,3}$", "nnn", accession)
309:     return (
310:         "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/"
311:         f"{range_subdir}/{accession}/soft/{accession}_family.soft.gz"
312:     )
313: 
314: 
315: def download_one(accession: str, cache: Path) -> Path:
316:     """Download one GSE family file atomically, reusing completed cache files."""
317: 
318:     destination = cache / accession / f"{accession}_family.soft.gz"
319:     if destination.exists() and destination.stat().st_size > 0:
320:         LOGGER.info("[%s] using cached GEO file", accession)
321:         return destination
322:     destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
323:     temporary = destination.with_suffix(destination.suffix + ".part")
324:     temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
325:     LOGGER.info("[%s] downloading GEO family file", accession)
326:     request = urllib.request.Request(
327:         geo_family_url(accession),
328:         headers={"User-Agent": "ovai-bulk-geo-test/1.0"},
329:     )
330:     try:
331:         with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=180) as response, temporary.open("wb") as output:
332:             shutil.copyfileobj(response, output)
333:         if temporary.stat().st_size == 0:
334:             raise RuntimeError("downloaded file is empty")
335:         with gzip.open(temporary, "rb") as compressed:
336:             compressed.read(1)
337:         temporary.replace(destination)
338:     finally:
339:         temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
340:     return destination
341: 
342: 
343: def prefetch(accessions: list[str], cache: Path, workers: int) -> dict[str, Path | Exception]:
344:     """Prefetch GSE files concurrently before any model evaluation starts."""
345: 
346:     downloaded: dict[str, Path | Exception] = {}
347:     with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers, thread_name_prefix="geo-download") as pool:
348:         futures = {pool.submit(download_one, accession, cache): accession for accession in accessions}
349:         for future in as_completed(futures):
350:             accession = futures[future]
351:             try:
352:                 downloaded[accession] = future.result()
353:                 LOGGER.info("[%s] download ready", accession)
354:             except Exception as exc:
355:                 downloaded[accession] = exc
356:                 LOGGER.error("[%s] download failed: %s", accession, exc)
357:     return downloaded
358: 
359: 
360: def test_one(accession: str, model: Pipeline, signature: tuple[str, ...], source: Path | Exception) -> Result:
361:     try:
362:         if GEOparse is None:
363:             raise RuntimeError(f"GEOparse is unavailable: {GEOPARSE_IMPORT_ERROR}")
364:         if isinstance(source, Exception):
365:             raise RuntimeError(f"download failed: {source}") from source
366:         LOGGER.info("[%s] parsing cached GEO family file", accession)
367:         gse = GEOparse.get_GEO(filepath=str(source), geotype="GSE", silent=True, how="full")
368:         values, raw_labels = expression_frame(gse, signature)
369:         missing = tuple(feature for feature in signature if values[feature].notna().sum() == 0)
370:         if missing:
371:             return Result(accession, "Skipped: Missing Features", "Skipped: Missing Features", len(values), detail="Missing: " + ", ".join(missing), missing_features=missing)
372:         keep = np.array([label is not None for label in raw_labels]) & values[list(signature)].notna().any(axis=1).to_numpy()
373:         labels = np.array([raw_labels[index] for index, value in enumerate(keep) if value], dtype=int)
374:         values = values.loc[keep].copy()
375:         if len(labels) != len(values) or len(np.unique(labels)) != 2:
376:             return Result(accession, "Failed: Missing Labels", "Failed: Missing Labels", len(values), detail="Need both ovarian cancer and non-cancer labeled samples")
377:         metrics = evaluate(model, values, labels, signature)
378:         success = metrics["sensitivity"] > 0.50 and metrics["balanced_accuracy"] > 0.60
379:         recommendation = "Approved for Integration" if success else "Failed: Platform Shift / 0% Sensitivity"
380:         status = "SUCCESSFULLY COMPATIBLE" if success else "FAILED"
381:         return Result(accession, status, recommendation, len(values), len(labels), **metrics)
382:     except Exception as exc:
383:         LOGGER.exception("[%s] failed", accession)
384:         return Result(accession, "Failed: Download or Parse Error", "Failed: Download or Parse Error", detail=str(exc))
385: 
386: 
387: def write_report(path: Path, results: list[Result], signature: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
388:     priority = {"SUCCESSFULLY COMPATIBLE": 0, "FAILED": 1, "Skipped: Missing Features": 2}
389:     ordered = sorted(results, key=lambda result: (priority.get(result.status, 3), result.accession))
390:     lines = [
391:         "# Bulk External GEO Dataset Test Results", "",
392:         "Evaluation uses the complete local GSE94533 Stage I/II cancer versus benign/control cohort. The model is a regularized logistic regression with local median imputation and scaling; external labels are never used for fitting or tuning.", "",
393:         f"- Candidates tested: {len(results)}", f"- Frozen five-miRNA signature: `{', '.join(signature)}`", "- Success rule: sensitivity > 50% and balanced accuracy > 60%.", "",
394:         "| GSE | Status | Recommendation | N evaluated | ROC-AUC | Balanced Accuracy | Sensitivity | Specificity | Detail |",
395:         "|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|",
396:     ]
397:     for result in ordered:
398:         def metric(value: float | None) -> str:
399:             return f"{value:.3f}" if value is not None and np.isfinite(value) else "-"
400:         detail = result.detail.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")
401:         lines.append(f"| {result.accession} | {result.status} | {result.recommendation} | {result.labeled_count or '-'} | {metric(result.roc_auc)} | {metric(result.balanced_accuracy)} | {metric(result.sensitivity)} | {metric(result.specificity)} | {detail} |")
402:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
403:     path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
404: 
405: 
406: def main() -> int:
407:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
408:     parser.add_argument("--input-report", type=Path, default=REPORT_INPUT)
409:     parser.add_argument("--output-report", type=Path, default=REPORT_OUTPUT)
410:     parser.add_argument("--cache-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CACHE)
411:     parser.add_argument("--top-n", type=int, default=10, help="Test the top N candidates by reported sample count.")
412:     parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, help="Deprecated alias for --top-n.")
413:     parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=DEFAULT_WORKERS, help="Concurrent GEO download workers (default: 3).")
414:     parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
415:     args = parser.parse_args()
416:     logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
417:     if args.top_n < 1:
418:         raise ValueError("--top-n must be positive")
419:     if args.limit is not None:
420:         if args.limit < 1:
421:             raise ValueError("--limit must be positive")
422:         args.top_n = args.limit
423:     if args.workers < 1 or args.workers > 3:
424:         raise ValueError("--workers must be between 1 and 3 to respect NCBI request limits")
425:     candidates = sorted(
426:         read_candidates(args.input_report),
427:         key=lambda candidate: (candidate.sample_count is not None, candidate.sample_count or -1),
428:         reverse=True,
429:     )
430:     selected = candidates[:args.top_n]
431:     accessions = [candidate.accession for candidate in selected]
432:     LOGGER.info("Selected top %d candidates by reported sample count: %s", len(accessions), ", ".join(accessions))
433:     frame, labels, features = load_local_training()
434:     model, signature = fit_model(frame, labels, features)
435:     downloaded = prefetch(accessions, args.cache_dir, args.workers)
436:     results: list[Result] = []
437:     for index, accession in enumerate(accessions, start=1):
438:         LOGGER.info("[%d/%d] testing %s", index, len(accessions), accession)
439:         result = test_one(accession, model, signature, downloaded[accession])
440:         results.append(result)
441:     write_report(args.output_report, results, signature)
442:     LOGGER.info("Wrote %s", args.output_report)
443:     return 0
444: 
445: 
446: if __name__ == "__main__":
447:     try:
448:         raise SystemExit(main())
449:     except Exception as exc:
450:         LOGGER.error("Bulk GEO test failed: %s", exc)
451:         raise SystemExit(2) from exc

43: def norm_id(value) -> str:
44:     s = str(value).strip().lower()
45: 
46:     if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0+", s):
47:         s = s.split(".", 1)[0]
48: 
49:     return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s)

53: # DOCX TABLE EXTRACTION
54: # ================================================================
55: 
56: def extract_docx_tables(path: Path):
57: 
58:     with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
59:         xml = z.read("word/document.xml")
60: 
61:     root = ET.fromstring(xml)
62: 
63:     tables = []
64: 
65:     for tbl in root.iter():
66: 
67:         if not tbl.tag.endswith("}tbl"):
68:             continue
69: 
70:         rows = []
71: 
72:         for tr in tbl:
73: 
74:             if not tr.tag.endswith("}tr"):
75:                 continue
76: 
77:             cells = []
78: 
79:             for tc in tr:
80: 
81:                 if not tc.tag.endswith("}tc"):
82:                     continue
83: 
84:                 texts = []
85: 
86:                 for node in tc.iter():
87: 
88:                     if node.tag.endswith("}t"):
89:                         texts.append(node.text or "")
90: 
91:                 cells.append(
92:                     "".join(texts).strip()
93:                 )
94: 
95:             if cells:
96:                 rows.append(cells)
97: 
98:         if rows:
99:             tables.append(rows)
100: 
101:     return tables

113:

116:                 for x in row
117:             }

120:                 "id",
121:                 "study",
122:                 "stage",
123:                 "histology",
124:                 "nn",
125:             }.issubset(normalized):
126:

130:                     f"{table_number}."

137:     )

149:         "stage",

170:             break

173:         print()

179:             print(f"{i}: {row}")
180:

182:             "Could not locate Table 2 header row."
183:         )
184: 
185:     return best

### scripts\diagnose_external_feature_firewall.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """Audit cached GEO cohorts against the frozen five-miRNA firewall.
3: 
4: This diagnostic does not fit a model and never uses external labels. It only
5: records whether the frozen features and a broad expression matrix are present,
6: which distinguishes direct feature salvage from a required rank-transform
7: experiment.
8: """
9: 
10: from __future__ import annotations
11: 
12: import argparse
13: import logging
14: import re
15: import warnings
16: from dataclasses import dataclass
17: from pathlib import Path
18: from typing import Any
19: 
20: import GEOparse
21: import numpy as np
22: import pandas as pd
23: 
24: warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)
25: warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=pd.errors.DtypeWarning)
26: 
27: PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
28: DEFAULT_CACHE = PROJECT / "data" / "raw" / "geo"
29: DEFAULT_QUEUE = PROJECT / "reports" / "potential_external_datasets.md"
30: DEFAULT_OUTPUT = PROJECT / "reports" / "external_feature_firewall_diagnostic.md"
31: SIGNATURE = (
32:     "hsa-miR-200b-3p",
33:     "hsa-miR-296-3p",
34:     "hsa-miR-6826-5p",
35:     "hsa-miR-32-3p",
36:     "hsa-miR-1255a",
37: )
38: LOGGER = logging.getLogger("ovai.feature_firewall")
39: 
40: 
41: @dataclass(frozen=True)
42: class Audit:
43:     accession: str
44:     cached: bool
45:     samples: int = 0
46:     nonempty_samples: int = 0
47:     feature_count: int = 0
48:     present: tuple[str, ...] = ()
49:     missing: tuple[str, ...] = SIGNATURE
50:     decision: str = "Not cached"
51:     detail: str = ""
52: 
53: 
54: def normalize(value: Any) -> str:
55:     return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", str(value).lower())
56: 
57: 
58: def read_queue(path: Path) -> list[str]:
59:     pattern = re.compile(r"^\|\s*(GSE\d+)\s*\|", re.IGNORECASE)
60:     accessions = [
61:         match.group(1).upper()
62:         for line in path.read_text().splitlines()
63:         if (match := pattern.match(line))
64:     ]
65:     return list(dict.fromkeys(accessions))
66: 
67: 
68: def cached_path(cache: Path, accession: str) -> Path:
69:     return cache / accession / f"{accession}_family.soft.gz"
70: 
71: 
72: def expression_identifiers(gse: Any) -> tuple[set[str], int, int, int]:
73:     identifiers: set[str] = set()
74:     nonempty = 0
75:     row_counts: list[int] = []
76:     for sample in (getattr(gse, "gsms", {}) or {}).values():
77:         table = getattr(sample, "table", None)
78:         if not isinstance(table, pd.DataFrame) or table.empty or table.shape[1] == 0:
79:             continue
80:         nonempty += 1
81:         row_counts.append(table.shape[0])
82:         identifiers.update(normalize(value) for value in table.iloc[:, 0].astype(str))
83:     median_rows = int(np.median(row_counts)) if row_counts else 0
84:     return identifiers, nonempty, median_rows, max(row_counts, default=0)
85: 
86: 
87: def platform_identifiers(gse: Any) -> tuple[set[str], int]:
88:     identifiers: set[str] = set()
89:     feature_count = 0
90:     for platform in (getattr(gse, "gpls", {}) or {}).values():
91:         table = getattr(platform, "table", None)
92:         if not isinstance(table, pd.DataFrame) or table.empty or table.shape[1] == 0:
93:             continue
94:         feature_count = max(feature_count, len(table))
95:         for value in table.astype(str).to_numpy().ravel():
96:             identifiers.add(normalize(value))
97:     return identifiers, feature_count
98: 
99: 
100: def audit_one(accession: str, cache: Path) -> Audit:
101:     path = cached_path(cache, accession)
102:     if not path.exists() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
103:         return Audit(accession=accession, cached=False)
104:     try:
105:         LOGGER.info("Auditing %s", accession)
106:         gse = GEOparse.get_GEO(filepath=str(path), geotype="GSE", silent=True, how="full")
107:         sample_ids, nonempty, median_rows, max_rows = expression_identifiers(gse)
108:         platform_ids, platform_count = platform_identifiers(gse)
109:         available = sample_ids | platform_ids
110:         present = tuple(feature for feature in SIGNATURE if any(normalize(feature) in identifier for identifier in available))
111:         missing = tuple(feature for feature in SIGNATURE if feature not in present)
112:         feature_count = max(platform_count, median_rows, max_rows)
113:         if not nonempty:
114:             decision = "No expression matrix; cannot salvage raw features"
115:         elif not missing and feature_count >= 100:
116:             decision = "Broad panel with exact signature; prioritize within-patient rank transform"
117:         elif not missing:
118:             decision = "Exact signature present; direct feature salvage is plausible"
119:         elif feature_count >= 100:
120:             decision = "Broad panel but incomplete signature; rank transform may be salvageable"
121:         else:
122:             decision = "Incompatible Feature Space"
123:         return Audit(
124:             accession=accession,
125:             cached=True,
126:             samples=len(getattr(gse, "gsms", {}) or {}),
127:             nonempty_samples=nonempty,
128:             feature_count=feature_count,
129:             present=present,
130:             missing=missing,
131:             decision=decision,
132:             detail=f"median expression rows/sample={median_rows}; platform rows={platform_count}",
133:         )
134:     except Exception as exc:
135:         LOGGER.exception("Could not audit %s", accession)
136:         return Audit(accession=accession, cached=True, decision="Parse error", detail=str(exc))
137: 
138: 
139: def write_report(path: Path, audits: list[Audit]) -> None:
140:     lines = [
141:         "# External Feature Validation Firewall Diagnostic",
142:         "",
143:         f"Frozen signature: `{', '.join(SIGNATURE)}`.",
144:         "This is a structural cache audit only. It does not establish assay equivalence or clinical validity.",
145:         "",
146:         "| GSE | Cached | Samples | Non-empty GSMs | Matrix features | Exact signature | Missing features | Decision | Detail |",
147:         "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|",
148:     ]
149:     for audit in audits:
150:         present = ", ".join(audit.present) or "None"
151:         missing = ", ".join(audit.missing) or "None"
152:         detail = audit.detail.replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")
153:         lines.append(
154:             f"| {audit.accession} | {'yes' if audit.cached else 'no'} | {audit.samples or '-'} | "
155:             f"{audit.nonempty_samples or '-'} | {audit.feature_count or '-'} | {present} | {missing} | "
156:             f"{audit.decision} | {detail} |"
157:         )
158:     lines.extend([
159:         "",
160:         "## Interpretation",
161:         "",
162:         "- A broad panel with all five frozen features is not a restricted-subset failure; it is a candidate for a prespecified within-patient rank-transform experiment because rank order can reduce platform-scale dependence.",
163:         "- A cohort without an expression table cannot be salvaged from its family SOFT file alone; obtain its series matrix or processed supplementary matrix first.",
164:         "- Missing frozen features block direct Phase 8 evaluation. A broad alternative panel may still support a separate rank-based model, but it must not be silently substituted into the frozen signature.",
165:     ])
166:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
167:     path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
168: 
169: 
170: def main() -> int:
171:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
172:     parser.add_argument("--cache-dir", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_CACHE)
173:     parser.add_argument("--queue", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_QUEUE)
174:     parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT)
175:     parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
176:     args = parser.parse_args()
177:     logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
178:     audits = [audit_one(accession, args.cache_dir) for accession in read_queue(args.queue)]
179:     write_report(args.output, audits)
180:     LOGGER.info("Wrote %s", args.output)
181:     return 0
182: 
183: 
184: if __name__ == "__main__":
185:     raise SystemExit(main())

### scripts\evaluate_gse106817_external.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: """Evaluate the frozen GSE94533 miRNA model on independent serum GSE106817."""
4: 
5: import csv
