47: def download(url, path):
48:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
49:     if not path.exists():
50:         path.write_bytes(urlopen(url, timeout=180).read())
51: 
52: 
53: def parse_series(path):
54:     metadata = {}
55:     lines = gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").readlines()
56:     start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith("!series_matrix_table_begin"))
57:     for line in lines[:start]:
58:         if line.startswith("!Sample_"):
59:             parts = next(csv.reader([line.rstrip("\n")], delimiter="\t", quotechar='"'))
60:             metadata[parts[0]] = parts[1:]
61:     table = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO("".join(lines[start + 1:])), sep="\t", comment="!", quotechar='"')
62:     table = table.rename(columns={table.columns[0]: "feature_id"})
63:     table = table[table.feature_id.notna() & (table.feature_id != "!series_matrix_table_end")]
64:     return metadata, table
65: 
66: 
67: def platform_names(path):
68:     names = {}
69:     started = False
70:     for line in path.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
71:         if line.startswith("!platform_table_begin"):
72:             started = True
73:             continue
74:         if started and line.startswith("!platform_table_end"):
75:             break
76:         if started:
77:             parts = re.split(r"\s+", line.strip())
78:             if len(parts) >= 3:
79:                 names[parts[0]] = parts[2]
80:     return names
81: 
82: 
83: def main():
84:     download(
85:         "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE106nnn/GSE106817/matrix/GSE106817_series_matrix.txt.gz",
86:         RAW,
87:     )
88:     download(
89:         "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?targ=self&acc=GPL21263&form=text&view=full",
90:         PLATFORM,
91:     )
92:     metadata, table = parse_series(RAW)
93:     names = platform_names(PLATFORM)
94:     feature_by_name = {name: feature for feature, name in names.items()}
95:     if "hsa-miR-203a-3p" in feature_by_name:
96:         feature_by_name["hsa-miR-203a"] = feature_by_name["hsa-miR-203a-3p"]
97:     missing = [name for name in MIRNAS if name not in feature_by_name]
98:     if missing:
99:         raise RuntimeError(f"Missing external platform features: {missing}")
100:     sample_ids = metadata["!Sample_geo_accession"]
101:     titles = metadata["!Sample_title"]
102:     values = table.set_index("feature_id").loc[
103:         [feature_by_name[name] for name in MIRNAS]
104:     ].T
105:     values.index = sample_ids
106:     values.columns = MIRNAS
107:     labels = []
108:     keep = []
109:     for sample_id, title in zip(sample_ids, titles):
110:         if re.match(r"^Ovarian Cancer\b", title, re.I):
111:             keep.append(sample_id)
112:             labels.append(1)
113:         elif re.match(r"^(?:Non-Cancer|Benign Ovarian Disease)\b", title, re.I):
114:             keep.append(sample_id)
115:             labels.append(0)
116:     external = values.loc[keep].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
117:     y_external = np.asarray(labels, dtype=int)
118: 
119:     train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN)
120:     X_train = np.log1p(train[MIRNAS].clip(lower=0))
121:     y_train = train["binary_label"].astype(int)
122:     grids = {
123:         "standard_scale": (StandardScaler(), "standard_scale"),
124:         "train_fitted_quantile": (
125:             QuantileTransformer(
126:                 output_distribution="normal",
127:                 n_quantiles=min(100, len(X_train)),
128:                 random_state=42,
129:             ),
130:             "train_fitted_quantile",
131:         ),
132:     }
133:     results = {
134:         "training_cohort": "GSE94533",
135:         "external_cohort": "GSE106817",
136:         "endpoint": "ovarian cancer vs non-cancer or benign ovarian disease",
137:         "patients": int(len(external)),
138:         "cancer": int(y_external.sum()),
139:         "non_cancer": int((y_external == 0).sum()),
140:         "features": MIRNAS,
141:         "platform": "GPL21263 3D-Gene Human miRNA V21",
142:         "combat": "not applied: external test must remain untouched",
143:     }
144:     for name, (transformer, normalization) in grids.items():
145:         pipeline = Pipeline([
146:             ("impute", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
147:             ("normalize", transformer),
148:             ("select", SelectKBest(f_classif)),
149:             ("model", LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000, solver="liblinear")),
150:         ])
151:         search = GridSearchCV(
152:             pipeline,
153:             {
154:                 "select__k": [5, 10, 14, "all"],
155:                 "model__C": [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0],
156:                 "model__class_weight": [None, "balanced"],
157:             },
158:             scoring="balanced_accuracy",
159:             cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42),
160:             refit=True, n_jobs=-1,
161:         )
162:         search.fit(X_train, y_train)
163:         probability = search.predict_proba(np.log1p(external.clip(lower=0)))[:, 1]
164:         train_probability = cross_val_predict(
165:             search.best_estimator_, X_train, y_train,
166:             cv=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=43),
167:             method="predict_proba", n_jobs=-1,
168:         )[:, 1]
169:         thresholds = np.linspace(0.10, 0.90, 81)
170:         threshold = max(
171:             thresholds,
172:             key=lambda candidate: balanced_accuracy_score(
173:                 y_train, (train_probability >= candidate).astype(int)
174:             ),
175:         )
176:         prediction = (probability >= threshold).astype(int)
177:         tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y_external, prediction).ravel()
178:         results[name] = {
179:             "normalization": normalization,
180:             "best_params": search.best_params_,
181:             "frozen_threshold": float(threshold),
182:             "accuracy": float(accuracy_score(y_external, prediction)),
183:             "balanced_accuracy": float(balanced_accuracy_score(y_external, prediction)),
184:             "roc_auc": float(roc_auc_score(y_external, probability)),
185:             "sensitivity": float(tp / (tp + fn)),
186:             "specificity": float(tn / (tn + fp)),
187:             "confusion_matrix": {"tn": int(tn), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn), "tp": int(tp)},
188:         }
189:     OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
190:     OUT.write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + "\n")
191:     print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
192: 
193: 
194: if __name__ == "__main__":
195:     main()

### scripts\evaluate_gse106817_phase5.py

65:     start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith("!series_matrix_table_begin"))
66:     metadata = {}
67:     for line in lines[:start]:
68:         if line.startswith("!Sample_"):
69:             parts = next(csv.reader([line.rstrip("\n")], delimiter="\t", quotechar='"'))
70:             metadata[parts[0]] = parts[1:]
71:     table = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO("".join(lines[start + 1:])), sep="\t", comment="!", quotechar='"')
72:     table = table.rename(columns={table.columns[0]: "feature_id"})
73:     table = table[table.feature_id.notna() & (table.feature_id != "!series_matrix_table_end")]
74:     names = {}
75:     inside = False
76:     for line in GPL21263.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
77:         if line.startswith("!platform_table_begin"):

87:     if "hsa-miR-203a-3p" in feature_by_name:
88:         feature_by_name["hsa-miR-203a"] = feature_by_name["hsa-miR-203a-3p"]
89:     missing = [name for name in MIRNAS if name not in feature_by_name]
90:     if missing:
91:         raise RuntimeError(f"Missing GSE106817 features: {missing}")
92:     sample_ids = metadata["!Sample_geo_accession"]
93:     titles = metadata["!Sample_title"]
94:     keep = []
95:     labels = []
96:     groups = {"cancer": 0, "benign": 0, "borderline": 0, "control": 0, "other": 0}
97:     for sample_id, title in zip(sample_ids, titles):
98:         if re.match(r"^Ovarian Cancer\b", title, re.I):
99:             keep.append(sample_id)
100:             labels.append(1)
101:             groups["cancer"] += 1
102:         elif re.match(r"^Benign Ovarian Disease\b", title, re.I):
103:             keep.append(sample_id)
104:             labels.append(0)
105:             groups["benign"] += 1
106:         elif re.match(r"^Borderline Ovarian Tumor\b", title, re.I):
107:             groups["borderline"] += 1
108:         elif re.match(r"^Non-Cancer\b", title, re.I):
109:             keep.append(sample_id)
110:             labels.append(0)
111:             groups["control"] += 1
112:         else:
113:             groups["other"] += 1
114:     matrix = table.set_index("feature_id").loc[[feature_by_name[name] for name in MIRNAS], keep].T
115:     matrix.columns = MIRNAS
116:     return matrix.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce"), np.asarray(labels, dtype=int), groups

118: 
119: def transform_pair(train: pd.DataFrame, test: pd.DataFrame, mode: str) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
120:     train_values = train.to_numpy(dtype=float)
121:     test_values = test.to_numpy(dtype=float)
122:     if mode.endswith("_values"):
123:         if mode == "log1p_values":
124:             train_values = np.log1p(np.clip(train_values, 0, None))
125:             test_values = np.log1p(np.clip(test_values, 0, None))
126:         return train_values, test_values
127:     if mode.startswith("within_dataset"):
128:         train_values = np.log1p(np.clip(train_values, 0, None))
129:         test_values = np.log1p(np.clip(test_values, 0, None))
130:         transformer = StandardScaler() if mode.endswith("standard") else QuantileTransformer(
131:             output_distribution="normal", n_quantiles=min(100, len(train_values)), random_state=SEED
132:         )
133:         return transformer.fit_transform(train_values), transformer.fit_transform(test_values)
134:     train_values = np.log1p(np.clip(train_values, 0, None))
135:     test_values = np.log1p(np.clip(test_values, 0, None))
136:     transformer = StandardScaler() if mode.endswith("standard") else QuantileTransformer(
137:         output_distribution="normal", n_quantiles=min(100, len(train_values)), random_state=SEED
138:     )
139:     return transformer.fit_transform(train_values), transformer.transform(test_values)
140: 
141: 
142: def choose_c_and_threshold(X: pd.DataFrame, y: np.ndarray, mode: str) -> tuple[float, float, np.ndarray]:
143:     outer = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
144:     cv_scores = {c: [] for c in C_GRID}
145:     oof_by_c = {c: np.full(len(y), np.nan) for c in C_GRID}
146:     for train_idx, validation_idx in outer.split(X, y):
147:         for c in C_GRID:
148:             train_values, validation_values = transform_pair(X.iloc[train_idx], X.iloc[validation_idx], mode)
149:             model = LogisticRegression(C=c, class_weight="balanced", solver="liblinear", max_iter=5000)
150:             model.fit(train_values, y[train_idx])
151:             probability = model.predict_proba(validation_values)[:, 1]
152:             oof_by_c[c][validation_idx] = probability
153:             cv_scores[c].append(roc_auc_score(y[validation_idx], probability))
154:     best_c = max(C_GRID, key=lambda c: (np.mean(cv_scores[c]), -abs(np.log10(c) - np.log10(0.3))))
155:     source_probability = oof_by_c[best_c]
156:     threshold = max(
157:         THRESHOLDS,
158:         key=lambda candidate: balanced_accuracy_score(y, source_probability >= candidate),
159:     )
160:     return float(best_c), float(threshold), source_probability
161: 
162: 
163: def metrics(y: np.ndarray, probability: np.ndarray, threshold: float) -> dict[str, object]:
164:     prediction = (probability >= threshold).astype(int)
165:     tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y, prediction, labels=[0, 1]).ravel()
166:     return {
167:         "n": int(len(y)),
168:         "positive": int(y.sum()),
169:         "negative": int((y == 0).sum()),
170:         "roc_auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, probability)),
171:         "pr_auc": float(average_precision_score(y, probability)),
172:         "accuracy": float(accuracy_score(y, prediction)),
173:         "balanced_accuracy": float(balanced_accuracy_score(y, prediction)),
174:         "sensitivity": float(tp / (tp + fn)) if tp + fn else None,
175:         "specificity": float(tn / (tn + fp)) if tn + fp else None,
176:         "brier_score": float(brier_score_loss(y, probability)),
177:         "threshold": float(threshold),
178:         "confusion_matrix": {"tn": int(tn), "fp": int(fp), "fn": int(fn), "tp": int(tp)},
179:     }
180: 
181: 
182: def run_direction(train_name: str, train_X: pd.DataFrame, train_y: np.ndarray, test_name: str, test_X: pd.DataFrame, test_y: np.ndarray) -> tuple[list[dict[str, object]], list[pd.DataFrame]]:
183:     results = []
184:     prediction_rows = []
185:     for mode in MODES:
186:         best_c, threshold, source_probability = choose_c_and_threshold(train_X, train_y, mode)
187:         train_values, test_values = transform_pair(train_X, test_X, mode)
188:         model = LogisticRegression(C=best_c, class_weight="balanced", solver="liblinear", max_iter=5000)
189:         model.fit(train_values, train_y)
190:         probability = model.predict_proba(test_values)[:, 1]
191:         result = {
192:             "experiment": "A" if train_name == "GSE94533" else "B",
193:             "train_dataset": train_name,
194:             "test_dataset": test_name,
195:             "normalization": mode,
196:             "best_C_source_only": best_c,
197:             "source_threshold": threshold,
198:             **metrics(test_y, probability, threshold),
199:         }
200:         results.append(result)
201:         prediction_rows.append(pd.DataFrame({
202:             "experiment": result["experiment"],
203:             "train_dataset": train_name,
204:             "test_dataset": test_name,
205:             "normalization": mode,
206:             "sample_index": np.arange(len(test_y)),
207:             "true_label": test_y,
208:             "probability": probability,
209:             "threshold": threshold,
210:             "prediction": (probability >= threshold).astype(int),
211:         }))
212:     return results, prediction_rows
213: 
214: 
215: def main() -> None:
216:     gse94533_X, gse94533_y = load_gse94533()
217:     gse106817_X, gse106817_y, external_groups = load_gse106817()
218:     results_a, predictions_a = run_direction("GSE94533", gse94533_X, gse94533_y, "GSE106817", gse106817_X, gse106817_y)
219:     results_b, predictions_b = run_direction("GSE106817", gse106817_X, gse106817_y, "GSE94533", gse94533_X, gse94533_y)
220:     distributions = []
221:     for feature in MIRNAS:
222:         source = np.log1p(np.clip(gse94533_X[feature].to_numpy(), 0, None))
223:         target = np.log1p(np.clip(gse106817_X[feature].to_numpy(), 0, None))
224:         ks = ks_2samp(source, target)
225:         distributions.append({
226:             "feature": feature,
227:             "gse94533_median_log1p": float(np.median(source)),
228:             "gse106817_median_log1p": float(np.median(target)),
229:             "median_shift_log1p_gse106817_minus_gse94533": float(np.median(target) - np.median(source)),
230:             "ks_statistic": float(ks.statistic),
231:             "ks_pvalue": float(ks.pvalue),
232:         })
233:     result_payload = {
234:         "shared_features": MIRNAS,
235:         "experiments": results_a + results_b,
236:         "experiment_C": {
237:             "status": "not_distinctly_executable",
238:             "compatible_datasets_available": ["GSE94533", "GSE106817"],
239:             "reason": "Only two compatible serum-miRNA datasets are available. Pooling both and holding one out is identical to Experiments A and B; there is no third dataset to rotate.",
240:         },
241:         "external_groups": external_groups,
242:         "preprocessing_rule": "All model selection, transforms, source thresholds, and hyperparameters use training data only. External labels are never used for preprocessing or selection.",
243:     }
244:     OUT_RESULTS.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
245:     OUT_RESULTS.write_text(json.dumps(result_payload, indent=2) + "\n")
246:     pd.concat(predictions_a + predictions_b, ignore_index=True).to_csv(OUT_PREDICTIONS, index=False)
247:     pd.DataFrame(distributions).to_csv(OUT_DISTRIBUTIONS, index=False)
248:     lines = [
249:         "# Phase 5: GSE106817 Bidirectional Validation",
250:         "",
251:         "This evaluation uses only shared historical miRNAs and never uses external test labels for preprocessing, model selection, normalization, or threshold selection.",
252:         "",
253:         "## Experiment A: GSE94533 -> GSE106817",
254:         "",
255:     ]
256:     for row in results_a:
257:         lines.append(f"- `{row['normalization']}`: ROC-AUC {row['roc_auc']:.4f}, balanced accuracy {row['balanced_accuracy']:.4f}, sensitivity {row['sensitivity']:.4f}, specificity {row['specificity']:.4f}, threshold {row['source_threshold']:.2f}.")
258:     lines.extend(["", "## Experiment B: GSE106817 -> GSE94533", ""])
259:     for row in results_b:
260:         lines.append(f"- `{row['normalization']}`: ROC-AUC {row['roc_auc']:.4f}, balanced accuracy {row['balanced_accuracy']:.4f}, sensitivity {row['sensitivity']:.4f}, specificity {row['specificity']:.4f}, threshold {row['source_threshold']:.2f}.")
261:     lines.extend([
262:         "",
263:         "## Experiment C: Pooled Leave-One-Dataset-Out",
264:         "",
265:         "Only two compatible serum-miRNA datasets are available. A pooled train/held-out rotation with these two datasets is exactly Experiments A and B, so no additional pooled result is reported as if it were an independent third rotation.",
266:         "",
267:         "## Experiment D: Platform Shift",
268:         "",
269:         "The distribution table compares log1p shared-miRNA values using medians and two-sample KS statistics. The raw, within-dataset, training-derived, and quantile modes are evaluated above. Within-dataset normalization uses unlabeled target feature distributions and is therefore explicitly labeled transductive; it does not use target labels.",
270:         "",
271:         "The external cohort remains untouched. A high ranking score with a failed source-derived threshold is reported as threshold/platform failure, not hidden or converted into diagnostic success.",
272:         "",
273:         "Machine-readable outputs: `reports/gse106817_phase5_results.json`, `reports/gse106817_phase5_predictions.csv`, and `reports/gse106817_phase5_distribution.csv`.",
274:     ])
275:     OUT_REPORT.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
276:     print(f"Saved {OUT_REPORT}")
277:     print(f"Saved {OUT_RESULTS}")
278:     print(f"Saved {OUT_PREDICTIONS}")
279:     print(f"Saved {OUT_DISTRIBUTIONS}")
280: 
281: 
282: if __name__ == "__main__":
283:     main()

### scripts\extract_original_14mirna_model.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: """
4: Extract the exact 14-miRNA feature set from the original eLife
5: GSE94533 neural-network PMML and compare it against our cleaned
6: 179-patient dataset.
7: 
8: This script DOES NOT train a new model.
9: 
10: It establishes:
11: 
12:     original PMML
13:           |
14:           v
15:     exact input features
16:           |
17:           v
18:     cleaned GSE94533 matrix
19:           |
20:           v
21:     availability / name-matching audit
22: 
23: The purpose is to prevent accidental "near reproduction" where
24: similar-looking miRNA names are substituted for the original inputs.
25: """
26: 
27: from __future__ import annotations
28: 
29: import json
30: import re
31: from pathlib import Path
32: from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
33: 
34: import pandas as pd
35: 
36: 
37: # ================================================================
38: # PATHS
39: # ================================================================
40: 
41: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
42: 
43: CODE_ROOT = (
44:     ROOT
45:     / "data"
46:     / "external"
47:     / "elife-28932-code1"
48: )
49: 
50: MATRIX_PATH = (
51:     ROOT
52:     / "data"
53:     / "processed"
54:     / "gse94533_mirna_tpm.csv.gz"
55: )
56: 
57: OUTPUT_DIR = (
58:     ROOT
59:     / "reports"
60:     / "tables"
61: )
62: 
63: FEATURE_OUTPUT = (
64:     OUTPUT_DIR
65:     / "original_14_mirna_features.json"
66: )
67: 
68: AUDIT_OUTPUT = (
69:     OUTPUT_DIR
70:     / "original_14_mirna_feature_audit.json"
71: )
72: 
73: 
74: # ================================================================
75: # NORMALIZATION
76: # ================================================================
77: 
78: def normalize_mirna_name(value: object) -> str:
79: 
80:     if value is None:
81:         return ""
82: 
83:     value = str(value).strip().lower()
84: 
85:     # Normalize unicode dashes to ordinary hyphens.
86:     value = (
87:         value
88:         .replace("–", "-")
89:         .replace("—", "-")
90:         .replace("−", "-")
91:     )
92: 
93:     # Remove whitespace.
94:     value = re.sub(r"\s+", "", value)
95: 
96:     return value
97: 
98: 
99: # ================================================================
100: # FIND PMML
101: # ================================================================
102: 
103: def find_pmml() -> Path:
104: 
105:     candidates = sorted(
106:         CODE_ROOT.rglob("*.xml")
107:     )
108: 
109:     if not candidates:
110: 
111:         raise RuntimeError(
112:             "No XML/PMML file was found inside:\n"
113:             f"{CODE_ROOT}\n\n"
114:             "The original eLife source-code archive may not have "
115:             "been extracted correctly."
116:         )
117: 
118:     print()
119:     print("=" * 90)
120:     print("PMML FILES FOUND")
121:     print("=" * 90)
122: 
123:     for path in candidates:
124:         print(f"  {path}")
125: 
126:     # Prefer Source-code1.xml.
127:     for path in candidates:
128: 
129:         if path.name.lower() == "source-code1.xml":
130:             return path
131: 
132:     return candidates[0]
133: 
134: 
135: # ================================================================
136: # EXTRACT PMML INFORMATION
137: # ================================================================
138: 
139: def extract_pmml_features(
140:     pmml_path: Path,
141: ) -> dict:
142: 
143:     print()
144:     print("=" * 90)
145:     print("READING ORIGINAL eLIFE PMML")
146:     print("=" * 90)
147: 
148:     print()
149:     print(f"PMML: {pmml_path}")
150: 
151:     tree = ET.parse(
152:         pmml_path
153:     )
154: 
155:     root = tree.getroot()
156: 
157:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
158:     # Find all fields referenced by the neural network.
159:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
160: 
161:     neural_networks = []
162: 
163:     for element in root.iter():
164: 
165:         if element.tag.endswith(
166:             "NeuralNetwork"
167:         ):
168: 
169:             neural_networks.append(
170:                 element
171:             )
172: 
173:     print()
174:     print(
175:         f"Neural networks found: "
176:         f"{len(neural_networks)}"
177:     )
178: 
179:     if not neural_networks:
180: 
181:         raise RuntimeError(
182:             "No NeuralNetwork element was found in the PMML."
183:         )
184: 
185:     for i, network in enumerate(
186:         neural_networks,
187:         1,
188:     ):
189: 
190:         print()
191:         print(
192:             f"Network {i}: "
193:             f"modelName={network.attrib.get('modelName')!r}"
194:         )
195: 
196:     # The original sequencing network is the one with 14 inputs and
197:     # seven hidden neurons. We therefore inspect all networks and
198:     # identify candidate input fields.
199: 
200:     network_info = []
201: 
202:     for network in neural_networks:
203: 
204:         name = network.attrib.get(
205:             "modelName",
206:             "",
207:         )
208: 
209:         fields = []
210: 
211:         for element in network.iter():
212: 
213:             # PMML namespace prefixes vary, so inspect local name.
214:             local = (
215:                 element.tag
216:                 .split("}")[-1]
217:             )
218: 
219:             if local == "DerivedField":
220: 
221:                 field_name = (
222:                     element.attrib.get("name")
223:                 )
224: 
225:                 if field_name:
226:                     fields.append(
227:                         field_name
228:                     )
229: 
230:             elif local == "MiningField":
231: 
232:                 field_name = (
233:                     element.attrib.get("name")
234:                 )
235: 
236:                 if field_name:
237:                     fields.append(
238:                         field_name
239:                     )
240: 
241:         network_info.append(
242:             {
243:                 "model_name": name,
244:                 "fields": list(
245:                     dict.fromkeys(fields)
246:                 ),
247:             }
248:         )
249: 
250:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
251:     # Search the entire XML text for all likely miRNA names.
252:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
253: 
254:     xml_text = pmml_path.read_text(
255:         encoding="utf-8",
256:         errors="replace",
257:     )
258: 
259:     mirna_pattern = re.compile(
260:         r"(?:hsa[-_]?)?"
261:         r"miR[-_]"
262:         r"[0-9A-Za-z]+"
263:         r"(?:[-_][0-9A-Za-z]+)*"
264:         r"(?:\*)?",
265:         re.IGNORECASE,
266:     )
267: 
268:     raw_matches = mirna_pattern.findall(
269:         xml_text
270:     )
271: 
272:     mirna_matches = []
273: 
274:     seen = set()
275: 
276:     for match in raw_matches:
277: 
278:         normalized = normalize_mirna_name(
279:             match
280:         )
281: 
282:         if normalized and normalized not in seen:
283: 
284:             seen.add(normalized)
285: 
286:             mirna_matches.append(
287:                 match
288:             )
289: 
290:     print()
291:     print("miRNA-like identifiers found in PMML:")
292: 
293:     for feature in mirna_matches:
294: 
295:         print(
296:             f"  {feature}"
297:         )
298: 
299:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
300:     # Extract names from <DerivedField> elements as well.
301:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
302: 
303:     all_named_fields = []
304: 
305:     for element in root.iter():
306: 
307:         local = (
308:             element.tag
309:             .split("}")[-1]
310:         )
311: 
312:         if local in {
313:             "DerivedField",
314:             "MiningField",
315:             "OutputField",
316:         }:
317: 
318:             name = (
319:                 element.attrib.get("name")
320:                 or element.attrib.get("field")
321:             )
322: 
323:             if name:
324:                 all_named_fields.append(
325:                     name
326:                 )
327: 
328:     # Identify likely input features among PMML field names.
329:     feature_fields = []
330: 
331:     for field in all_named_fields:
332: 
333:         normalized = normalize_mirna_name(
334:             field
335:         )
336: 
337:         if (
338:             "mir" in normalized
339:             or "miR".lower() in normalized
340:         ):
341: 
342:             feature_fields.append(
343:                 field
344:             )
345: 
346:     feature_fields = list(
347:         dict.fromkeys(
348:             feature_fields
349:         )
350:     )
351: 
352:     print()
353:     print(
354:         "miRNA-containing PMML fields:"
355:     )
356: 
357:     for field in feature_fields:
358:         print(
359:             f"  {field}"
360:         )
361: 
362:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
363:     # Save all discovered information.
364:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
365: 
366:     result = {
367:         "pmml": str(pmml_path),
368:         "neural_networks": network_info,
369:         "mirna_like_identifiers": mirna_matches,
370:         "mirna_named_fields": feature_fields,
371:     }
372: 
373:     return result
374: 
375: 
376: # ================================================================
377: # LOAD CLEAN MATRIX
378: # ================================================================
379: 
380: def load_clean_matrix() -> pd.DataFrame:
381: 
382:     if not MATRIX_PATH.exists():
383: 
384:         raise RuntimeError(
385:             "Clean matrix not found:\n"
386:             f"{MATRIX_PATH}\n\n"
387:             "Run build_gse94533_clean_dataset.py first."
388:         )
389: 
390:     matrix = pd.read_csv(
391:         MATRIX_PATH,
392:         index_col=0,
393:     )
394: 
395:     print()
396:     print("=" * 90)
397:     print("CLEAN MATRIX")
398:     print("=" * 90)
399: 
400:     print()
401:     print(
402:         f"Patients: {matrix.shape[0]}"
403:     )
404: 
405:     print(
406:         f"Features: {matrix.shape[1]}"
407:     )
408: 
409:     return matrix
410: 
411: 
412: # ================================================================
413: # MATCH FEATURES
414: # ================================================================
415: 
416: def audit_features(
417:     discovered: dict,
418:     matrix: pd.DataFrame,
419: ) -> dict:
420: 
421:     print()
422:     print("=" * 90)
423:     print("FEATURE MATCHING AUDIT")
424:     print("=" * 90)
425: 
426:     matrix_lookup = {}
427: 
428:     for feature in matrix.columns:
429: 
430:         normalized = normalize_mirna_name(
431:             feature
432:         )
433: 
434:         matrix_lookup.setdefault(
435:             normalized,
436:             [],
437:         ).append(
438:             feature
439:         )
440: 
441:     # Use all likely PMML features.
442:     original_fields = (
443:         discovered["mirna_named_fields"]
444:     )
445: 
446:     print()
447:     print(
448:         f"PMML miRNA-containing fields: "
449:         f"{len(original_fields)}"
450:     )
451: 
452:     matches = {}
453:     missing = {}
454: 
455:     for original in original_fields:
456: 
457:         normalized = normalize_mirna_name(
458:             original
459:         )
460: 
461:         candidates = matrix_lookup.get(
462:             normalized,
463:             [],
464:         )
465: 
466:         if candidates:
467: 
468:             matches[original] = candidates
469: 
470:         else:
471: 
472:             missing[original] = []
473: 
474:     print()
475:     print("MATCHED FEATURES:")
476: 
477:     for original, candidates in matches.items():
478: 
479:         print(
480:             f"  {original!r}"
481:             f" -> {candidates}"
482:         )
483: 
484:     print()
485:     print("UNMATCHED FEATURES:")
486: 
487:     if missing:
488: 
489:         for original in missing:
490:             print(
491:                 f"  {original!r}"
492:             )
493: 
494:     else:
495: 
496:         print(
497:             "  None"
498:         )
499: 
500:     result = {
501:         "matched": matches,
502:         "missing": list(
503:             missing.keys()
504:         ),
505:         "matrix_feature_count": int(
506:             matrix.shape[1]
507:         ),
508:     }
509: 
510:     return result
511:

518: 
519:     print("=" * 90)
520:     print(
521:         "ORIGINAL 14-miRNA MODEL FEATURE AUDIT"
522:     )

37: def download(url: str, destination: Path) -> None:
38: 
39:     destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
40: 
41:     if destination.exists() and destination.stat().st_size > 0:
42:         print(f"[OK] Already downloaded: {destination}")
43:         return
44: 
45:     print()
46:     print(f"[DOWNLOAD] {url}")
47:     print(f"           -> {destination}")
48: 
49:     request = urllib.request.Request(
50:         url,
51:         headers={
52:             "User-Agent": "ovarian-ai-research-prototype/1.0"
53:         },
54:     )
55: 
56:     with urllib.request.urlopen(
57:         request,
58:         timeout=180,
59:     ) as response:
60: 
61:         data = response.read()
62: 
63:     destination.write_bytes(data)
64: 
65:     print(
66:         f"[OK] Downloaded {destination.stat().st_size:,} bytes"
67:     )
68: 
69: 
70: def extract_zip(zip_path: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
71: 
72:     if destination.exists():
73: 
74:         # Don't automatically delete anything.
75:         # We simply reuse an existing extracted archive.
76:         existing = list(destination.rglob("*"))
77: 
78:         if existing:
79:             print(
80:                 f"[OK] Existing extraction found: {destination}"
81:             )
82:             return
83: 
84:     destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
85: 
86:     print()
87:     print(f"[EXTRACT] {zip_path}")
88:     print(f"          -> {destination}")
89: 
90:     with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:
91: 
92:         z.extractall(destination)
93: 
94:     print("[OK] Extraction complete.")
95: 
96: 
97: def find_files(root: Path, extensions: set[str]) -> list[Path]:
98: 
99:     results = []
100: 
101:     for path in root.rglob("*"):
102: 
103:         if path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() in extensions:
104:             results.append(path)
105: 
106:     return sorted(results)
107: 
108: 
109: def normalize_id(value: object) -> str:
110: 
111:     if pd.isna(value):
112:         return ""
113: 
114:     text = str(value).strip().lower()
115: 
116:     # Correct handling of Excel-style numeric IDs:
117:     # 50057.0 -> 50057
118:     if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0+", text):
119:         text = text.split(".", 1)[0]
120: 
121:     # E-1001 -> e1001
122:     text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", text)
123: 
124:     return text

127: def inspect_excel(path: Path) -> None:
128: 
129:     print()
130:     print("=" * 110)
131:     print(f"EXCEL FILE: {path.name}")
132:     print("=" * 110)
133: 
134:     try:
135:         xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
136:     except Exception as exc:
137:         print(f"Could not open workbook: {exc}")
138:         return
139: 
140:     print()
141:     print("SHEETS:")
142: 
143:     for i, sheet in enumerate(xls.sheet_names, 1):
144:         print(f"  {i:3d}. {sheet}")
145: 
146:     # Search every sheet for:
147:     #   - diagnostic words
148:     #   - sample IDs
149:     #   - clinical fields
150:     #
151:     # We do this in a deliberately bounded way first so the terminal
152:     # does not get flooded with millions of expression values.
153: 
154:     keywords = [
155:         "cancer",
156:         "benign",
157:         "borderline",
158:         "control",
159:         "diagnosis",
160:         "histology",
161:         "stage",
162:         "sample",
163:         "patient",
164:         "case",
165:         "validation",
166:         "training",
167:         "testing",
168:         "prediction",
169:     ]
170: 
171:     target_ids = {
172:         "e1001",
173:         "e1056",
174:         "e1057",
175:         "e1058",
176:         "e1063",
177:         "50217",
178:         "50057",
179:         "70088",
180:     }
181: 
182:     for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
183: 
184:         print()
185:         print("-" * 110)
186:         print(f"SHEET: {sheet}")
187:         print("-" * 110)
188: 
189:         try:
190:             # Read only first 25 rows without assuming a header.
191:             preview = pd.read_excel(
192:                 path,
193:                 sheet_name=sheet,
194:                 header=None,
195:                 nrows=25,
196:                 engine="openpyxl",
197:             )
198:         except Exception as exc:
199:             print(f"Could not read sheet: {exc}")
200:             continue
201: 
202:         print(f"Preview shape: {preview.shape}")
203: 
204:         print()
205:         print("FIRST 15 ROWS / FIRST 30 COLUMNS:")
206: 
207:         print(
208:             preview.iloc[:, :30].to_string(
209:                 index=True,
210:                 header=False,
211:             )
212:         )
213: 
214:         # Search the first 100 rows for obvious metadata.
215:         try:
216:             search_df = pd.read_excel(
217:                 path,
218:                 sheet_name=sheet,
219:                 header=None,
220:                 nrows=100,
221:                 engine="openpyxl",
222:             )
223: 
224:             flattened = []
225: 
226:             for value in search_df.to_numpy().ravel():
227: 
228:                 if pd.isna(value):
229:                     continue
230: 
231:                 text = str(value).strip()
232: 
233:                 if text:
234:                     flattened.append(text)
235: 
236:             joined_lower = " | ".join(
237:                 flattened
238:             ).lower()
239: 
240:             found_keywords = [
241:                 keyword
242:                 for keyword in keywords
243:                 if keyword in joined_lower
244:             ]
245: 
246:             if found_keywords:
247: 
248:                 print()
249:                 print("KEYWORDS FOUND:")
250:                 for keyword in found_keywords:
251:                     print(f"  - {keyword}")
252: 
253:             # Search specifically for sample IDs.
254:             found_ids = set()
255: 
256:             for value in flattened:
257: 
258:                 normalized = normalize_id(value)
259: 
260:                 if normalized in target_ids:
261:                     found_ids.add(normalized)
262: 
263:             if found_ids:
264: 
265:                 print()
266:                 print("TARGET SAMPLE IDS FOUND:")
267:                 for sample_id in sorted(found_ids):
268:                     print(f"  - {sample_id}")
269: 
270:         except Exception as exc:
271:             print(
272:                 f"Metadata search failed for {sheet}: {exc}"
273:             )

276: def inspect_code(root: Path) -> None:
277: 
278:     print()
279:     print("=" * 110)
280:     print("ORIGINAL eLIFE SOURCE CODE")
281:     print("=" * 110)
282: 
283:     files = []
284: 
285:     for path in root.rglob("*"):
286: 
287:         if (
288:             path.is_file()
289:             and path.suffix.lower() in {
290:                 ".r",
291:                 ".txt",
292:                 ".m",
293:                 ".pmml",
294:                 ".xml",
295:                 ".csv",
296:                 ".xlsx",
297:             }
298:         ):
299: 
300:             files.append(path)
301: 
302:     if not files:
303:         print("No source-code files found.")
304:         return
305: 
306:     for path in sorted(files):
307: 
308:         print()
309:         print("-" * 110)
310:         print(f"FILE: {path}")
311:         print("-" * 110)
312: 
313:         try:
314:             text = path.read_text(
315:                 encoding="utf-8",
316:                 errors="replace",
317:             )
318:         except Exception:
319:             print("Could not read as text.")
320:             continue
321: 
322:         lower = text.lower()
323: 
324:         interesting_terms = [
325:             "cancer",
326:             "benign",
327:             "borderline",
328:             "control",
329:             "training",
330:             "testing",
331:             "validation",
332:             "mirna",
333:             "e-1001",
334:             "e-1056",
335:         ]
336: 
337:         found = [
338:             term
339:             for term in interesting_terms
340:             if term in lower
341:         ]
342: 
343:         if found:
344:             print(
345:                 "Interesting terms:",
346:                 ", ".join(found),
347:             )
348: 
349:         # Print lines containing diagnostic/classification information.
350:         lines = text.splitlines()
351: 
352:         relevant_lines = []
353: 
354:         for line_no, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
355: 
356:             low = line.lower()
357: 
358:             if any(
359:                 term in low
360:                 for term in [
361:                     "cancer",
362:                     "benign",
363:                     "borderline",
364:                     "control",
365:                     "class",
366:                     "label",
367:                     "training",
368:                     "testing",
369:                     "validation",
370:                     "sample",
371:                     "mirna",
372:                 ]
373:             ):
374: 
375:                 clean = line.strip()
376: 
377:                 if clean:
378:                     relevant_lines.append(
379:                         (line_no, clean[:300])
380:                     )
381: 
382:         for line_no, line in relevant_lines[:120]:
383: 
384:             print(
385:                 f"{line_no:5d}: {line}"
386:             )

531:     print(
532:         """
533: The goal here is to recover the exact sample-level information used
534: by the original publication.
535: 
536: We specifically want to establish:
537: 
538:     sample ID
539:         ↓
540:     original diagnosis
541:         ↓

543:         ↓
544:     original miRNA expression

546: Once those are established, we can reproduce the historical miRNA
547: baseline and then deliberately improve upon it.
548: 
549: That gives your research project a defensible progression:
550: 
551:     Published model
552:           ↓
553:     faithful reproduction
554:           ↓
555:     clinical/symptom baseline
556:           ↓
557:     additional genomic modalities
558:           ↓
559:     multimodal model
560:           ↓
561:     independent validation
562:     """
563:     )
564: 
565:     return 0
566: 
567: 
568: if __name__ == "__main__":
569:     raise SystemExit(main())

### scripts\map_historical_mirnas_to_mimat.py
1: from pathlib import Path
2: import gzip
3: import re
4: import urllib.request
5: import pandas as pd
6: 
7: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
8: 
9: XLSX = (
10:     ROOT
11:     / "data"
12:     / "external"
13:     / "elife_28932"
14:     / "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_6.xlsx"
15: )
16: 
17: OUT = (
18:     ROOT
19:     / "reports"
20:     / "tables"
21:     / "historical_mirna_to_mimat.csv"
22: )
23: 
24: FASTA = ROOT / "data" / "external" / "mirbase_mature.fa"
25: 
26: URL = "https://www.mirbase.org/download/CURRENT/mature.fa"
27: 
28: 
29: def norm_name(x):
30:     s = str(x).strip().lower()
31:     s = s.replace("mirna", "mir")
32:     return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "", s)
33: 
34: 
35: print("=" * 80)
36: print("MAPPING HISTORICAL miRNA NAMES TO miRBase MIMAT IDs")
37: print("=" * 80)
38: 
39: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
40: # Get current miRBase mature annotation.
41: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
42: 
43: FASTA.parent.mkdir(
44:     parents=True,
45:     exist_ok=True,
46: )
47: 
48: if not FASTA.exists():
49: 
50:     print()
51:     print("Downloading miRBase mature.fa.gz...")
52: 
53:     urllib.request.urlretrieve(
54:         URL,
55:         FASTA,
56:     )
57: 
58: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
59: # Parse human mature miRNAs.
60: #
61: # Typical header:
62: # >MIMAT0000418 hsa-miR-23b-3p ...
63: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
64: 
65: mapping = {}
66: 
67: with open(
68:     FASTA,
69:     "rt",
70:     encoding="utf-8",
71: ) as f:
72: 
73:     for line in f:
74: 
75:         if not line.startswith(">"):
76:             continue
77: 
78:         parts = line[1:].strip().split()
79: 
80:         if len(parts) < 2:
81:             continue
82: 
83:         name = parts[0]
84:         accession = parts[1]
85: 
86:         if not name.lower().startswith("hsa-"):
87:             continue
88: 
89:         mapping[norm_name(name)] = accession
90: 
91: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
92: # Extract the 192 historical miRNAs.
93: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
94: 
95: raw = pd.read_excel(
96:     XLSX,
97:     sheet_name="Supplemental Dataset 2",
98:     header=None,
99:     engine="openpyxl",
100: )
101: 
102: historical = list(dict.fromkeys(
103:     str(x).strip()
104:     for x in raw.iloc[:, 0]
105:     if str(x).strip().startswith("hsa-")
106: ))
107: 
108: print()
109: print("Historical miRNAs:", len(historical))
110: print("Human miRBase names:", len(mapping))
111: 
112: records = []
113: 
114: for name in historical:
115: 
116:     key = norm_name(name)
117:     mimat = mapping.get(key)
118: 
119:     records.append({
120:         "historical_name": name,
121:         "mimat": mimat,
122:         "matched": mimat is not None,
123:     })
124: 
125: result = pd.DataFrame(records)
126: 
127: result.to_csv(
128:     OUT,
129:     index=False,
130: )
131: 
132: matched = int(result["matched"].sum())
133: missing = len(result) - matched
134: 
135: print()
136: print("=" * 80)
137: print("MAPPING RESULT")
138: print("=" * 80)
139: 
140: print("Historical miRNAs:", len(result))
141: print("Matched to MIMAT:", matched)
142: print("Not matched:", missing)
143: 
144: if missing:
145: 
146:     print()
147:     print("UNMATCHED miRNAs:")
148: 
149:     for x in result.loc[
150:         ~result["matched"],
151:         "historical_name",
152:     ]:
153:         print(" ", x)
154: 
155: print()
156: print("EXAMPLE MATCHES:")
157: 
158: print(
159:     result[
160:         result["matched"]
161:     ].head(20).to_string(index=False)
162: )
163: 
164: print()
165: print("Saved:")
166: print(OUT)

367: # =====================================================================
368: # HELPERS
369: # =====================================================================
370: 
371: def normalize_id(value: object) -> str:
372: 
373:     if value is None:
374:         return ""
375: 
376:     try:
377:         if pd.isna(value):
378:             return ""
379:     except Exception:
380:         pass
381: 
382:     s = str(value).strip().lower()
383: 
384:     # Numeric Excel values:
385:     #
386:     # 50217.0 -> 50217
387:     # 2.0     -> 2
388:     #
389:     if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0+", s):
390:         s = s.split(".", 1)[0]
391: 
392:     # E-1001 -> e1001
393:     s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s)
394: 
395:     return s
396:

398: def ensure_files_exist() -> None:
399: 
400:     required = [
401:         SUPPLEMENTARY_XLSX,
402:         METADATA_PATH,
403:         COHORT1_XLSX,
404:         COHORT2_XLSX,
405:     ]
406: 
407:     missing = [
408:         str(p)
409:         for p in required
410:         if not p.exists()
411:     ]
412: 
413:     if missing:
414: 
415:         print()
416:         print("=" * 100)
417:         print("MISSING REQUIRED FILES")
418:         print("=" * 100)
419: 
420:         for item in missing:
421:             print(f"  {item}")
422: 
423:         raise RuntimeError(
424:             "Required historical reproduction files are missing."
425:         )
426: 
427: 
428: def workbook_sample_ids(
429:     workbook: Path,
430:     sheet_name: str = "mirna_tpm",
431: ) -> list[str]:
432: 
433:     header = pd.read_excel(
434:         workbook,
435:         sheet_name=sheet_name,
436:         header=2,
437:         nrows=0,
438:         engine="openpyxl",
439:     )
440: 
441:     raw_columns = list(header.columns)
442: 
443:     # The first four columns are:
444:     #
445:     # Name
446:     # Sequence
447:     # Name count
448:     # Identical miRNAs
449:     #
450:     # Everything after that is a sample column.
451: 
452:     sample_columns = raw_columns[4:]
453: 
454:     result = []
455: 
456:     for value in sample_columns:
457: 
458:         normalized = normalize_id(value)
459: 
460:         if normalized:
461:             result.append(normalized)
462: 
463:     return result
464: 
465: 
466: # =====================================================================
467: # RECOVER ORIGINAL 179-SAMPLE ORDER
468: # =====================================================================
469: 
470: def recover_historical_sample_order() -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
471: 
472:     print()
473:     print("=" * 100)
474:     print("RECOVERING EXACT HISTORICAL SAMPLE ORDER")
475:     print("=" * 100)
476: 
477:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
478:     # Cohort 2 workbook contains 120 samples.
479:     #
480:     # Dataset 2 contains 179 expression columns:
481:     #
482:     #   numeric headers corresponding to Cohort 2 positions
483:     #   +
484:     #   60 explicit e#### samples
485:     #
486:     # Critically, Dataset 2 already omits numeric position 56.
487:     # Therefore the historical cohort is:
488:     #
489:     #   Cohort 2 positions 1..55
490:     #   Cohort 2 positions 57..120
491:     #   all 60 Dataset-2 e-samples
492:     #
493:     # E-1056 MUST NOT be removed.
494:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
495: 
496:     cohort2 = workbook_sample_ids(COHORT2_XLSX)
497:     cohort1 = workbook_sample_ids(COHORT1_XLSX)
498: 
499:     print()
500:     print(f"Cohort 2 workbook samples: {len(cohort2)}")
501:     print(f"Cohort 1 workbook samples: {len(cohort1)}")
502: 
503:     if len(cohort2) != 120:
504:         raise RuntimeError(
505:             f"Expected 120 Cohort 2 samples, found {len(cohort2)}."
506:         )
507: 
508:     if len(cohort1) != 60:
509:         raise RuntimeError(
510:             f"Expected 60 Cohort 1 samples, found {len(cohort1)}."
511:         )
512: 
513:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
514:     # Read Dataset 2 header directly.
515:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
516: 
517:     raw = pd.read_excel(
518:         SUPPLEMENTARY_XLSX,
519:         sheet_name="Supplemental Dataset 2",
520:         header=None,
521:         engine="openpyxl",
522:     )
523: 
524:     header_row = 2
525: 
526:     raw_header = list(
527:         raw.iloc[
528:             header_row,
529:             1:180,
530:         ]
531:     )
532: 
533:     if len(raw_header) != 179:
534:         raise RuntimeError(
535:             f"Expected 179 Dataset 2 expression columns, "
536:             f"found {len(raw_header)}."
537:         )
538: 
539:     historical = []
540: 
541:     numeric_positions = []
542:     observed_esamples = []
543: 
544:     for column_number, value in enumerate(raw_header, start=1):
545: 
546:         # Numeric Dataset 2 headers represent Cohort 2 positions.
547:         try:
548:             numeric = float(value)
549: 
550:             if numeric.is_integer():
551:                 position = int(numeric)
552: 
553:                 if not (1 <= position <= 120):
554:                     raise RuntimeError(
555:                         f"Dataset 2 numeric header {value!r} at "
556:                         f"column {column_number} is outside 1..120."
557:                     )
558: 
559:                 sample_id = cohort2[position - 1]
560: 
561:                 historical.append(sample_id)
562:                 numeric_positions.append(position)
563:                 continue
564: 
565:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
566:             pass
567: 
568:         # Non-numeric headers should be explicit e#### IDs.
569:         sample_id = normalize_id(value)
570: 
571:         if not sample_id.startswith("e"):
572:             raise RuntimeError(
573:                 f"Unexpected Dataset 2 sample header at "
574:                 f"column {column_number}: {value!r}"
575:             )
576: 
577:         historical.append(sample_id)
578:         observed_esamples.append(sample_id)
579: 
580:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
581:     # Validate exact historical structure.
582:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
583: 
584:     expected_numeric_positions = [
585:         *range(1, 56),
586:         *range(57, 121),
587:     ]
588: 
589:     if numeric_positions != expected_numeric_positions:
590:         raise RuntimeError(
591:             "Dataset 2 numeric sample positions do not match the "
592:             "historical structure.\n"
593:             f"Observed: {numeric_positions}\n"
594:             f"Expected: {expected_numeric_positions}"
595:         )
596: 
597:     if len(observed_esamples) != 60:
598:         raise RuntimeError(
599:             f"Expected 60 e-samples in Dataset 2, "
600:             f"found {len(observed_esamples)}."
601:         )
602: 
603:     expected_esamples = set(cohort1)
604:     observed_esample_set = set(observed_esamples)
605: 
606:     if observed_esample_set != expected_esamples:
607:         missing = sorted(expected_esamples - observed_esample_set)
608:         unexpected = sorted(observed_esample_set - expected_esamples)
609: 
610:         raise RuntimeError(
611:             "Dataset 2 e-sample set does not match Cohort 1.\n"
612:             f"Missing: {missing}\n"
613:             f"Unexpected: {unexpected}"
614:         )
615: 
616:     if len(historical) != 179:
617:         raise RuntimeError(
618:             f"Expected 179 historical samples, found {len(historical)}."
619:         )
620: 
621:     if len(set(historical)) != 179:
622:         raise RuntimeError(
623:             "Historical sample mapping contains duplicate sample IDs."
624:         )
625: 
626:     if cohort2[55] in historical:
627:         raise RuntimeError(
628:             "Excluded numeric Cohort 2 position 56 "
629:             f"({cohort2[55]}) is present in historical data."
630:         )
631: 
632:     if "e1056" not in historical:
633:         raise RuntimeError(
634:             "E-1056 is unexpectedly absent. "
635:             "It should be retained in the historical dataset."
636:         )
637: 
638:     print()
639:     print("Exact historical sample mapping recovered from Dataset 2 header:")
640: 
641:     print()
642:     print("First 10:")
643:     for i, sid in enumerate(historical[:10], start=1):
644:         print(f"  {i:3d}: {sid}")
645: 
646:     print()
647:     print("Around excluded numeric position 56:")
648:     for i in range(50, 62):
649:         if i <= len(historical):
650:             print(f"  {i:3d}: {historical[i - 1]}")
651: 
652:     print()
653:     print("Last 10:")
654:     start = len(historical) - 9
655:     for i, sid in enumerate(
656:         historical[-10:],
657:         start=start,
658:     ):
659:         print(f"  {i:3d}: {sid}")
660: 
661:     print()
662:     print("Historical sample count:", len(historical))
663:     print("Numeric samples retained:", len(numeric_positions))
664:     print("E-samples retained:", len(observed_esamples))
665:     print("Excluded numeric position: 56")
666:     print("Excluded mapped sample:", cohort2[55])
667:     print("E-1056 retained: YES")
668: 
669:     return historical, cohort2

675: # LOAD DATASET 2
676: # =====================================================================
677: 
678: def load_dataset2(
679:     historical_ids: list[str],
680: ) -> pd.DataFrame:
681: 
682:     print()
683:     print("=" * 100)
684:     print("READING eLIFE SUPPLEMENTAL DATASET 2")
685:     print("=" * 100)
686: 
687:     raw = pd.read_excel(
688:         SUPPLEMENTARY_XLSX,
689:         sheet_name="Supplemental Dataset 2",
690:         header=None,
691:         engine="openpyxl",
692:     )
693: 
694:     print()
695:     print(f"Raw shape: {raw.shape}")
696: 
697:     header_row = 2
698: 
699:     raw_header = list(
700:         raw.iloc[
701:             header_row,
702:             1:180,
703:         ]
704:     )
705: 
706:     if len(raw_header) != 179:
707:         raise RuntimeError(
708:             "Dataset 2 did not contain exactly 179 sample columns."
709:         )
710: 
711:     print()
712:     print("FIRST 10 RAW HEADER VALUES:")
713: 
714:     for i, value in enumerate(
715:         raw_header[:10],
716:         start=1,
717:     ):
718: 
719:         print(
720:             f"  column {i:3d}: {value!r}"
721:         )
722: 
723:     print()
724:     print("LAST 10 RAW HEADER VALUES:")
725: 
726:     start = 170
727: 
728:     for i, value in enumerate(
729:         raw_header[-10:],
730:         start=start,
731:     ):
732: 
733:         print(
734:             f"  column {i:3d}: {value!r}"
735:         )
736: 
737:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
738:     # HEADER AUDIT
739:     #
740:     # Dataset 2 contains 179 expression columns. Its header is a
741:     # mixed representation:
742:     #
743:     #   early columns use positional sample numbers
744:     #   later columns contain explicit E-#### sample IDs
745:     #
746:     # We do NOT use these header values to identify patients.
747:     #
748:     # The historical patient identity/order was independently recovered
749:     # from the two processed cohort workbooks above:
750:     #
751:     #   positions 1..120   -> Cohort 2 workbook order
752:     #   positions 121..179 -> Cohort 1 workbook order
753:     #
754:     # Therefore the Dataset 2 columns are treated as POSITIONAL.
755:     # This avoids depending on pandas' interpretation of mixed Excel
756:     # headers while preserving the original column ordering.
757:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
758: 
759:     if len(raw_header) != 179:
760:         raise RuntimeError(
761:             "Dataset 2 does not contain exactly 179 sample columns."
762:         )
763: 
764:     # Audit the first 120 headers without making them a prerequisite
765:     # for the reconstruction.
766: 
767:     positional_header_ok = True
768:     first_bad_position = None
769:     first_bad_value = None
770: 
771:     for expected, observed in enumerate(
772:         raw_header[:120],
773:         start=1,
774:     ):
775: 
776:         try:
777:             numeric = float(observed)
778:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
779:             positional_header_ok = False
780:             first_bad_position = expected
781:             first_bad_value = observed
782:             break
783: 
784:         if not math.isclose(
785:             numeric,
786:             float(expected),
787:             rel_tol=0.0,
788:             abs_tol=1e-9,
789:         ):
790:             positional_header_ok = False
791:             first_bad_position = expected
792:             first_bad_value = observed
793:             break
794: 
795:     print()
796: 
797:     if positional_header_ok:
798: 
799:         print(
800:             "Dataset 2 header audit: first 120 headers "
801:             "match positions 1..120."
802:         )
803: 
804:     else:
805: 
806:         print(
807:             "Dataset 2 header audit: mixed/non-positional header "
808:             "detected."
809:         )
810: 
811:         print(
812:             f"  first differing position: {first_bad_position}"
813:         )
814: 
815:         print(
816:             f"  observed value: {first_bad_value!r}"
817:         )
818: 
819:         print(
820:             "  This does NOT affect reconstruction because "
821:             "sample identity is assigned by column position."
822:         )
823: 
824:     print()
825:     print(
826:         "Using independently recovered historical sample order "
827:         "for all 179 Dataset 2 columns."
828:     )
829: 
830:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
831:     # Extract exact PMML features.
832:     #
833:     # First column is the miRNA name.
834:     # Columns 2..180 are the 179 samples.
835:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
836: 
837:     feature_series = raw.iloc[
838:         :,
839:         0,
840:     ].astype(str).str.strip()
841: 
842:     rows = {}
843: 
844:     for feature in FEATURES:
845: 
846:         matches = np.where(
847:             feature_series.values == feature
848:         )[0]
849: 
850:         if len(matches) != 1:
851: 
852:             raise RuntimeError(
853:                 f"Expected exactly one row for "
854:                 f"{feature}, found {len(matches)}."
855:             )
856: 
857:         rows[feature] = int(matches[0])
858: 
859:     print()
860:     print("Exact PMML feature rows:")
861: 
862:     for feature in FEATURES:
863: 
864:         print(
865:             f"  {feature}: row {rows[feature]}"
866:         )
867: 
868:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
869:     # Pull numeric matrix.
870:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
871: 
872:     values = []
873: 
874:     for feature in FEATURES:
875: 
876:         row_index = rows[feature]
877: 
878:         row_values = raw.iloc[
879:             row_index,
880:             1:180,
881:         ]
882: 
883:         numeric = pd.to_numeric(
884:             row_values,
885:             errors="coerce",
886:         ).to_numpy(
887:             dtype=np.float64,
888:         )
889: 
890:         if len(numeric) != 179:
891:             raise RuntimeError(
892:                 f"{feature} has {len(numeric)} values "
893:                 "instead of 179."
894:             )
895: 
896:         if not np.all(
897:             np.isfinite(numeric)
898:         ):
899: 
900:             bad = np.where(
901:                 ~np.isfinite(numeric)
902:             )[0]
903: 
904:             raise RuntimeError(
905:                 f"{feature} contains non-finite values "
906:                 f"at Dataset 2 columns {bad[:10].tolist()}."
907:             )
908: 
909:         values.append(numeric)
910: 
911:     # Features x samples -> samples x features
912:     X = np.vstack(values).T
913: 
914:     dataset = pd.DataFrame(
915:         X,
916:         columns=FEATURES,
917:     )
918: 
919:     dataset.insert(
920:         0,
921:         "sample_id",
922:         historical_ids,
923:     )
924: 
925:     print()
926:     print(
927:         f"Historical Dataset 2 matrix: "
928:         f"{dataset.shape[0]} patients x "
929:         f"{len(FEATURES)} PMML features"
930:     )
931: 
932:     return dataset
933:

935: # =====================================================================
936: # LOAD GEO LABELS
937: # =====================================================================
938: 
939: def load_labels(
940:     historical_ids: list[str],
941: ) -> pd.DataFrame:
942: 
943:     print()
944:     print("=" * 100)
945:     print("LOADING GEO DIAGNOSIS LABELS")
946:     print("=" * 100)
947: 
948:     metadata = pd.read_csv(
949:         METADATA_PATH
950:     )
951: 
952:     required = {
953:         "title",
954:         "diagnosis",
955:     }
956: 
957:     missing = required - set(metadata.columns)
958: 
959:     if missing:
960:         raise RuntimeError(
961:             "GEO metadata is missing required columns: "
962:             f"{sorted(missing)}\n"
963:             f"Available columns: {metadata.columns.tolist()}"
964:         )
965: 
966:     metadata = metadata.copy()
967: 
968:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
969:     # The GEO metadata stores the original biological sample ID in
970:     # the `title` field.
971:     #
972:     # Examples:
973:     #   50217  -> "50217"
974:     #   E-1001 -> "E-1001"
975:     #
976:     # Normalize those identifiers so that they match the historical
977:     # IDs recovered from the supplementary expression workbook.
978:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
979: 
980:     metadata["sample_id"] = (
981:         metadata["title"]
982:         .astype(str)
983:         .str.strip()
984:         .str.lower()
985:         .str.replace("-", "", regex=False)
986:         .str.replace(r"\.0+$", "", regex=True)
987:     )
988: 
989:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
990:     # Verify uniqueness.
991:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
992: 
993:     duplicate_ids = (
994:         metadata.loc[
995:             metadata["sample_id"].duplicated(keep=False),
996:             "sample_id",
997:         ]
998:         .drop_duplicates()
999:         .tolist()
1000:     )
1001: 
1002:     if duplicate_ids:
1003:         raise RuntimeError(
1004:             "GEO metadata contains duplicate normalized sample IDs:\n"
1005:             + "\n".join(sorted(duplicate_ids))
1006:         )
1007: 
1008:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1009:     # Index by biological sample ID.
1010:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1011: 
1012:     indexed = metadata.set_index(
1013:         "sample_id"
1014:     )
1015: 
1016:     missing_ids = [
1017:         sid
1018:         for sid in historical_ids
1019:         if sid not in indexed.index
1020:     ]
1021: 
1022:     if missing_ids:
1023:         raise RuntimeError(
1024:             "Historical samples missing GEO metadata:\n"
1025:             + "\n".join(missing_ids)
1026:         )
1027: 
1028:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1029:     # Recover labels in EXACT historical expression order.
1030:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1031: 
1032:     selected = indexed.loc[
1033:         historical_ids,
1034:         [
1035:             "diagnosis",
1036:             "stage",
1037:             "histology",
1038:             "title",
1039:         ],
1040:     ].copy()
1041: 
1042:     selected.insert(
1043:         0,
1044:         "sample_id",
1045:         historical_ids,
1046:     )
1047: 
1048:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1049:     # Binary endpoint:
1050:     #
1051:     #   Cancer = 1
1052:     #   Benign/Borderline/Control = 0
1053:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1054: 
1055:     diagnosis = (
1056:         selected["diagnosis"]
1057:         .astype(str)
1058:         .str.strip()
1059:         .str.title()
1060:     )
1061: 
1062:     valid_diagnoses = {
1063:         "Cancer",
1064:         "Benign",
1065:         "Borderline",
1066:         "Control",
1067:     }
1068: 
1069:     unexpected = sorted(
1070:         set(diagnosis) - valid_diagnoses
1071:     )
1072: 
1073:     if unexpected:
1074:         raise RuntimeError(
1075:             "Unexpected diagnosis values:\n"
1076:             + "\n".join(unexpected)
1077:         )
1078: 
1079:     selected["diagnosis"] = diagnosis
1080: 
1081:     selected["true_label"] = (
1082:         selected["diagnosis"] == "Cancer"
1083:     ).astype(int)
1084: 
1085:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1086:     # Audit counts.
1087:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1088: 
1089:     print()
1090:     print("Historical diagnosis values:")
1091: 
1092:     counts = (
1093:         selected["diagnosis"]
1094:         .value_counts()
1095:         .sort_index()
1096:     )
1097: 
1098:     for diagnosis_name, count in counts.items():
1099:         print(
1100:             f"  {diagnosis_name:<12} {count}"
1101:         )
1102: 
1103:     print()
1104:     print(
1105:         f"Cancer:      "
1106:         f"{int(selected['true_label'].sum())}"
1107:     )
1108: 
1109:     print(
1110:         f"Non-cancer:  "
1111:         f"{int((selected['true_label'] == 0).sum())}"
1112:     )
1113: 
1114:     return selected
1115:

1121: # =====================================================================
1122: # VERIFY PMML NORMALIZATION
1123: # =====================================================================
1124: 
1125: def verify_normalization() -> None:
1126: 
1127:     print()
1128:     print("=" * 100)
1129:     print("VERIFYING PMML NORMALIZATION PARAMETERS")
1130:     print("=" * 100)
1131: 
1132:     calculated_scale = (
1133:         1.0
1134:         / (
1135:             PMML_MAX
1136:             - PMML_MIN
1137:         )
1138:     )
1139: 
1140:     calculated_shift = (
1141:         -PMML_MIN
1142:         * calculated_scale
1143:     )
1144: 
1145:     scale_ok = np.allclose(
1146:         calculated_scale,
1147:         SCALE,
1148:         rtol=0.0,
1149:         atol=1e-12,
1150:     )
1151: 
1152:     shift_ok = np.allclose(
1153:         calculated_shift,
1154:         SHIFT,
1155:         rtol=0.0,
1156:         atol=1e-12,
1157:     )
1158: 
1159:     print()
1160:     print(
1161:         f"Scale agrees with PMML endpoints: {scale_ok}"
1162:     )
1163: 
1164:     print(
1165:         f"Shift agrees with PMML endpoints: {shift_ok}"
1166:     )
1167: 
1168:     if not scale_ok or not shift_ok:
1169: 
1170:         raise RuntimeError(
1171:             "PMML normalization constants failed verification."
1172:         )
1173: 
1174:     # Verify both endpoints map to approximately 0 and 1.
1175:     lower = (
1176:         PMML_MIN
1177:         * SCALE
1178:         + SHIFT
1179:     )
1180: 
1181:     upper = (
1182:         PMML_MAX
1183:         * SCALE
1184:         + SHIFT
1185:     )
1186: 
1187:     if not np.allclose(
1188:         lower,
1189:         0.0,
1190:         atol=1e-12,
1191:     ):
1192: 
1193:         raise RuntimeError(
1194:             "PMML minimum normalization does not map to zero."
1195:         )
1196: 
1197:     if not np.allclose(
1198:         upper,
1199:         1.0,
1200:         atol=1e-12,
1201:     ):
1202: 
1203:         raise RuntimeError(
1204:             "PMML maximum normalization does not map to one."
1205:         )
1206: 
1207:     print(
1208:         "Endpoint normalization check: PASS"
1209:     )
1210: 
1211: 
1212: # =====================================================================
1213: # FORWARD PASS
1214: # =====================================================================
1215: 
1216: def forward_pass(
1217:     X_raw: np.ndarray,
1218: ) -> tuple[
1219:     np.ndarray,
1220:     np.ndarray,
1221:     np.ndarray,
1222:     np.ndarray,
1223: ]:
1224: 
1225:     if X_raw.ndim != 2:
1226:         raise ValueError(
1227:             "X_raw must be a 2D matrix."
1228:         )
1229: 
1230:     if X_raw.shape[1] != 14:
1231:         raise ValueError(
1232:             f"Expected 14 features, got {X_raw.shape[1]}."
1233:         )
1234: 
1235:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1236:     # PMML input transformation.
1237:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1238: 
1239:     X = (
1240:         X_raw
1241:         * SCALE
1242:         + SHIFT
1243:     )
1244: 
1245:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1246:     # Hidden layer.
1247:     #
1248:     # h = tanh(XW^T + bias)
1249:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1250: 
1251:     hidden_pre = (
1252:         X
1253:         @ HIDDEN_WEIGHTS.T
1254:         + HIDDEN_BIAS
1255:     )
1256: 
1257:     hidden = np.tanh(
1258:         hidden_pre
1259:     )
1260: 
1261:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1262:     # Output layer.
1263:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1264: 
1265:     output_pre = (
1266:         hidden
1267:         @ OUTPUT_WEIGHTS.T
1268:         + OUTPUT_BIAS
1269:     )
1270: 
1271:     output = np.tanh(
1272:         output_pre
1273:     )
1274: 
1275:     return (
1276:         X,
1277:         hidden_pre,
1278:         hidden,
1279:         output,
1280:     )
1281: 
1282:

1284: # SAVE SAMPLE MAPPING
1285: # =====================================================================
1286: 
1287: def save_mapping(
1288:     dataset: pd.DataFrame,
1289:     metadata: pd.DataFrame,
1290: ) -> None:
1291: 
1292:     mapping = dataset[
1293:         ["sample_id"]
1294:     ].copy()
1295: 
1296:     mapping["diagnosis"] = [
1297:         metadata.loc[
1298:             sid,
1299:             "diagnosis",
1300:         ]
1301:         for sid in mapping["sample_id"]
1302:     ]
1303: 
1304:     mapping["binary_label"] = [
1305:         int(
1306:             metadata.loc[
1307:                 sid,
1308:                 "true_label",
1309:             ]
1310:         )
1311:         for sid in mapping["sample_id"]
1312:     ]
1313: 
1314:     mapping["historical_position"] = np.arange(
1315:         1,
1316:         len(mapping) + 1,
1317:     )
1318: 
1319:     mapping[
1320:         "historical_dataset_section"
1321:     ] = [
1322:         "cohort2"
1323:         if position <= 120
1324:         else "cohort1"
1325:         for position
1326:         in mapping["historical_position"]
1327:     ]
1328: 
1329:     mapping.to_csv(
1330:         MAPPING_OUTPUT,
1331:         index=False,
1332:     )

1347:     print(

1352:     print(
