731:                 "do not agree with the recovered sample order."
732:             )
733: 
734:         # Build the complete real-ID order.
735:         sample_ids = (
736:             cohort2_ids
737:             + explicit_cohort1_ids
738:         )
739: 
740:         # --------------------------------------------------------
741:         # Strong integrity checks
742:         # --------------------------------------------------------
743: 
744:         if len(sample_ids) != 179:
745:             raise RuntimeError(
746:                 "Translated historical sample list does not "
747:                 "contain exactly 179 samples."
748:             )
749: 
750:         if len(set(sample_ids)) != 179:
751:             raise RuntimeError(
752:                 "Translated historical sample IDs are not unique."
753:             )
754: 
755:         print()
756:         print(
757:             "Historical position -> actual sample ID:"
758:         )
759: 
760:         for position in range(1, 11):
761: 
762:             print(
763:                 f"  {position:3d} -> "
764:                 f"{sample_ids[position - 1]}"
765:             )
766: 
767:         print(
768:             "  ..."
769:         )
770: 
771:         for position in range(171, 180):
772: 
773:             print(
774:                 f"  {position:3d} -> "
775:                 f"{sample_ids[position - 1]}"
776:             )
777: 
778:         print()
779:         print(
780:             f"Position 1   -> {sample_ids[0]}"
781:         )
782: 
783:         print(
784:             f"Position 120 -> {sample_ids[119]}"
785:         )
786: 
787:         print(
788:             f"Position 121 -> {sample_ids[120]}"
789:         )
790: 
791:         print(
792:             f"Position 179 -> {sample_ids[178]}"
793:         )
794: 
795:         print()
796:         print(
797:             "Historical position -> real sample ID mapping:"
798:         )
799: 
800:         for position, sample_id in list(
801:             enumerate(
802:                 sample_ids,
803:                 start=1,
804:             )
805:         )[:15]:
806: 
807:             print(
808:                 f"  {position:3d} -> {sample_id}"
809:             )
810: 
811:         print(
812:             "  ..."
813:         )
814: 
815:         for position, sample_id in list(
816:             enumerate(
817:                 sample_ids,
818:                 start=1,
819:             )
820:         )[-15:]:
821: 
822:             print(
823:                 f"  {position:3d} -> {sample_id}"
824:             )
825: 
826:         print()
827:         print(
828:             "Position 1:"
829:             f"  {sample_ids[0]}"
830:         )
831: 
832:         print(
833:             "Position 120:"
834:             f"  {sample_ids[119]}"
835:         )
836: 
837:         print(
838:             "Position 121:"
839:             f"  {sample_ids[120]}"
840:         )
841: 
842:         print(
843:             "Position 179:"
844:             f"  {sample_ids[178]}"
845:         )
846: 
847:     else:
848: 
849:         print()
850:         print(
851:             "Supplemental Dataset 2 appears to contain "
852:             "explicit sample identifiers rather than "
853:             "positional 1..179 headers."
854:         )
855: 
856:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
857:     # Exactly 179 historical patients are expected.
858:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
859: 
860:     if len(sample_ids) != 179:
861: 
862:         raise RuntimeError(
863:             "Supplemental Dataset 2 yielded "
864:             f"{len(sample_ids)} sample IDs; expected 179."
865:         )
866: 
867:     if len(set(sample_ids)) != 179:
868: 
869:         duplicates = (
870:             pd.Series(
871:                 sample_ids
872:             )
873:             .value_counts()
874:         )
875: 
876:         duplicates = duplicates[
877:             duplicates > 1
878:         ]
879: 
880:         raise RuntimeError(
881:             "Supplemental Dataset 2 contains duplicate sample IDs:\n"
882:             + duplicates.to_string()
883:         )
884: 
885:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
886:     # Find the rows corresponding to the exact 14 PMML features.
887:     #
888:     # We do NOT assume that all remaining rows are miRNAs.
889:     # We explicitly locate each requested feature by name.
890:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
891: 
892:     first_column = (
893:         raw.iloc[
894:             :,
895:             0
896:         ]
897:         .astype(str)
898:         .str.strip()
899:     )
900: 
901:     feature_row_map = {}
902: 
903:     for feature in FEATURES:
904: 
905:         matches = np.where(
906:             first_column.eq(
907:                 feature
908:             )
909:         )[0]
910: 
911:         if len(matches) == 0:
912: 
913:             raise RuntimeError(
914:                 f"Could not find PMML feature "
915:                 f"{feature!r} in Supplemental Dataset 2."
916:             )
917: 
918:         if len(matches) > 1:
919: 
920:             raise RuntimeError(
921:                 f"Feature {feature!r} appears "
922:                 f"{len(matches)} times in Supplemental Dataset 2."
923:             )
924: 
925:         feature_row_map[
926:             feature
927:         ] = int(
928:             matches[0]
929:         )
930: 
931:     print()
932:     print(
933:         "Exact PMML feature rows found:"
934:     )
935: 
936:     for feature in FEATURES:
937: 
938:         print(
939:             f"  {feature}: row "
940:             f"{feature_row_map[feature]}"
941:         )
942: 
943:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
944:     # Build feature x sample values using the detected sample columns.
945:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
946: 
947:     selected_rows = []
948: 
949:     for feature in FEATURES:
950: 
951:         row_idx = feature_row_map[
952:             feature
953:         ]
954: 
955:         values = []
956: 
957:         for col_idx in sample_column_indices:
958: 
959:             values.append(
960:                 raw.iloc[
961:                     row_idx,
962:                     col_idx
963:                 ]
964:             )
965: 
966:         selected_rows.append(
967:             values
968:         )
969: 
970:     expression = pd.DataFrame(
971:         selected_rows,
972:         index=FEATURES,
973:         columns=sample_ids,
974:     )
975: 
976:     expression = expression.apply(
977:         pd.to_numeric,
978:         errors="coerce",
979:     )
980: 
981:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
982:     # Every selected feature must contain finite numeric values.
983:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
984: 
985:     values = expression.to_numpy(
986:         dtype=float
987:     )
988: 
989:     if not np.isfinite(
990:         values
991:     ).all():
992: 
993:         bad = np.argwhere(
994:             ~np.isfinite(
995:                 values
996:             )
997:         )
998: 
999:         first_bad_row = int(
1000:             bad[0][0]
1001:         )
1002: 
1003:         first_bad_col = int(
1004:             bad[0][1]
1005:         )
1006: 
1007:         raise RuntimeError(
1008:             "Supplemental Dataset 2 contains non-finite "
1009:             "values in the selected PMML matrix.\n"
1010:             f"Feature: {FEATURES[first_bad_row]}\n"
1011:             f"Sample: {sample_ids[first_bad_col]}"
1012:         )
1013: 
1014:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1015:     # Transpose:
1016:     #
1017:     #     sample x feature
1018:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1019: 
1020:     selected = expression.T.copy()
1021: 
1022:     selected.columns = FEATURES
1023: 
1024:     # Preserve the historical positional column as a provenance field.
1025:     selected[
1026:         "historical_sample_number"
1027:     ] = np.arange(
1028:         1,
1029:         len(selected) + 1,
1030:     )
1031: 
1032:     # `historical_sample_number` is the original positional column
1033:     # from Supplemental Dataset 2.
1034:     #
1035:     # `sample_id` below is the actual GSE94533 identifier recovered
1036:     # from the original cohort ordering.
1037:     #
1038:     # Keeping both fields prevents us from confusing the two concepts.
1039: 
1040:     # Actual GSE94533 sample ID.
1041:     selected[
1042:         "sample_id"
1043:     ] = selected.index.astype(
1044:         str
1045:     )
1046: 
1047:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1048:     # Put identifiers first.
1049:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1050: 
1051:     selected = selected[
1052:         [
1053:             "sample_id",
1054:             "historical_sample_number",
1055:         ]
1056:         + FEATURES
1057:     ]
1058: 
1059:     print()
1060:     print(
1061:         "Historical representation:"
1062:     )
1063: 
1064:     print(
1065:         "  Batch adjusted"
1066:     )
1067: 
1068:     print(
1069:         "  log10 transformed"
1070:     )
1071: 
1072:     print(
1073:         f"  Samples: {len(selected)}"
1074:     )
1075: 
1076:     print(
1077:         "  PMML features: 14"
1078:     )
1079: 
1080:     return selected

1084: def verify_against_processed_data(
1085:     historical,
1086:     sample_ids,
1087: ):
1088: 
1089:     print()
1090:     print("=" * 100)
1091:     print("VERIFYING HISTORICAL SAMPLE IDENTIFIERS")
1092:     print("=" * 100)
1093: 
1094:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1095:     # Expected GSE94533 IDs reconstructed from the processed
1096:     # Cohort 1 + Cohort 2 workbooks.
1097:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1098: 
1099:     expected_ids = set(
1100:         get_processed_sample_order()
1101:     )
1102: 
1103:     observed_ids = set(
1104:         normalize_id(x)
1105:         for x in historical[
1106:             "sample_id"
1107:         ]
1108:     )
1109: 
1110:     print()
1111:     print(
1112:         f"Expected processed-workbook IDs: {len(expected_ids)}"
1113:     )
1114: 
1115:     print(
1116:         f"Observed historical IDs:          {len(observed_ids)}"
1117:     )
1118: 
1119:     missing = sorted(
1120:         expected_ids
1121:         - observed_ids
1122:     )
1123: 
1124:     extra = sorted(
1125:         observed_ids
1126:         - expected_ids
1127:     )
1128: 
1129:     if missing:
1130: 
1131:         raise RuntimeError(
1132:             "Historical Dataset 2 is missing sample IDs:\n"
1133:             + "\n".join(
1134:                 f"  {x}"
1135:                 for x in missing
1136:             )
1137:         )
1138: 
1139:     if extra:
1140: 
1141:         raise RuntimeError(
1142:             "Historical Dataset 2 contains unexpected sample IDs:\n"
1143:             + "\n".join(
1144:                 f"  {x}"
1145:                 for x in extra
1146:             )
1147:         )
1148: 
1149:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1150:     # Confirm the order supplied by this function is identical to
1151:     # the actual order from the historical workbook.
1152:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1153: 
1154:     if list(
1155:         historical[
1156:             "sample_id"
1157:         ]
1158:     ) != list(
1159:         sample_ids
1160:     ):
1161: 
1162:         raise RuntimeError(
1163:             "Internal sample-ID order mismatch."
1164:         )
1165: 
1166:     print()
1167:     print(
1168:         "Sample-ID set check: PASS"
1169:     )
1170: 
1171:     print(
1172:         "Sample-ID uniqueness: PASS"
1173:     )
1174: 
1175:     print(
1176:         "Sample-ID order preservation: PASS"
1177:     )
1178: 
1179:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1180:     # We deliberately DO NOT require the first sample to be 50217.
1181:     #
1182:     # Different supplementary datasets can store the same 179
1183:     # patients in different orders.
1184:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1185: 
1186:     print()
1187:     print(
1188:         "No artificial first-sample assumption applied."
1189:     )
1190: 
1191:     return historical

1194: def load_pmml_parameters():
1195: 
1196:     print()
1197:     print("=" * 100)
1198:     print("LOADING PMML PARAMETERS")
1199:     print("=" * 100)
1200: 
1201:     audit = json.loads(
1202:         PMML_AUDIT.read_text()
1203:     )
1204: 
1205:     nn = audit[
1206:         "neural_network"
1207:     ]
1208: 
1209:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1210:     # Input normalization.
1211:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1212: 
1213:     normalization = {}
1214: 
1215:     for feature, neural_input in zip(
1216:         FEATURES,
1217:         nn[
1218:             "neural_inputs"
1219:         ],
1220:     ):
1221: 
1222:         derived = neural_input[
1223:             "expressions"
1224:         ][0]
1225: 
1226:         norm = derived[
1227:             "children"
1228:         ][0]
1229: 
1230:         attrs = norm[
1231:             "attributes"
1232:         ]
1233: 
1234:         normalization[
1235:             feature
1236:         ] = {
1237:             "shift": float(
1238:                 attrs[
1239:                     "shift"
1240:                 ]
1241:             ),
1242:             "scale": float(
1243:                 attrs[
1244:                     "scale"
1245:                 ]
1246:             ),
1247:         }
1248: 
1249:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1250:     # Hidden layer
1251:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1252: 
1253:     hidden = nn[
1254:         "neural_layers"
1255:     ][0]
1256: 
1257:     output = nn[
1258:         "neural_layers"
1259:     ][1]
1260: 
1261:     hidden_weights = np.zeros(
1262:         (
1263:             7,
1264:             14,
1265:         ),
1266:         dtype=float,
1267:     )
1268: 
1269:     hidden_bias = np.zeros(
1270:         7,
1271:         dtype=float,
1272:     )
1273: 
1274:     for i, neuron in enumerate(
1275:         hidden[
1276:             "neurons"
1277:         ]
1278:     ):
1279: 
1280:         hidden_bias[i] = float(
1281:             neuron[
1282:                 "bias"
1283:             ]
1284:         )
1285: 
1286:         for connection in neuron[
1287:             "connections"
1288:         ]:
1289: 
1290:             j = int(
1291:                 connection[
1292:                     "from"
1293:                 ]
1294:             )
1295: 
1296:             hidden_weights[
1297:                 i,
1298:                 j
1299:             ] = float(
1300:                 connection[
1301:                     "weight"
1302:                 ]
1303:             )
1304: 
1305:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1306:     # Output layer
1307:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1308: 
1309:     output_weights = np.zeros(
1310:         (
1311:             2,
1312:             7,
1313:         ),
1314:         dtype=float,
1315:     )
1316: 
1317:     output_bias = np.zeros(
1318:         2,
1319:         dtype=float,
1320:     )
1321: 
1322:     hidden_ids = [
1323:         "14",
1324:         "15",
1325:         "16",
1326:         "17",
1327:         "18",
1328:         "19",
1329:         "20",
1330:     ]
1331: 
1332:     for i, neuron in enumerate(
1333:         output[
1334:             "neurons"
1335:         ]
1336:     ):
1337: 
1338:         output_bias[i] = float(
1339:             neuron[
1340:                 "bias"
1341:             ]
1342:         )
1343: 
1344:         for connection in neuron[
1345:             "connections"
1346:         ]:
1347: 
1348:             hidden_id = str(
1349:                 connection[
1350:                     "from"
1351:                 ]
1352:             )
1353: 
1354:             j = hidden_ids.index(
1355:                 hidden_id
1356:             )
1357: 
1358:             output_weights[
1359:                 i,
1360:                 j
1361:             ] = float(
1362:                 connection[
1363:                     "weight"
1364:                 ]
1365:             )
1366: 
1367:     return (
1368:         normalization,
1369:         hidden_weights,
1370:         hidden_bias,
1371:         output_weights,
1372:         output_bias,
1373:     )

1375: 
1376: # ===================================================================
1377: # FORWARD PASS
1378: # ===================================================================
1379: 
1380: def forward_pass(
1381:     data,
1382:     normalization,
1383:     hidden_weights,
1384:     hidden_bias,
1385:     output_weights,
1386:     output_bias,
1387: ):
1388: 
1389:     X = data[
1390:         FEATURES
1391:     ].to_numpy(
1392:         dtype=float
1393:     )
1394: 
1395:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1396:     # PMML NormContinuous:
1397:     #
1398:     # normalized = x * scale + shift
1399:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1400: 
1401:     X_norm = np.zeros_like(
1402:         X,
1403:         dtype=float,
1404:     )
1405: 
1406:     for j, feature in enumerate(
1407:         FEATURES
1408:     ):
1409: 
1410:         scale = normalization[
1411:             feature
1412:         ][
1413:             "scale"
1414:         ]
1415: 
1416:         shift = normalization[
1417:             feature
1418:         ][
1419:             "shift"
1420:         ]
1421: 
1422:         X_norm[
1423:             :,
1424:             j
1425:         ] = (
1426:             X[
1427:                 :,
1428:                 j
1429:             ]
1430:             * scale
1431:             + shift
1432:         )
1433: 
1434:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1435:     # Hidden layer.
1436:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1437: 
1438:     H_linear = (
1439:         X_norm
1440:         @ hidden_weights.T
1441:         + hidden_bias
1442:     )
1443: 
1444:     H = np.tanh(
1445:         H_linear
1446:     )
1447: 
1448:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1449:     # Output layer.
1450:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1451: 
1452:     O_linear = (
1453:         H
1454:         @ output_weights.T
1455:         + output_bias
1456:     )
1457: 
1458:     O = np.tanh(
1459:         O_linear
1460:     )
1461: 
1462:     return (
1463:         X_norm,
1464:         H_linear,
1465:         H,
1466:         O_linear,
1467:         O,
1468:     )
1469: 
1470: 
1471: # ===================================================================
1472: # METRICS
1473: # ===================================================================
1474: 
1475: def auc_rank(
1476:     y_true,
1477:     scores,
1478: ):
1479: 
1480:     y_true = np.asarray(
1481:         y_true,
1482:         dtype=int,
1483:     )
1484: 
1485:     scores = np.asarray(
1486:         scores,
1487:         dtype=float,
1488:     )
1489: 
1490:     positive = scores[
1491:         y_true == 1
1492:     ]
1493: 
1494:     negative = scores[
1495:         y_true == 0
1496:     ]
1497: 
1498:     wins = 0.0
1499: 
1500:     for p in positive:
1501: 
1502:         wins += np.sum(
1503:             p > negative
1504:         )
1505: 
1506:         wins += 0.5 * np.sum(
1507:             p == negative
1508:         )
1509: 
1510:     return float(
1511:         wins
1512:         / (
1513:             len(positive)
1514:             * len(negative)
1515:         )
1516:     )
1517: 
1518: 
1519: def classification_metrics(
1520:     y_true,
1521:     y_pred,
1522: ):
1523: 
1524:     y_true = np.asarray(
1525:         y_true,
1526:         dtype=int,
1527:     )
1528: 
1529:     y_pred = np.asarray(
1530:         y_pred,
1531:         dtype=int,
1532:     )
1533: 
1534:     tp = int(
1535:         np.sum(
1536:             (y_true == 1)
1537:             & (y_pred == 1)
1538:         )
1539:     )
1540: 
1541:     tn = int(
1542:         np.sum(
1543:             (y_true == 0)
1544:             & (y_pred == 0)
1545:         )
1546:     )
1547: 
1548:     fp = int(
1549:         np.sum(
1550:             (y_true == 0)
1551:             & (y_pred == 1)
1552:         )
1553:     )
1554: 
1555:     fn = int(
1556:         np.sum(
1557:             (y_true == 1)
1558:             & (y_pred == 0)
1559:         )
1560:     )
1561: 
1562:     return {
1563:         "tp": tp,
1564:         "tn": tn,
1565:         "fp": fp,
1566:         "fn": fn,
1567:         "accuracy": (
1568:             tp + tn
1569:         )
1570:         / len(y_true),
1571:         "sensitivity": (
1572:             tp
1573:             / (tp + fn)
1574:         )
1575:         if tp + fn
1576:         else None,
1577:         "specificity": (
1578:             tn
1579:             / (tn + fp)
1580:         )
1581:         if tn + fp
1582:         else None,
1583:     }
1584:

1650:             "sample_id"
1651:         ]
1652:         .astype(str)
1653:         .map(
1654:             normalize_id
1655:         )
1656:     )
1657: 
1658:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1659:     # Normalize historical IDs.
1660:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1661: 
1662:     historical[
1663:         "sample_id"
1664:     ] = historical[
1665:         "sample_id"
1666:     ].map(
1667:         normalize_id
1668:     )
1669: 
1670:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1671:     # Join diagnosis.
1672:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1673: 
1674:     keep_metadata_columns = [
1675:         "sample_id",
1676:         "diagnosis",
1677:         "binary_label",
1678:     ]
1679: 
1680:     available = [
1681:         col
1682:         for col in keep_metadata_columns
1683:         if col in metadata.columns
1684:     ]
1685: 
1686:     if set(
1687:         [
1688:             "sample_id",
1689:             "binary_label",
1690:         ]
1691:     ) - set(available):
1692:

1694:             "Current metadata does not contain expected label columns."
1695:         )
1696: 
1697:     merged = historical.merge(
1698:         metadata[
1699:             available
1700:         ],
1701:         on="sample_id",
1702:         how="left",
1703:         validate="one_to_one",
1704:     )
1705: 
1706:     if merged[
1707:         "binary_label"
1708:     ].isna().any():
1709: 
1710:         missing_ids = merged.loc[
1711:             merged[
1712:                 "binary_label"
1713:             ].isna(),
1714:             "sample_id",
1715:         ].tolist()
1716: 
1717:         raise RuntimeError(
1718:             "Could not map metadata for:\n"
1719:             + "\n".join(
1720:                 missing_ids
1721:             )
1722:         )
1723: 
1724:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1725:     # Remove metadata from feature matrix only where appropriate.
1726:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
1727: 
1728:     # Save historical 14-miRNA matrix first.
1729:     historical[

1741:     # Run PMML.

1743: 
1744:     (

1747:         hidden_bias,

1762:         hidden_bias,
1763:         output_weights,

1768:         :,
1769:         0
1770:     ]
1771:

1774:         1
1775:     ]

1780:         > noncancer_score

### scripts\search_original_44_patient_split.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: import re
6: import zipfile
7: from pathlib import Path
8: from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
9: 
10: import pandas as pd
11: 
12: 
13: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
14: 
15: EXTERNAL = ROOT / "data" / "external" / "elife_28932"
16: 
17: TERMS = [
18:     "training set",
19:     "testing set",
20:     "training",
21:     "testing",
22:     "test set",
23:     "train set",
24:     "stratified random",
25:     "random sampling",
26:     "randomization",
27:     "135",
28:     "44",
29:     "validation set",
30:     "validation",
31:     "patient 56",
32:     "sample 56",
33: ]
34: 
35: FILES = sorted(
36:     p for p in EXTERNAL.rglob("*")
37:     if p.is_file()
38: )
39: 
40: 
41: # ================================================================
42: # HELPERS
43: # ================================================================
44: 
45: def normalize_text(text: str) -> str:
46: 
47:     text = text.replace("\xa0", " ")
48:     text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
49: 
50:     return text.strip()
51: 
52: 
53: def show_context(text: str, term: str, radius: int = 350):
54: 
55:     lower = text.lower()
56: 
57:     start = 0
58: 
59:     while True:
60: 
61:         pos = lower.find(term.lower(), start)
62: 
63:         if pos == -1:
64:             break
65: 
66:         left = max(0, pos - radius)
67:         right = min(len(text), pos + len(term) + radius)
68: 
69:         print()
70:         print("-" * 100)
71:         print(f"TERM: {term}")
72:         print("-" * 100)
73:         print(text[left:right])
74: 
75:         start = pos + len(term)
76: 
77: 
78: # ================================================================
79: # TEXT / XML / CODE FILES
80: # ================================================================
81: 
82: def search_text_file(path: Path):
83: 
84:     try:
85:         text = path.read_text(errors="ignore")
86:     except Exception:
87:         return
88: 
89:     normalized = normalize_text(text)
90: 
91:     for term in TERMS:
92: 
93:         if term.lower() in normalized.lower():
94: 
95:             print()
96:             print("=" * 100)
97:             print(path)
98:             print("=" * 100)
99: 
100:             show_context(
101:                 normalized,
102:                 term,
103:             )
104: 
105: 
106: # ================================================================
107: # DOCX
108: # ================================================================
109: 
110: def extract_docx_text(path: Path) -> str:
111: 
112:     try:
113:         with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
114:             xml = z.read("word/document.xml")
115:     except Exception:
116:         return ""
117: 
118:     try:
119:         root = ET.fromstring(xml)
120:     except Exception:
121:         return ""
122: 
123:     parts = []
124: 
125:     for node in root.iter():
126: 
127:         if node.tag.endswith("}t"):
128:             parts.append(node.text or "")
129: 
130:     return normalize_text(
131:         " ".join(parts)
132:     )
133: 
134: 
135: # ================================================================
136: # XLSX
137: # ================================================================
138: 
139: def inspect_xlsx(path: Path):
140: 
141:     try:
142:         excel = pd.ExcelFile(
143:             path,
144:             engine="openpyxl",
145:         )
146:     except Exception as exc:
147: 
148:         print()
149:         print(f"Could not open {path}: {exc}")
150:         return
151: 
152:     print()
153:     print("=" * 100)
154:     print(f"XLSX: {path}")
155:     print("=" * 100)
156: 
157:     print()
158:     print("Sheets:")
159: 
160:     for sheet in excel.sheet_names:
161:         print(f"  {sheet}")
162: 
163:     for sheet in excel.sheet_names:
164: 
165:         try:
166: 
167:             raw = pd.read_excel(
168:                 path,
169:                 sheet_name=sheet,
170:                 header=None,
171:                 engine="openpyxl",
172:             )
173: 
174:         except Exception:
175:             continue
176: 
177:         # Search every cell as text.
178:         for row_idx in range(len(raw)):
179: 
180:             values = [
181:                 str(x)
182:                 for x in raw.iloc[row_idx].tolist()
183:             ]
184: 
185:             row_text = normalize_text(
186:                 " | ".join(values)
187:             )
188: 
189:             lower = row_text.lower()
190: 
191:             if any(
192:                 term.lower() in lower
193:                 for term in TERMS
194:             ):
195: 
196:                 print()
197:                 print(
198:                     f"[{sheet}] row {row_idx + 1}"
199:                 )
200:                 print(row_text)
201: 
202: 
203: # ================================================================
204: # DIRECTORY SEARCH
205: # ================================================================
206: 
207: print("=" * 100)
208: print("SEARCHING ORIGINAL eLIFE MATERIALS FOR THE 135/44 SPLIT")
209: print("=" * 100)
210: 
211: print()
212: print("External directory:")
213: print(EXTERNAL)
214: 
215: print()
216: print("Files found:", len(FILES))
217: 
218: for path in FILES:
219: 
220:     suffix = path.suffix.lower()
221: 
222:     if suffix in {
223:         ".txt",
224:         ".xml",
225:         ".csv",
226:         ".r",
227:         ".py",
228:         ".sas",
229:         ".log",
230:         ".md",
231:     }:
232: 
233:         search_text_file(path)
234: 
235:     elif suffix == ".docx":
236: 
237:         text = extract_docx_text(path)
238: 
239:         for term in TERMS:
240: 
241:             if term.lower() in text.lower():
242: 
243:                 print()
244:                 print("=" * 100)
245:                 print(path)
246:                 print("=" * 100)
247: 
248:                 show_context(
249:                     text,
250:                     term,
251:                 )
252: 
253:     elif suffix == ".xlsx":
254: 
255:         inspect_xlsx(path)
256: 
257: 
258: # ================================================================
259: # SEARCH CODE SOURCE TREE TOO
260: # ================================================================
261: 
262: print()
263: print("=" * 100)
264: print("SEARCHING ENTIRE PROJECT FOR SPLIT INFORMATION")
265: print("=" * 100)
266: 
267: for path in ROOT.rglob("*"):
268: 
269:     if not path.is_file():
270:         continue
271: 
272:     if path.suffix.lower() not in {
273:         ".py",
274:         ".r",
275:         ".xml",
276:         ".txt",
277:         ".csv",
278:         ".md",
279:         ".json",
280:     }:
281:         continue
282: 
283:     if "reports" in path.parts:
284:         continue
285: 
286:     try:
287:         text = path.read_text(errors="ignore")
288:     except Exception:
289:         continue
290: 
291:     lower = text.lower()
292: 
293:     hits = [
294:         term
295:         for term in TERMS
296:         if term.lower() in lower
297:     ]
298: 
299:     if hits:
300: 
301:         print()
302:         print("-" * 100)
303:         print(path)
304:         print("Hits:", ", ".join(hits))
305: 
306:         # Show only relevant lines.
307:         for line_no, line in enumerate(
308:             text.splitlines(),
309:             start=1,
310:         ):
311: 
312:             if any(
313:                 term.lower() in line.lower()
314:                 for term in TERMS
315:             ):
316: 
317:                 print(
318:                     f"{line_no}: {line[:500]}"
319:                 )
320: 
321: 
322: print()
323: print("=" * 100)
324: print("SEARCH COMPLETE")
325: print("=" * 100)
326: 
327: print()
328: print("Important:")
329: print(
330:     "Finding '135' and '44' alone is not enough. "
331:     "We need evidence identifying WHICH 44 patients formed the "
332:     "original testing set."
333: )

### scripts\search_original_split_evidence.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: import re
6: import zipfile
7: from pathlib import Path
8: from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
9: 
10: 
11: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
12: 
13: SEARCH_DIRS = [
14:     ROOT / "data" / "external" / "elife_28932",
15:     ROOT / "data" / "external" / "elife-28932-code1",
16: ]
17: 
18: PATTERNS = [
19:     r"\btraining set\b",
20:     r"\btesting set\b",
21:     r"\btraining\b",
22:     r"\btesting\b",
23:     r"\btrain\b",
24:     r"\btest\b",
25:     r"\b135\b",
26:     r"\b44\b",
27:     r"\brandom\b",
28:     r"\brandomization\b",
29:     r"\brandomly\b",
30:     r"\bsplit\b",
31:     r"\bvalidation\b",
32:     r"\bvalidation set\b",
33: ]
34: 
35: COMPILED = [
36:     re.compile(p, re.IGNORECASE)
37:     for p in PATTERNS
38: ]
39: 
40: 
41: def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
42:     text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
43:     return text.strip()
44: 
45: 
46: def matching_patterns(text: str) -> list[str]:
47:     found = []
48: 
49:     for pattern, compiled in zip(PATTERNS, COMPILED):
50:         if compiled.search(text):
51:             found.append(pattern)
52: 
53:     return found
54: 
55: 
56: def print_context(
57:     filename: str,
58:     text: str,
59:     label: str,
60: ) -> None:
61: 
62:     cleaned = clean_text(text)
63: 
64:     matches = []
65: 
66:     for compiled in COMPILED:
67:         for match in compiled.finditer(cleaned):
68: 
69:             start = max(
70:                 0,
71:                 match.start() - 180,
72:             )
73: 
74:             end = min(
75:                 len(cleaned),
76:                 match.end() + 260,
77:             )
78: 
79:             context = cleaned[start:end]
80: 
81:             matches.append(context)
82: 
83:             if len(matches) >= 8:
84:                 break
85: 
86:         if len(matches) >= 8:
87:             break
88: 
89:     if not matches:
90:         return
91: 
92:     print()
93:     print("=" * 100)
94:     print(f"{filename} [{label}]")
95:     print("=" * 100)
96: 
97:     for i, context in enumerate(matches, start=1):
98:         print()
99:         print(f"CONTEXT {i}")
100:         print(context)
101: 
102: 
103: def process_docx(path: Path) -> None:
104: 
105:     try:
106:         with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
107:             xml = z.read("word/document.xml")
108:     except Exception as exc:
109:         print(f"[ERROR] {path.name}: {exc}")
110:         return
111: 
112:     try:
113:         root = ET.fromstring(xml)
114:     except Exception as exc:
115:         print(f"[ERROR] XML parse failed for {path.name}: {exc}")
116:         return
117: 
118:     text_parts = []
119: 
120:     for elem in root.iter():
121:         if elem.tag.endswith("}t"):
122:             text_parts.append(elem.text or "")
123: 
124:     text = " ".join(text_parts)
125: 
126:     print_context(
127:         path.name,
128:         text,
129:         "DOCX",
130:     )
131: 
132: 
133: def process_xml(path: Path) -> None:
134: 
135:     try:
136:         text = path.read_text(
137:             encoding="utf-8",
138:             errors="ignore",
139:         )
140:     except Exception as exc:
141:         print(f"[ERROR] {path.name}: {exc}")
142:         return
143: 
144:     print_context(
145:         path.name,
146:         text,
147:         "XML",
148:     )
149: 
150: 
151: def main() -> None:
152: 
153:     print("=" * 100)
154:     print("eLIFE ORIGINAL TRAIN/TEST SPLIT EVIDENCE SEARCH")
155:     print("=" * 100)
156: 
157:     files = []
158: 
159:     for directory in SEARCH_DIRS:
160: 
161:         if not directory.exists():
162:             continue
163: 
164:         for path in sorted(directory.rglob("*")):
165: 
166:             if not path.is_file():
167:                 continue
168: 
169:             if path.suffix.lower() in {
170:                 ".docx",
171:                 ".xml",
172:             }:
173:                 files.append(path)
174: 
175:     print()
176:     print(f"Files searched: {len(files)}")
177: 
178:     for path in files:
179: 
180:         if path.suffix.lower() == ".docx":
181:             process_docx(path)
182: 
183:         elif path.suffix.lower() == ".xml":
184:             process_xml(path)
185: 
186:     print()
187:     print("=" * 100)
188:     print("SEARCH COMPLETE")
189:     print("=" * 100)
190:     print()
191:     print("No model was trained.")
192:     print()
193:     print("Look especially for evidence containing:")
194:     print("  - 135 training / 44 testing")
195:     print("  - explicit sample IDs")
196:     print("  - random assignment")
197:     print("  - seed values")
198:     print("  - a list/table identifying training and testing patients")
199:     print()
200:

203:     main()

### scripts\search_possible_historical_test_splits.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: """
4: Search for stratified 44-patient test sets that are compatible with
5: the published eLife GSE94533 demographic counts and reported NN AUC.
6: 
7: IMPORTANT
8: ---------
9: This does NOT claim to recover the original random seed.
10: 
11: The published paper tells us:
12: 
13:     total = 179
14:     training = 135
15:     testing = 44
16: 
17: Testing-set pathology counts:
18: 
19:     Control                 4
20:     Benign                 11
21:     Borderline              5
22:     Stage I/II cancer      12
23:     Stage III/IV cancer    12
24: 
25: The PMML network has already been independently reproduced.
26: 
27: We use the reproduced cancer activation as the ranking score and
28: search many stratified random splits.
29: 
30: A candidate is only a COMPATIBLE split unless independent evidence
31: later proves it was the original split.
32: """
33: 
34: from __future__ import annotations
35: 
36: import json
37: from pathlib import Path
38: 
39: import numpy as np
40: import pandas as pd
41: from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
42: 
43: 
44: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
45: 
46: PREDICTIONS = (
47:     ROOT
48:     / "reports"
49:     / "tables"
50:     / "original_historical_clean_predictions.csv"
51: )
52: 
53: OUTPUT = (
54:     ROOT
55:     / "reports"
56:     / "tables"
57:     / "possible_historical_test_splits.csv"
58: )
59: 
60: N_TRIALS = 20_000
61: def pathology_stratum(row):
62: 
63:     diagnosis = str(
64:         row.get("diagnosis_final", "")
65:     ).strip().lower()
66: 
67:     stage_value = row.get("stage_final", "")
68:     stage = str(stage_value).strip().lower()
69: 
70:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
71:     # Published Table 2 identifies E-1056 as:
72:     #
73:     #   Diagnosis: Cancer
74:     #   Stage: I
75:     #
76:     # Its GEO metadata has no stage value, so use the published
77:     # clinical annotation for this one historical record.
78:     # ---------------------------------------------------------------
79: 
80:     candidate_ids = []
81: 
82:     for field in (
83:         "sample_id_normalized",
84:         "sample_key",
85:         "sample_id",
86:         "title",
87:     ):
88:         value = row.get(field)
89: 
90:         if value is not None:
91:             candidate_ids.append(
92:                 str(value).strip().lower()
93:             )
94: 
95:     is_e1056 = any(
96:         value.replace("-", "") == "e1056"
97:         for value in candidate_ids
98:     )
99: 
100:     if diagnosis == "cancer":
101: 
102:         if is_e1056 and (
103:             not stage
104:             or stage in {"nan", "none"}
105:         ):
106:             return "Stage I/II"
107: 
108:         if "stage i/ii" in stage:
109:             return "Stage I/II"
110: 
111:         if "stage iii/iv" in stage:
112:             return "Stage III/IV"
113: 
114:         if stage in {"i", "ii", "1", "2"}:
115:             return "Stage I/II"
116: 
117:         if stage in {"iii", "iv", "3", "4"}:
118:             return "Stage III/IV"
119: 
120:         raise RuntimeError(
121:             "Cancer patient has an unrecognized stage: "
122:             f"diagnosis={diagnosis!r}, "
123:             f"stage={stage_value!r}, "
124:             f"ids={candidate_ids!r}"
125:         )
126: 
127:     if diagnosis == "benign":
128:         return "Benign"
129: 
130:     if diagnosis == "borderline":
131:         return "Borderline"
132: 
133:     if diagnosis == "control":
134:         return "Control"
135: 
136:     raise RuntimeError(
137:         "Could not classify patient: "
138:         f"diagnosis={diagnosis!r}, "
139:         f"stage={stage_value!r}, "
140:         f"ids={candidate_ids!r}"
141:     )
142: 
143: 
144: 
145: print("=" * 90)
146: print("SEARCHING COMPATIBLE HISTORICAL 44-PATIENT TEST SETS")
147: print("=" * 90)
148:

150: 
151: print()
152: print(f"Patients loaded: {len(df)}")
153: 
154: if len(df) != 179:
155:     raise RuntimeError(
156:         f"Expected 179 patients, found {len(df)}."
157:     )
158: 
159: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
160: # Recover the clinical strata.
161: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
162: 
163: # The prediction file may not currently contain stage.
164: # Load it from the processed historical sample mapping/metadata.
165: METADATA = (
166:     ROOT
167:     / "data"
168:     / "processed"
169:     / "gse94533_metadata.csv"
170: )

252:     )

255:

257: 
258:     diagnosis = str(
259:         row.get("diagnosis_final", "")
260:     ).strip().lower()
261: 
262:     stage_value = row.get("stage_final")
263:     stage = str(stage_value).strip().lower()
264:

270:     # Therefore it belongs to the Stage I/II stratum.

272:

274: 
275:     for field in (
276:         "sample_id",
277:         "sample_key",
278:         "sample_id_normalized",
279:         "title",
280:     ):
281:         value = row.get(field)
282: 
283:         if value is not None:
284:             sample_values.append(
285:                 str(value).strip().lower()
286:             )
287: 
288:     is_e1056 = any(
289:         value.replace("-", "") == "e1056"
290:         for value in sample_values
291:     )
292: 
293:     if diagnosis == "control":
294:         return "Control"
295: 
296:     if diagnosis == "benign":
297:         return "Benign"
298: 
299:     if diagnosis == "borderline":
300:         return "Borderline"
301: 
302:     if diagnosis == "cancer":
303: 
304:         if is_e1056 and (
305:             not stage
306:             or stage in {"nan", "none"}
307:         ):

309:

311:             return "Stage I/II"
312: 
313:         if "stage iii/iv" in stage:
314:             return "Stage III/IV"
315: 
316:         if stage in {"i", "ii", "1", "2"}:
317:             return "Stage I/II"
318: 
319:         if stage in {"iii", "iv", "3", "4"}:
320:             return "Stage III/IV"
321: 
322:         raise RuntimeError(
323:             "Cancer patient has an unrecognized or missing stage: "
324:             f"sample_values={sample_values!r}, "
325:             f"stage={stage_value!r}"
326:         )
327: 
328:     raise RuntimeError(
329:         "Could not classify patient: "
330:         f"sample_values={sample_values!r}, "
331:         f"diagnosis={diagnosis!r}, "
332:         f"stage={stage_value!r}"
333:     )
334:

338:     get_stratum,
339:     axis=1,
340: )
341: 
342: print()
343: print("Available strata:")
344: print(
345:     merged["stratum"]
346:     .value_counts(dropna=False)
347:     .to_string()
348: )
349:

351:

354:         [
355:             "sample_id",
356:             "diagnosis_final",
357:             "stage_final",
358:         ],
359:     ]
360: 
361:     print()
362:     print("UNCLASSIFIED PATIENTS:")
363:     print(bad.to_string(index=False))
364: 
365:     raise RuntimeError(
366:         "Could not assign every patient to one of the five historical strata."
367:     )
368: 
369: TARGET_COUNTS = {
370:     "Control": 4,
371:     "Benign": 11,
372:     "Borderline": 5,
373:     "Stage I/II": 12,
374:     "Stage III/IV": 12,
375: }
376:

378: 
379:     available = int(
380:         (merged["stratum"] == stratum).sum()
381:     )
382:

385:         f"required={n:3d}"
386:     )
387: 
388:     if available < n:
389:         raise RuntimeError(
390:             f"Not enough patients in stratum {stratum}."
391:         )
392: 
393: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
394: # Search stratified random splits.
395: # ---------------------------------------------------------------
396: 
397: rng = np.random.default_rng(94533)
398: 
399: records = []
400: 
401: for trial in range(N_TRIALS):
402:

404:         print(
405:             f"Progress: {trial:,}/{N_TRIALS:,} trials",
406:             flush=True,
407:         )
408: 
409:     selected = []
410:

412: 
413:         candidates = merged.index[
414:             merged["stratum"] == stratum
415:         ].to_numpy()
416:

418:             candidates,
419:             size=n,
420:             replace=False,

439:             ),
440:             "benign": int(
441:                 (test["stratum"] == "Benign").sum()
442:             ),
443:             "borderline": int(
444:                 (test["stratum"] == "Borderline").sum()
445:             ),
446:             "stage_I_II": int(
447:                 (test["stratum"] == "Stage I/II").sum()
448:             ),
449:             "stage_III_IV": int(
450:                 (test["stratum"] == "Stage III/IV").sum()

### scripts\search_split_evidence_clean.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: import re
6: import zipfile
7: from pathlib import Path
8: from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
9: 
10: 
11: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
12: EXT = ROOT / "data" / "external" / "elife_28932"
13: 
14: DOCX_FILES = [
15:     EXT / "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_1.docx",
16:     EXT / "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_2.docx",
17:     EXT / "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_3.docx",
18:     EXT / "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_4.docx",
19:     EXT / "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_5.docx",
20:     EXT / "elife_poa_e28932_Transparent_Reporting_File.docx",
21: ]
22: 
23: XML_FILES = list(
24:     EXT.glob("*.xml")
25: )
26: 
27: KEYWORDS = [
28:     "training set",
29:     "testing set",
30:     "test set",
31:     "train set",
32:     "testing",
33:     "training",
34:     "stratified",
35:     "random",
36:     "randomly",
37:     "randomization",
38:     "135",
39:     "44",
40: ]
41: 
42: 
43: def extract_docx_text(path: Path) -> str:
44: 
45:     with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
46:         xml = z.read("word/document.xml")
47: 
48:     root = ET.fromstring(xml)
49: 
50:     parts = []
51: 
52:     for node in root.iter():
53:         if node.tag.endswith("}t"):
54:             parts.append(node.text or "")
55: 
56:     text = " ".join(parts)
57: 
58:     return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
59: 
60: 
61: def print_context(text: str, keyword: str, radius: int = 250):
62: 
63:     lower = text.lower()
64:     start = 0
65:     seen = 0
66: 
67:     while True:
68: 
69:         pos = lower.find(keyword.lower(), start)
70: 
71:         if pos == -1:
72:             break
73: 
74:         left = max(0, pos - radius)
75:         right = min(
76:             len(text),
77:             pos + len(keyword) + radius,
78:         )
79: 
80:         context = text[left:right]
81: 
82:         # Ignore isolated numeric hits.
83:         if keyword in {"135", "44"}:
84: 
85:             nearby = context.lower()
86: 
87:             phrases = [
88:                 "training set",
89:                 "testing set",
90:                 "test set",
91:                 "train set",
92:                 "testing",
93:                 "training",
94:                 "sample",
95:                 "patient",
96:             ]
97: 
98:             if not any(p in nearby for p in phrases):
99:                 start = pos + len(keyword)
100:                 continue
101: 
102:         print(f"\n  [{keyword}] ...{context}...")
103: 
104:         seen += 1
105: 
106:         # Avoid printing dozens of duplicate contexts.
107:         if seen >= 5:
108:             break
109: 
110:         start = pos + len(keyword)
111: 
112: 
113: print("=" * 90)
114: print("CLEAN SEARCH FOR ORIGINAL 135/44 TRAIN-TEST SPLIT EVIDENCE")
115: print("=" * 90)
116: 
117: print("\nSearching DOCX supplementary materials...\n")
118: 
119: for path in DOCX_FILES:
120: 
121:     if not path.exists():
122:         continue
123: 
124:     text = extract_docx_text(path)
125: 
126:     hits = []
127: 
128:     for keyword in KEYWORDS:
129: 
130:         if keyword.lower() in text.lower():
131:             hits.append(keyword)
132: 
133:     if not hits:
134:         continue
135: 
136:     print("=" * 90)
137:     print(path.name)
138:     print("=" * 90)
139: 
140:     # Prioritize meaningful textual phrases.
141:     priority = [
142:         "training set",
143:         "testing set",
144:         "test set",
145:         "train set",
146:         "stratified",
147:         "random",
148:         "randomly",
149:         "randomization",
150:     ]
151: 
152:     printed = set()
153: 
154:     for keyword in priority:
155: 
156:         if keyword.lower() in text.lower():
157: 
158:             print_context(
159:                 text,
160:                 keyword,
161:             )
162: 
163:             printed.add(keyword)
164: 
165: 
166: print("\n")
167: print("=" * 90)
168: print("SEARCHING XML SOURCE FILES")
169: print("=" * 90)
170: 
171: for path in XML_FILES:
172: 
173:     try:
174:         text = path.read_text(errors="ignore")
175:     except Exception:
176:         continue
177: 
178:     # Only report actual textual split terminology.
179:     pattern = re.compile(
180:         r".{0,250}"
181:         r"(training set|testing set|test set|train set|"
182:         r"stratif[a-z]*|random[a-z]*)"
183:         r".{0,250}",
184:         re.IGNORECASE,
185:     )
186: 
187:     matches = pattern.findall(text)
188: 
189:     if not matches:
190:         continue
191: 
192:     print(f"\n{path.name}")
193: 
194:     # Re-run with full context.
195:     count = 0
196: 
197:     for match in pattern.finditer(text):
198: 
199:         snippet = re.sub(
200:             r"\s+",
201:             " ",
202:             match.group(0),
203:         )
204: 
205:         print(f"  ...{snippet}...")
206: 
207:         count += 1
208: 
209:         if count >= 10:
210:             break
211: 
212: 
213: print("\n")
214: print("=" * 90)
215: print("SEARCH COMPLETE")
216: print("=" * 90)
217: 
218: print(
219:     "\nWe specifically need evidence identifying the actual 44 patients."
220: )
221: print(
222:     "Finding only 'N=44' or 'testing set' is not enough to reconstruct "
223:     "the original split."
224: )

### scripts\validate_historical_reproduction.py
1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: import re
6: import zipfile
7: from pathlib import Path
8: from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
9: 
10: import numpy as np
11: import pandas as pd
12: 
13: 
14: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
15: 
16: SUPP = (
17:     ROOT
18:     / "data/external/elife_28932/"
19:     "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_6.xlsx"
20: )
21: 
22: DOCX = (
23:     ROOT
24:     / "data/external/elife_28932/"
25:     "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_1.docx"
26: )
27: 
28: PMML = (
29:     ROOT
30:     / "data/external/elife-28932-code1/"
31:     "Source-code1.xml"
32: )
33: 
34: GEO_METADATA = (
35:     ROOT
36:     / "data/interim/"
37:     "gse94533_geo_metadata_full.csv"
38: )
39: 
40: 
41: def norm_id(x):
42:     if pd.isna(x):
43:         return ""
44:     s = str(x).strip().lower()
45:     if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0+", s):
46:         s = s.split(".", 1)[0]
47:     return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s)
48: 
49: 
50: def get_sample_column(df):
51:     for col in df.columns:
52:         if str(col).strip().lower() in {"sample", "samples"}:
53:             return col
54: 
55:     for col in df.columns:
56:         name = str(col).strip().lower()
57:         if "sample" in name and "fastq" not in name:
58:             return col
59: 
60:     raise RuntimeError(
61:         f"Could not find sample column in columns: {list(df.columns)}"
62:     )

85:     print("=" * 90)

102:     print(f"Cohort 1 IDs in samples sheet: {len(cohort1_all)}")

116:     #   columns 121..180 -> 60 actual e-sample IDs

124:         header=None,
125:         engine="openpyxl",
126:     )

130:             f"Expected Dataset 2 to have 180 columns, got {raw.shape[1]}"
131:         )

230:         print(f"  {i:3d}: {x}")

247: def load_dataset2(historical_ids):
248:     print()
249:     print("=" * 90)
250:     print("READING SUPPLEMENTAL DATASET 2")
251:     print("=" * 90)
252: 
253:     raw = pd.read_excel(
254:         SUPP,
255:         sheet_name="Supplemental Dataset 2",
256:         header=None,
257:         engine="openpyxl",
258:     )
259: 
260:     print(f"Raw shape: {raw.shape}")
261: 
262:     if raw.shape[1] != 180:
263:         raise RuntimeError(
264:             f"Expected 180 columns, got {raw.shape[1]}"
265:         )
266: 
267:     header = raw.iloc[2, 1:].tolist()
268: 
269:     print()
270:     print("Dataset 2 has 179 expression columns after the feature column?")
271: 
272:     # The workbook has 180 total columns:
273:     # column 0 = miRNA
274:     # columns 1..179 = 179 expression columns in the way pandas
275:     # presents this sheet.
276:     #
277:     # We therefore explicitly associate the 179 Dataset-2 columns
278:     # with the 179 recovered historical patients AFTER removing
279:     # numeric position 56 from the 180-sample biological order.
280:     #
281:     # Dataset 2 itself contains 179 columns here because the original
282:     # supplementary sheet already omits one numeric sample's values.
283: 
284:     sample_columns = list(range(1, 180))
285: 
286:     if len(sample_columns) != 179:
287:         raise RuntimeError("Dataset 2 expression column count is not 179.")
288: 
289:     # Verify e-sample tail.
290:     #
291:     # Dataset 2 contains 179 retained expression columns:
292:     #
293:     #   retained positions 1..119  = numeric cohort samples
294:     #   retained positions 120..179 = 60 e-samples
295:     #
296:     # The original biological numeric position 56 (sample 81195)
297:     # was excluded. Therefore the e-sample block begins at Python
298:     # index 119, not 120.
299:     #
300:     # `header` already contains the 179 Dataset-2 expression-column
301:     # headers, so there is no reason to reference undefined
302:     # `header_row` or `expression_columns`.
303: 
304:     if len(header) != 179:
305:         raise RuntimeError(
306:             "Dataset 2 header contains "
307:             f"{len(header)} expression columns instead of 179."
308:         )
309: 
310:     observed_tail = [
311:         norm_id(x)
312:         for x in header[119:]
313:     ]
314: 
315:     expected_tail = [
316:         norm_id(x)
317:         for x in historical_ids[119:]
318:     ]
319: 
320:     if observed_tail != expected_tail:
321:         raise RuntimeError(
322:             "Dataset 2 e-sample order does not match historical order.\\n"
323:             f"Observed: {observed_tail}\\n"
324:             f"Expected: {expected_tail}"
325:         )
326: 
327:     print()
328:     print("Dataset 2 e-sample order verified.")
329:     print(f"  First e-sample: {observed_tail[0]}")
330:     print(f"  Last e-sample:  {observed_tail[-1]}")
331: 
332:     # Reconstruct which biological sample each Dataset-2 column means.
333:     #
334:     # The 179 biological samples represented are:
335:     #   Cohort2 positions 1..55
336:     #   Cohort2 positions 57..120
337:     #   Cohort1 all 60
338:     #
339:     expected_ids = historical_ids
340: 
341:     features = [
342:         "hsa-miR-23b-3p",
343:         "hsa-miR-29a-3p",
344:         "hsa-miR-32-5p",
345:         "hsa-miR-92a-3p",
346:         "hsa-miR-150-5p",
347:         "hsa-miR-200a-3p",
348:         "hsa-miR-203a",
349:         "hsa-miR-320c",
350:         "hsa-miR-320d",
351:         "hsa-miR-335-5p",
352:         "hsa-miR-450b-5p",
353:         "hsa-miR-1246",
354:         "hsa-miR-1307-5p",
355:         "hsa-miR-200c-3p",
356:     ]
357: 
358:     # Preserve the exact PMML feature order separately later.
359:     available = {}
360: 
361:     for row_idx in range(3, len(raw)):
362:         feature = raw.iloc[row_idx, 0]
363: 
364:         if pd.isna(feature):
365:             continue
366: 
367:         feature = str(feature).strip()
368: 
369:         if feature in features:
370:             values = raw.iloc[row_idx, 1:180].tolist()
371: 
372:             if len(values) != 179:
373:                 raise RuntimeError(
374:                     f"{feature}: expected 179 values, got {len(values)}"
375:                 )
376: 
377:             available[feature] = values
378: 
379:     missing = [x for x in features if x not in available]
380: 
381:     if missing:
382:         raise RuntimeError(
383:             f"Missing Dataset 2 PMML features: {missing}"
384:         )
385: 
386:     matrix = pd.DataFrame(
387:         {
388:             feature: pd.to_numeric(
389:                 available[feature],
390:                 errors="coerce",
391:             )
392:             for feature in features
393:         },
394:         index=expected_ids,
395:     )
396: 
397:     print()
398:     print("Dataset 2 historical matrix:")
399:     print(f"  Patients: {matrix.shape[0]}")
400:     print(f"  Features: {matrix.shape[1]}")
401: 
402:     if matrix.isna().any().any():
403:         raise RuntimeError("Dataset 2 contains missing PMML feature values.")
404: 
405:     return matrix

407: 
408: def parse_pmml():
409:     print()
410:     print("=" * 90)
411:     print("READING ORIGINAL PMML")
412:     print("=" * 90)
413: 
414:     root = ET.parse(PMML).getroot()
415: 
416:     # PMML tags may have namespaces.
417:     def local(tag):
418:         return tag.split("}")[-1]
419: 
420:     norm = {}
421: 
422:     for elem in root.iter():
423:         if local(elem.tag) != "NormContinuous":
424:             continue
425: 
426:         field = elem.attrib.get("field")
427: 
428:         if not field or not field.startswith("hsa-miR-"):
429:             continue
430: 
431:         shift = float(elem.attrib["shift"])
432:         scale = float(elem.attrib["scale"])
433: 
434:         norm[field] = {
435:             "shift": shift,
436:             "scale": scale,
437:         }
438: 
439:     networks = [
440:         x for x in root.iter()
441:         if local(x.tag) == "NeuralNetwork"
442:     ]
443: 
444:     if len(networks) != 1:
445:         raise RuntimeError(
446:             f"Expected exactly one neural network, found {len(networks)}"
447:         )
448: 
449:     network = networks[0]
450: 
451:     layers = [
452:         x for x in network
453:         if local(x.tag) == "NeuralLayer"
454:     ]
455: 
456:     if len(layers) != 2:
457:         raise RuntimeError(
458:             f"Expected 2 neural layers, found {len(layers)}"
459:         )
460: 
461:     hidden = {}
462:     output = {}
463: 
464:     for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(layers):
465: 
466:         activation = layer.attrib.get(
467:             "activationFunction"
468:         )
469: 
470:         if activation != "tanh":
471:             raise RuntimeError(
472:                 f"Expected tanh activation, got {activation}"
473:             )
474: 
475:         for neuron in layer:
476: 
477:             if local(neuron.tag) != "Neuron":
478:                 continue
479: 
480:             nid = int(neuron.attrib["id"])
481:             bias = float(neuron.attrib["bias"])
482: 
483:             weights = {}
484: 
485:             for con in neuron:
486: 
487:                 if local(con.tag) != "Con":
488:                     continue
489: 
490:                 weights[int(con.attrib["from"])] = float(
491:                     con.attrib["weight"]
492:                 )
493: 
494:             if layer_idx == 0:
495:                 hidden[nid] = {
496:                     "bias": bias,
497:                     "weights": weights,
498:                 }
499:             else:
500:                 output[nid] = {
501:                     "bias": bias,
502:                     "weights": weights,
503:                 }
504: 
505:     if len(hidden) != 7:
506:         raise RuntimeError(
507:             f"Expected 7 hidden neurons, found {len(hidden)}"
508:         )
509: 
510:     if len(output) != 2:
511:         raise RuntimeError(
512:             f"Expected 2 output neurons, found {len(output)}"
513:         )
514: 
515:     return norm, hidden, output
516: 
517: 
518: def forward_pass(matrix, norm, hidden, output, feature_order):
519:     x = matrix[feature_order].to_numpy(dtype=float)
520: 
521:     normalized = np.column_stack(
522:         [
523:             x[:, i] * norm[feature]["scale"]
524:             + norm[feature]["shift"]
525:             for i, feature in enumerate(feature_order)
526:         ]
527:     )
528: 
529:     hidden_ids = sorted(hidden)
530: 
531:     hidden_values = np.column_stack(
532:         [
533:             np.tanh(
534:                 hidden[nid]["bias"]
535:                 + normalized @ np.array(
536:                     [
537:                         hidden[nid]["weights"][i]
538:                         for i in range(len(feature_order))
539:                     ]
540:                 )
541:             )
542:             for nid in hidden_ids
543:         ]
544:     )
545: 
546:     output_ids = sorted(output)
547: 
548:     output_values = np.column_stack(
549:         [
550:             np.tanh(
551:                 output[nid]["bias"]
552:                 + hidden_values @ np.array(
553:                     [
554:                         output[nid]["weights"][hid]
555:                         for hid in hidden_ids
556:                     ]
557:                 )
558:             )
559:             for nid in output_ids
560:         ]
561:     )
562: 
563:     # neuron 21 = cancer
564:     # neuron 22 = controls/borderline
565:     predicted = np.where(
566:         output_values[:, 0] > output_values[:, 1],
567:         "CA",
568:         "BBC",
569:     )
570: 
571:     return output_values, predicted
572: 
573: 
574: def parse_table2():
575:     print()
576:     print("=" * 90)
577:     print("READING PUBLISHED TABLE 2")
578:     print("=" * 90)
579: 
580:     with zipfile.ZipFile(DOCX) as z:
581:         xml = z.read("word/document.xml")
582: 
583:     root = ET.fromstring(xml)
584: 
585:     ns = {
586:         "w": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
587:     }
588: 
589:     tables = root.findall(".//w:tbl", ns)
590: 
591:     print(f"Tables found: {len(tables)}")
592: 
593:     if len(tables) < 2:
594:         raise RuntimeError("Could not find Table 2.")
595: 
596:     table = tables[1]
597: 
598:     rows = []
599: 
600:     for tr in table.findall("./w:tr", ns):
601: 
602:         cells = []
603: 
604:         for tc in tr.findall("./w:tc", ns):
605: 
606:             texts = tc.findall(".//w:t", ns)
607: 
608:             value = "".join(
609:                 t.text or ""
610:                 for t in texts
611:             ).strip()
612: 
613:             cells.append(value)
614: 
615:         rows.append(cells)
616: 
617:     header = rows[0]
618: 
619:     print()
620:     print("Table 2 header:")
621:     for i, h in enumerate(header):
622:         print(f"  {i}: {h}")
623: 
624:     required = {
625:         "ID",
626:         "Study",
627:         "NN",
628:     }
629: 
630:     if not required.issubset(set(header)):
631:         raise RuntimeError(
632:             f"Table 2 header missing required fields: {required}"
633:         )
634: 
635:     id_idx = header.index("ID")
636:     nn_idx = header.index("NN")
637: 
638:     records = []
639: 
640:     for row in rows[1:]:
641: 
642:         if len(row) <= max(id_idx, nn_idx):
643:             continue
644: 
645:         sid = norm_id(row[id_idx])
646:         nn = row[nn_idx].strip()
647: 
648:         if not sid:
649:             continue
650: 
651:         if nn not in {"CA", "BBC"}:
652:             continue
653: 
654:         records.append(
655:             {
656:                 "sample_id": sid,
657:                 "published_nn": nn,
658:             }
659:         )
660: 
661:     table2 = pd.DataFrame(records)
662: 
663:     print()
664:     print(f"Published Table 2 prediction rows: {len(table2)}")
665: 
666:     if len(table2) != 179:
667:         raise RuntimeError(
668:             f"Expected 179 Table 2 prediction rows, got {len(table2)}"
669:         )
670: 
671:     if table2["sample_id"].duplicated().any():
672:         raise RuntimeError("Duplicate IDs found in Table 2.")
673: 
674:     return table2
675: 
676: 
677: def main():
678:     historical_ids = recover_historical_ids()
679: 
680:     dataset2 = load_dataset2(historical_ids)
681: 
682:     norm, hidden, output = parse_pmml()
683: 
684:     feature_order = [
685:         "hsa-miR-23b-3p",
686:         "hsa-miR-29a-3p",
687:         "hsa-miR-32-5p",
688:         "hsa-miR-92a-3p",
689:         "hsa-miR-150-5p",
690:         "hsa-miR-200a-3p",
691:         "hsa-miR-200c-3p",
692:         "hsa-miR-203a",
693:         "hsa-miR-320c",
694:         "hsa-miR-320d",
695:         "hsa-miR-335-5p",
696:         "hsa-miR-450b-5p",
697:         "hsa-miR-1246",
698:         "hsa-miR-1307-5p",
699:     ]
700: 
701:     missing_norm = [
702:         f for f in feature_order
703:         if f not in norm
704:     ]
705: 
706:     if missing_norm:
707:         raise RuntimeError(
708:             f"Missing PMML normalization fields: {missing_norm}"
709:         )
710: 
711:     output_values, predicted = forward_pass(
712:         dataset2,
713:         norm,
714:         hidden,
715:         output,
716:         feature_order,
717:     )
718: 
719:     predictions = pd.DataFrame(
720:         {
721:             "sample_id": dataset2.index,
722:             "pmml_predicted": predicted,
723:             "cancer_activation": output_values[:, 0],
724:             "bbc_activation": output_values[:, 1],
725:         }
726:     )
727: 
728:     table2 = parse_table2()
729: 
730:     merged = predictions.merge(
731:         table2,
732:         on="sample_id",
733:         how="outer",
734:         indicator=True,
735:     )
736: 
737:     if not (merged["_merge"] == "both").all():
738:         print()
739:         print("ID mismatch:")
740:         print(
741:             merged[
742:                 merged["_merge"] != "both"
743:             ].to_string(index=False)
744:         )
745:         raise RuntimeError(
746:             "Historical sample IDs do not exactly match Table 2."
747:         )
748: 
749:     merged["match"] = (
750:         merged["pmml_predicted"]
751:         == merged["published_nn"]
752:     )
753: 
754:     agreement = merged["match"].mean()
755: 
756:     print()
757:     print("=" * 90)
758:     print("HISTORICAL PMML vs PUBLISHED TABLE 2")
759:     print("=" * 90)
760: 
761:     print()
762:     print(f"Patients compared: {len(merged)}")
763:     print(f"Exact prediction agreement: {agreement:.6f}")
764:     print(
765:         f"Matching predictions: "
766:         f"{merged['match'].sum()} / {len(merged)}"
767:     )
768: 
769:     mismatches = merged[
770:         ~merged["match"]
771:     ]
772: 
773:     print()
774:     print(f"Mismatches: {len(mismatches)}")
775: 
776:     if len(mismatches):
777:         print()
778:         print("FIRST MISMATCHES:")
779:         print(
780:             mismatches[
781:                 [
782:                     "sample_id",
783:                     "published_nn",
784:                     "pmml_predicted",
785:                     "cancer_activation",
786:                     "bbc_activation",
787:                 ]
788:             ]
789:             .head(30)
790:             .to_string(index=False)
791:         )
792: 
793:     out = (
794:         ROOT
795:         / "reports/tables/"
796:         "historical_pmml_vs_published_table2.csv"
797:     )
798: 
799:     merged.to_csv(out, index=False)
800: 
801:     print()
802:     print("Saved:")
803:     print(f"  {out}")
804: 
805:     if agreement == 1.0:
806:         print()
807:         print("=" * 90)
808:         print("SUCCESS: EXACT HISTORICAL REPRODUCTION")
809:         print("=" * 90)
810:         print(
811:             "The PMML forward pass reproduces every published "
812:             "Table 2 NN classification."
813:         )
814:     else:
815:         print()
816:         print("=" * 90)
817:         print("REPRODUCTION NOT YET EXACT")
818:         print("=" * 90)
819:         print(
820:             "The historical mapping is structurally correct, "
821:             "but the PMML/data representation still needs investigation."
822:         )
823: 
824: 
825: if __name__ == "__main__":
826:     main()
