6: import zipfile
7: from pathlib import Path
8: from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
9: 
10: import pandas as pd
11: from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix
12: 
13: 
14: ROOT = Path.home() / "ovarian-ai"
15: 
16: PREDICTIONS = (
17:     ROOT
18:     / "reports"
19:     / "tables"
20:     / "original_historical_clean_predictions.csv"
21: )
22: 
23: DOCX = (
24:     ROOT
25:     / "data"
26:     / "external"
27:     / "elife_28932"
28:     / "elife_poa_e28932_Supplementary_File_1.docx"
29: )
30: 
31: OUTPUT = (
32:     ROOT
33:     / "reports"
34:     / "tables"
35:     / "pmml_vs_table2_by_actual_sample_id.csv"
36: )
37: 
38: 
39: # ================================================================
40: # NORMALIZATION
41: # ================================================================
42: 
43: def norm_id(value) -> str:
44: 
45:     s = str(value).strip().lower()
46: 
47:     if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0+", s):
48:         s = s.split(".", 1)[0]
49: 
50:     return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", s)
51: 
52: 
53: # ================================================================
54: # DOCX TABLE EXTRACTION
55: # ================================================================
56: 
57: def cell_text(cell) -> str:
58: 
59:     parts = []
60: 
61:     for node in cell.iter():
62: 
63:         if node.tag.endswith("}t"):
64:             parts.append(node.text or "")
65: 
66:     return "".join(parts).strip()
67: 
68: 
69: def extract_docx_tables(path: Path):
70: 
71:     with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
72: 
73:         xml = z.read("word/document.xml")
74: 
75:     root = ET.fromstring(xml)
76: 
77:     tables = []
78: 
79:     for table in root.iter():
80: 
81:         if not table.tag.endswith("}tbl"):
82:             continue
83: 
84:         rows = []
85: 
86:         for row in table:
87: 
88:             if not row.tag.endswith("}tr"):
89:                 continue
90: 
91:             cells = []
92: 
93:             for cell in row:
94: 
95:                 if not cell.tag.endswith("}tc"):
96:                     continue
97: 
98:                 cells.append(cell_text(cell))
99: 
100:             if cells:
101:                 rows.append(cells)
102: 
103:         if rows:
104:             tables.append(rows)
105: 
106:     return tables
107: 
108: 
109: # ================================================================
110: # FIND TABLE 2
111: # ================================================================
112: 
113: def find_table2(tables):
114: 
115:     for i, table in enumerate(tables):
116: 
117:         if not table:
118:             continue
119: 
120:         header = [
121:             str(x).strip().lower()
122:             for x in table[0]
123:         ]
124: 
125:         has_id = "id" in header
126:         has_nn = "nn" in header
127: 
128:         if has_id and has_nn:
129: 
130:             return i + 1, table
131: 
132:     raise RuntimeError(
133:         "Could not identify published Table 2."
134:     )
135: 
136: 
137: # ================================================================
138: # LOAD PREDICTIONS
139: # ================================================================
140: 
141: pred = pd.read_csv(PREDICTIONS)
142: 
143: if len(pred) != 179:
144: 
145:     raise RuntimeError(
146:         f"Prediction file contains {len(pred)} patients, "
147:         "expected 179."
148:     )
149: 
150: pred["sample_id"] = pred["sample_id"].map(norm_id)
151: 
152: if pred["sample_id"].duplicated().any():
153: 
154:     raise RuntimeError(
155:         "Prediction file contains duplicate sample IDs."
156:     )
157: 
158: 
159: # ================================================================
160: # BUILD TABLE-2-ID -> ACTUAL SAMPLE-ID MAPPING
161: # ================================================================
162: 
163: def table2_id_to_actual_sample_id(table2_id: str) -> str:
164: 
165:     sid = norm_id(table2_id)
166: 
167:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
168:     # Cohort 2
169:     #
170:     # Published Table 2 uses patient numbers:
171:     #
172:     #     1 ... 55
173:     #     57 ... 120
174:     #
175:     # Patient 56 was excluded.
176:     #
177:     # The prediction file is already ordered as:
178:     #
179:     #     Table2 1 ... 55
180:     #     Table2 57 ... 120
181:     #     e-samples
182:     #
183:     # Therefore:
184:     #
185:     #     Table2 ID <=55
186:     #         -> prediction row ID-1
187:     #
188:     #     Table2 ID >=57
189:     #         -> prediction row ID-2
190:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
191: 
192:     if re.fullmatch(r"\d+", sid):
193: 
194:         number = int(sid)
195: 
196:         if 1 <= number <= 55:
197: 
198:             return norm_id(
199:                 pred.iloc[number - 1]["sample_id"]
200:             )
201: 
202:         if 57 <= number <= 120:
203: 
204:             return norm_id(
205:                 pred.iloc[number - 2]["sample_id"]
206:             )
207: 
208:         raise RuntimeError(
209:             f"Unexpected numeric Table 2 patient ID: {sid}"
210:         )
211: 
212:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
213:     # ERASMOS e-samples use their actual identifiers:
214:     #
215:     # e1001
216:     # e1002
217:     # ...
218:     # ------------------------------------------------------------
219: 
220:     if sid.startswith("e"):
221: 
222:         return sid
223: 
224:     raise RuntimeError(
225:         f"Unrecognized Table 2 patient ID: {table2_id!r}"
226:     )
227: 
228: 
229: # ================================================================
230: # READ TABLE 2
231: # ================================================================
232: 
233: print("=" * 90)
234: print("PMML VS PUBLISHED TABLE 2 — ACTUAL SAMPLE-ID VALIDATION")
235: print("=" * 90)
236: 
237: print()
238: print("Prediction patients:", len(pred))
239: 
240: tables = extract_docx_tables(DOCX)
241: 
242: table_number, table2 = find_table2(tables)
243: 
244: print()
245: print("Tables extracted:", len(tables))
246: print("Identified Table:", table_number)
247: 
248: header = [
249:     str(x).strip()
250:     for x in table2[0]
251: ]
252: 
253: print()
254: print("Table 2 header:")
255: for i, value in enumerate(header):
256:     print(f"  {i}: {value}")
257: 
258: 
259: # ================================================================
260: # CONVERT TABLE 2 TO DATAFRAME
261: # ================================================================
262: 
263: rows = []
264: 
265: for row in table2[1:]:
266: 
267:     if len(row) < len(header):
268:         row = row + [""] * (
269:             len(header) - len(row)
270:         )
271: 
272:     if len(row) > len(header):
273:         row = row[:len(header)]
274: 
275:     if not str(row[0]).strip():
276:         continue
277: 
278:     rows.append(row)
279: 
280: 
281: published = pd.DataFrame(
282:     rows,
283:     columns=header,
284: )
285: 
286: published = published.iloc[:179].copy()
287: 
288: if len(published) != 179:
289: 
290:     raise RuntimeError(
291:         f"Published Table 2 contains "
292:         f"{len(published)} patient rows instead of 179."
293:     )
294: 
295: published["table2_id"] = (
296:     published["ID"]
297:     .map(norm_id)
298: )
299: 
300: published["actual_sample_id"] = (
301:     published["table2_id"]
302:     .map(table2_id_to_actual_sample_id)
303: )
304: 
305: 
306: # ================================================================
307: # VALIDATE MAPPING
308: # ================================================================
309: 
310: print()
311: print("=" * 90)
312: print("TABLE 2 -> ACTUAL SAMPLE-ID MAPPING")
313: print("=" * 90)
314: 
315: print()
316: 
317: print(
318:     published[
319:         [
320:             "table2_id",
321:             "actual_sample_id",
322:         ]
323:     ].head(10).to_string(index=False)
324: )
325: 
326: print()
327: 
328: print(
329:     published[
330:         [
331:             "table2_id",
332:             "actual_sample_id",
333:         ]
334:     ].tail(10).to_string(index=False)
335: )
336: 
337: 
338: if (
339:     published["actual_sample_id"]
340:     .duplicated()
341:     .any()
342: ):
343: 
344:     duplicates = published.loc[
345:         published["actual_sample_id"].duplicated(
346:             keep=False
347:         ),
348:         [
349:             "table2_id",
350:             "actual_sample_id",
351:         ],
352:     ]
353: 
354:     print()
355:     print(duplicates.to_string(index=False))
356: 
357:     raise RuntimeError(
358:         "Table 2 mapping generated duplicate actual sample IDs."
359:     )
360: 
361: 
362: pred_ids = set(pred["sample_id"])
363: table_ids = set(
364:     published["actual_sample_id"]
365: )
366: 
367: missing_from_predictions = (
368:     table_ids - pred_ids
369: )
370: 
371: extra_predictions = (
372:     pred_ids - table_ids
373: )
374: 
375: print()
376: print("=" * 90)
377: print("ACTUAL SAMPLE-ID SET VALIDATION")
378: print("=" * 90)
379: 
380: print()
381: print("Prediction IDs:", len(pred_ids))
382: print("Table 2 IDs:  ", len(table_ids))
383: 
384: print()
385: print(
386:     "Missing from predictions:",
387:     len(missing_from_predictions),
388: )
389: 
390: if missing_from_predictions:
391:     print(
392:         sorted(missing_from_predictions)
393:     )
394: 
395: print()
396: print(
397:     "Extra prediction IDs:",
398:     len(extra_predictions),
399: )
400: 
401: if extra_predictions:
402:     print(
403:         sorted(extra_predictions)
404:     )
405: 
406: if missing_from_predictions or extra_predictions:
407: 
408:     raise RuntimeError(
409:         "Prediction and Table 2 sample-ID sets do not match."
410:     )
411: 
412: 
413: # ================================================================
414: # JOIN BY ACTUAL SAMPLE ID
415: # ================================================================
416: 
417: comparison = published.merge(
418:     pred[
419:         [
420:             "sample_id",
421:             "predicted_class",
422:             "cancer_activation",
423:             "controls_or_borderline_activation",
424:         ]
425:     ],
426:     left_on="actual_sample_id",
427:     right_on="sample_id",
428:     how="inner",
429:     validate="one_to_one",
430: )
431: 
432: 
433: if len(comparison) != 179:
434: 
435:     raise RuntimeError(
436:         f"Joined comparison contains {len(comparison)} "
437:         "rows instead of 179."
438:     )
439: 
440: 
441: # ================================================================
442: # NORMALIZE PUBLISHED NN LABEL
443: # ================================================================
444: 
445: comparison["published_nn"] = (
446:     comparison["NN"]
447:     .astype(str)
448:     .str.strip()
449:     .str.upper()
450: )
451: 
452: comparison["pmml_nn"] = comparison[
453:     "predicted_class"
454: ].map(
455:     {
456:         "Ovarian Cancer": "CA",
457:         "Controls or Borderline": "BBC",
458:     }
459: )
460: 
461: 
462: comparison["exact_match"] = (
463:     comparison["published_nn"]
464:     == comparison["pmml_nn"]
465: )
466: 
467: 
468: # ================================================================
469: # RESULTS
470: # ================================================================
471: 
472: matches = int(
473:     comparison["exact_match"].sum()
474: )
475: 
476: mismatches = (
477:     len(comparison) - matches
478: )
479: 
480: agreement = (
481:     matches / len(comparison)
482: )
483: 
484: print()
485: print("=" * 90)
486: print("FINAL RESULTS")
487: print("=" * 90)
488: 
489: print()
490: print(f"Patients:            {len(comparison)}")
491: print(f"Exact matches:       {matches}")
492: print(f"Mismatches:          {mismatches}")
493: print(f"Prediction agreement:{agreement:.6f}")
494: 
495: 
496: # ================================================================
497: # CONFUSION MATRIX
498: # ================================================================
499: 
500: cm = confusion_matrix(
501:     comparison["published_nn"],
502:     comparison["pmml_nn"],
503:     labels=["BBC", "CA"],
504: )
505: 
506: print()
507: print("Confusion matrix:")
508: print()
509: print("                    PMML")
510: print("                 BBC     CA")
511: print(
512:     f"Published BBC    "
513:     f"{cm[0,0]:3d}   {cm[0,1]:3d}"
514: )
515: print(
516:     f"Published CA     "
517:     f"{cm[1,0]:3d}   {cm[1,1]:3d}"
518: )
519: 
520: 
521: # ================================================================
522: # MISMATCHES
523: # ================================================================
524: 
525: if mismatches:
526: 
527:     print()
528:     print("=" * 90)
529:     print("MISMATCHED PATIENTS")
530:     print("=" * 90)
531: 
532:     mismatch_cols = [
533:         "table2_id",
534:         "actual_sample_id",
535:         "published_nn",
536:         "pmml_nn",
537:         "cancer_activation",
538:         "controls_or_borderline_activation",
539:     ]
540: 
541:     print()
542: 
543:     print(
544:         comparison.loc[
545:             ~comparison["exact_match"],
546:             mismatch_cols,
547:         ].to_string(index=False)
548:     )
549: 
550: else:
551: 
552:     print()
553:     print("=" * 90)
554:     print("PERFECT PUBLISHED-PMML AGREEMENT")
555:     print("=" * 90)
556: 
557:     print()
558:     print(
559:         "Every one of the 179 published Table 2 "
560:         "predictions matches the PMML forward pass."
561:     )
562: 
563: 
564: # ================================================================
565: # SAVE
566: # ================================================================
567: 
568: comparison.to_csv(
569:     OUTPUT,
570:     index=False,
571: )
572: 
573: print()
574: print("Saved:")
575: print(f"  {OUTPUT}")
576: 
577: 
578: # ================================================================
579: # FINAL INTERPRETATION
580: # ================================================================
581: 
582: print()
583: print("=" * 90)
584: 
585: if mismatches == 0:
586: 
587:     print("HISTORICAL MODEL VALIDATION: PASSED")
588: 
589: else:
590: 
591:     print(
592:         "HISTORICAL MODEL VALIDATION: "
593:         f"{mismatches} MISMATCHES"
594:     )
595: 
596: print("=" * 90)
